IYASHUBA eyeziteleka emanyuvesi aKwaZulu-Natal njengoba izolo kuphazamiseke ukubhalisa eDurban University of Technology (DUT) nase-University of South Africa (Unisa) abasebenzi betelekela ukunyuselwa amaholo. Abasebenzi base-Unisa abangaphansi kweNational Education Health and Allied Workers Union (Nehawu) bafuna ukunyuselwa umholo ngo-12% kulo nyaka, umqashi uthi angabanika u-6%, abaseDUT bafuna u-10% umqashi uthi angabanika * -4%.Izinyunyana zabasebenzi baseDUT abangaphansi kweNehawu, iTertiary Education National Union SA (Tenusa) neNational Tertiary Education Union (NTEU) bangenele isiteleka ngoMsombuluko.Ngalolu suku bavule ngemashi ebiqondiswe koyiPhini likaShansela wale nyuvesi, uSolwazi Thandwa Mthembu.Izolo, abasebenzi abebethi babona sengathi umphathi uyabaziba babuyele ehhovisi lakhe befuna ukukhuluma naye.UMnuz Milton Estrice okhulumela lezi zinyunyana uthe kusukela bahambisa uhlu lwezikhalo ngalolu suku kuMthembu akukaze kube khona mpendulo noma umhlangano ohleliwe phakathi kwezinyunyana nomqashi.“Sibona sengathi iphini likaShansela lizishaya indiva izikhalo zethu kungakho namhlanje (izolo) sithe asibuye size ehhovisi lakhe ukuze asichazele ukuthi umi kuphi nodaba lwethu.“Sidinga isixazululo esisheshayo ngalolu daba ngoba sibona sengathi akazimisele ukululungisa,” kusho yena.Abasebenzi bazithele phezu konogada abebevimbile ehhovisi lomphathi, abasebenza kuleli hhovisi abathe akekho.ABASEBENZI baseDurban University of Technology (DUT) abatelekele ukwenyuselwa umholo izolo bemasha belibangise kumphathi wale nyuvesi, uSolwazi Thandwa Mthembu Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBOBathi uthe uzothumela umyalezo nge-email mayelana nomhlangano wokucacisango-4% no-6% umqashi azimisele ukunyusela ngayo abasebenzi.“Thina asiwazi u-6% ngoba sazi ukuthi abasebenzi abaqashwanga ngaphansi kohlelo olwaziwa nge-cost to company, yingakho sitshele abezindaba ukuthi umqashi ufuna ukubenyusela umholo ngo-4%. Sisamile ekutheni ngeke sibuyele emsebenzini lungalungisiwe lolu daba,” kusho yena.Lesi sikhungo siqashe abasebenzi besikhashana abebesebenzela kwenye ingxenye yenyuvesi abebebhalisa abafundi.UNksz Noxolo Memela oyimenenja yezokuxhumana kule nyuvesi, uthe inyuvesi izimisele ukulungisa lesi simo ngokushesha.Uthe abaphathi bazimisele ukuhlangana nezinyunyana kuleli sonto ukuze kuxazululwe udaba lwamaholo, olwaqala ukudingidwa ngoMeyi nyakenye.“Izitshudeni nabanye abantu abangena enyuvesi baphephile,” kusho yena.Khonamanjalo e-Unisa, abasebenzi abangaphansi kweNehawu bamise ukubhalisa befuna ukunyuselwa amaholo ngo-12%.Okhulumela iNehawu, uMnuz Khaya Xaba, uthe umqashi ufuna ukunyusa amaholo ngo-6% wathi bakhathele ukuthathwa kancane ngabakule nyuvesi.“Sifuna kuqashwe ngokugcwele abasebenzi abayitoho kuyekwe ukuxhashazwa kwabo emnyangweni wezobuchwepheshe.“Siyazi inyuvesi ingakwazi ukunyusela abasebenzi umholo ngoba babalelwa ku-400 000 abafundi ababhaliswayo minyaka yonke kanti kunoR400 billion osezinqolobaneni. Sizoteleka baze bahlangabezane nezimfuno zethu.”Imizamo yokuthola okhulumela le nyuvesi uMnuz Matrin Ramotshela ayiphumelelanga, ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa nemibuzo athunyelwe yona akayiphendulanga.

UDELE imali ayihola ngokuba ngummeli wasemajajini wagxila ekulungiseleleni iComrades Marathon umpetha walo nyaka wabesifazane, u-Ann Ashworth odle ubhedu izolo emjahweni obusuka eMgungundlovu uphelele eMoses Mabhida Stadium, eThekwini.U-Ashworth (34) ogijimela iMassmart ungene entanjeni ngo-6:10:04 walandelwa womunye umgijimi waseNingizimu Afrika, uGerda Steyn, ogijimela iNedbank ongene ngo-6:15:34.Umgijimi waseRussia, u-Alexandra Morozova, ungene endaweni yesithathu ngo-6:20:21. Wayekade eqede endaweni yesibili nyakenye ngemuva kukaCamille Harron wase-USA ongazange abuye ukuzovikela isicoco sakhe ngenxa yokulimala.Ekhumula nabezindaba u-Ashworth ubonge umndeni nomqeqeshi wakhe ngokumeseka. Ubengalindele ukunqoba yize bona bebekholelwa kuye.“Kungishaqile ukuthi nami ngila. Ngilandele iqhinga lo mqeqeshi. Bekuwumjaho ongajwayelekile ngoba usheshe zibekwa. Kodwa ngizitshele ukuthi ngizogijima ngendlela ebengihlele ngayo. Ngiyabonga kakhulu emndenini wami nomqeqeshi ngabangenzele kona. Bengingasebenzi izinyanga ezimbili. Uma ungasebenzi uwu-advocate awuholi. Ngiyabonga futhi angizisoli ngesinqumo sami,” kusho u-Ashworth odabuka eKapa kodwa osezinze eGauteng.USteyn ungomunye wabebebhekiwe ukuthi banqobe kwabesifazane. Ngo-Ephreli udle ubhedu kwiTwo Oceans Marathon.Emjaweni wabesifazane kuqale kuhamba phambili umpetha wango-2016, uCharne Bosman, kodwa ogcine edlulwe yilaba abebemlandela. Ugcine eqede endaweni yesihlanu ngo-6:33:08.“Umjaho wabesifazane ubusezingeni ebelilindelekile. Besingekho isikhathi sokuhlala ngemuva. Leli golide lingena ezindondweni esengizitholile kulo nyaka,” kusho uSteyn.USteyn, oneminyaka ewu-28, uthe akasoze ayeka ukugijima iComrades Marathon yize abanye bemthatha ngokuthi usemncane.UMorozova ubalise ngokungayitholi imali yakhe yanyakenye. Uthe inhlangano eyengamele ezokugijima, i-Athletics South Africa (ASA), ifuna isiqiniseko sokuthi ukufanele yini ukugijima iComrades.Yize kunjalo uthe isimo abhekene naso asizange simthene amandla okuthi abuye kulo nyaka.Umengameli we-ASA, * -Aleck Skhosana, uthe: “Izwe lakhe limisiwe yi-IAAF thina esilandela imithetho yayo. Igama lakhe alikho ohlwini olwathunyelwa yiyona lwabagijimi abavumelekile ukubamba iqhaza emiqhudelwaneni. Ngeke sikhulume ngemali. Uma ufuna ukukhuluma ngayo kumele ulandele yonke imigudu efanele.”Abaphume phambili kwabesifazane:Ann Ashworth (6:10:04)Gerda Steyn (6:15:34)Alexandra Morozova (6:20:21)Tanith Maxwell (6:20:35)Charne Bosman (6:33:08)Sophia Sundberg (6:45:24)Devon Yanko (6:47:44)Sarah Bard (6:49:05)Carla Malinaro (6:52:16)Yolande Maclean (6:52:16)

UNKZ Bandile Ngidi ekhuluma nephephandaba elinguzakwabo waleli, iThe Mercury uthe lesi sigwebo seminyaka engu-10 esinikwe uPhumlani Ndlovu kasenele kodwa singcono kunokuthi angagwetshwa. Ngokuthi ikhipha isigwebo eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini ngoMsombuluko, imantshi u-Anand Maharaj ifunde umthetho olawula izinkantolo okhuluma ngokuthi izinkantolo zizimele futhi zinomsebenzi wokukhipha izigwebo ezinobulungiswa futhi ezifanele. UNdlovu watholwa enecala ngoJulayi nyakenye. Ubufakazi bochwepheshe bezibhamu baveza ukuthi yisibhamu sakhe esadubula uNqobile Nzuza (17). Yize kunjalo uMaharaj uthe umbuso uzibhekile izimo leli phoyisa elazithola lihlangabezana nazo ezenze ukuthi agudluke esigwebeni esibekiwe seminyaka engu-15. Uqhube wathi uNdlovu owayengajwayele ukusebenza ngezixuku zabantu wazithola ebhekene ngeziqu zamehlo nequlu labantu ababediniwe, wabe esedubula ebhekise kubabhikishi, kwadubuleka uNqobile owayebaleka. UMaharaj uthe leli cala lifaka inkantolo enkingeni okunzima ukuthi ibhekane nayo uma sekumele igwebe. “Umphakathi ubheke ukuthi amaphoyisa asebenze ngaphansi komthetho futhi aqaphele uma ebhekene nababhikishi abanodlame, futhi aqaphele ukuthi awasebenzisi indluzula uma ekulezi zimo.” Uthe imibhikisho ekhona kuleli muva nje ikhombisa ukuthi kukhona nenhlese yokwenza lungabi khona uzinzo. “Angeke kubekezelelwe lokhu futhi ngeke kugqugquzelwe kubantu.” Uthe kulindelekile ukuthi amaphoyisa uma ebhekene ngeziqu zamehlo nequlu lababhikishi abadiniwe, akwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi komthetho futhi aqaphele. “Kodwa indlela izinto ezenzeka ngayo empilweni ziyasifundisa ukuthi lokhu kulula ukukusho kunokwenza ikakhulukazi uma abantu bengasalawuleki,” kusho uMaharaj. Uthe ukuphela kwempilo kaNqobile kuyinto ebuhlungu. “Wayemncane futhi wadutshulwa emhlane. Lokhu bekuhambisana nesifiso sokuthi sikhulume nangokuya ocansini kusetshenziswa umgudu ongemuva. Nizongivumela ukuthi la mathafa womabili - untwentwesana esilubiza ngokuthi yiso nalolu hlobo lokuya ocansini - ngakunye yingosi ezimele. Iso liyatholakala ezilwaneni ezifana nezindlovu namahhashi. LIPHUCE iphoyisa isibhamu lazingqokloza ngaso emtholampilo lashona ibhungu (20) laseGamalakhe okuthiwa litakulwe amaphoyisa lishaywa umphakathi emuva kokuba sengozini yemoto eshiye abantu belimele. Kuthiwa uMnuz Vuyo “Boy Boy” Abdolo waseMagogogweni, eGamalakhe, uzidubulele emtholampilo iGamalakhe Community Health Centre ekhanda emuva kokuthi elanyulelwe amaphoyisa eshaywa umphakathi ngeSonto ekuseni. Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokushayela budedengu avula nokodo mayelana nokushona kwalo mlisa emuva kwalesi sigameko. UCaptain Gwala uthe kusolakala ukuthi lo mlisa uhluleke ukulawula imoto washayisa itekisi ebeyilayisha abantu esitobhini sebhasi iMasengeni. Kuthiwa ibe seyishayisa abantu abathathu balimala baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela. Abagibeli nomshayeli kuthiwa bazamile ukumumisa ngesikhathi ezama ukubaleka endaweni yesigameko. Kusolakala ukuthi umufi ushaywe amalungu omphakathi ngoba ezama ukubaleka endaweni yesigameko emuva kwengozi. Kusolakala nokuthi ngesikhathi engaphandle komtholampilo endaweni yokupaka umsolwa uhlule iphoyisa ngamandla wathatha isibhamu salo wazidubula ekhanda ngesikhathi elinye lingaphakathi emtholampilo. UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, udlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini ka-Abdolo athe kuthiwa ubentshontshe imoto yakubo ngesikhathi ebandakanyeka engozini. Uthe batholile ukuthi usizwe amaphoyisa amyisa emtholampilo waseGamalakhe nokuyilapho obekulindeleke ukuthi ahlolwe igazi ukuze kuvele ukuthi ubengaphuzile yini amanzi amponjwana. UDhlomo uchaze lesi sigameko njengesishaqisayo. Sidabuke kakhulu ngalesi sigameko sokulahlekelwa umphefumulo wumuntu osemusha ngokungenasidingo. Akucabangeki ukuthi abazali bakhe babhekene nobuhlungu obungakanani kulesi sikhathi. Akulula ukubhekana nesimo sokushonelwa yingane ngenxa yento eqale iwukuganga yagcina seyiyinhlekelele enjena. Uthe bayazi nokuthi bakhahlamezeke kangakanani abantu abebekhona ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sigameko emtholampilo waseGamalakhe njengoba ethe babafisela ukuthi bathole amandla kuNkulunkulu ukuthi abasize babhekane nalesi simo. Uthe bazobasiza nalabo abadinga ukululekwa ngokomqondo. Unxuse namalungu omphakathi ukuthi akugweme ukuzijezisela abantu. Izolo, umalume ka-Abdolo, uMnuz Phumlani Mdlozini, uthe umndeni usesimeni esingesihle emuva kokwenzekile. Uthe akulula ukuthi bangakhuluma kakhulu ngakho ngoba kuphenywa wuphiko luphenya amacala enziwa amaphoyisa Independent Police Investigative Directorate. Ngokusho kwakhe, umshana wakhe ube sengozini yemoto wase ehlaselwa amalungu omphakathi nokuyilapho okufike khona amaphoyisa amyisa emtholampilo okuyilapho okwenzeke khona lesi sigameko. UBUMBANO, ezemfundo, ukubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, ezempilo, ukufukula ezomnotho, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ngezinye zezinto okulindeleke ukuthi zibe seqhulwini enkulumeni yaminyaka yonke ye-ANC ezothulwa nguMengameli wale nhlangano, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa. Le nkulumo ibhekwe ngabomvu, ikakhulu kulo nyaka wokhetho, njengoba le nhlangano izobe ikhankasela ukuwina ukhetho ukuze igcine amandla okuhola uhulumeni kuleli ngaphandle kwaseWestern Cape lapho kuphethe iDA. Umgubho iJanuwari 8, uzoba senkundleni yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida eThekwini kusasa. Le nhlangano imemezele ukuthi ilindele ukugcwalisa le nkundla emumatha abantu abangu-87 000. Abahlaziyi bezombusazwe abakhulume neSolezwe, bathe lezi zinto ezibalwe ngenhla yizona ezizobe zihamba phambili enkulumeni kaRamaphosa. Umhlaziyi, uMnuz Protas Madlala, uthe ucabanga ukuthi inkulumo kamengameli izogxila kakhulu odabeni lokudala amathuba emisebenzi nokufukula ezomnotho. "Angingabazi ukuthi uRamaphosa imkhathaza kakhulu indaba yomnotho wezwe osuhlale iside ungasimami yingakho enza konke okusemandleni ukuba kuguqulwe isimo somnotho wezwe," kusho uMadlala. Uthe ngeke ayishiye ngaphandle indaba yobumbano ikakhulukazi njengoba uhlangothi obeluhamba noDkt Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, ngesikhathi kuyiwa eNasrec, kade lungamfuni. "Enye into engicabanga ukuthi uzoyikhuza, isihlava sokubulalana kosopolitiki esenzeka kakhulu lapha KwaZulu-Natal," kusho uMadlala. Omunye umhlaziyi wezepolitiki ozimele, uMnuz Bukani Mngoma, naye uhambe emazwini kaMadlala wathi ubona inkulumo kamengameli izogxila kakhulu ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi nokufukula umnotho. "Udaba lwamathuba emisebenzi nezomnotho kuyahambisana. Enye into engicabanga ukuthi uzoyithinta, wudaba lwezemfundo nodaba lokubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwezinxephezelo," kusho uMngoma. Uthe ezemfundo zibalulekile ngoba ziyisikhali sezwe. Naye uRamaphosa ekhuluma kuleli sonto emgubheni weminyaka engu-107 kwabunjwa i-ANC oHlange, eNanda, ubalule ibanga eselihanjiwe kwezemfundo kuleli. Ubale ukunyuka kwemiphumela ka-matric unyaka nonyaka, isibalo esiphezulu sabafundi ababhala leli banga, ukudla ezikoleni, ukuthuthwa kwabafundi njengezinye zezinto le nhlangano ezenze ngempumelelo selokhu yathatha amandla ombuso. Ukhale ngabafundi abaqala isikole kodwa bangafinyeleli kwa-matric, wathi lokhu kuyabakhathaza. Ubale nokuthi uhulumeni wandise isibalo sabantu abasebenzayo kuleli. "Sathatha izintambo abantu abangu-8 million ababesebenza kuleli, sengeze ngabanye abangu-7 million asebesebenza manje selokhu sathatha izintambo." Umhlaba sizowuthatha ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Sizobhekana nokwahlukana, sizobumbana," kusho uRamaphosa ngamafuphi eNanda. Kuleli sonto, abaholi abahlukene abaphezulu bale nhlangano bankanise isifundazwe sonke benxenxa abantu ukuthi bathamele le nkulumo eMabhida. UMnuz Zizi Kodwa, obhekele ezokuxhumana ehhovisi likaRamaphosa kwi-ANC, uthe abantu bazogcwala nakwenye indawo abazobe behlelelwe kuyona uma sekugcwele eMabhida. "Zintathu kuphela izinhlangano ezikwazi ukugcwalisa izinkundla kuleli. I-ANC, iChiefs uma idlala nePirates nebandla iZCC. Sizoyigcwalisa iMabhida," kusho uKodwa. Le nhlangano ithe yonke into isimi ngomumo ngalo mgubho.

KUMISWE ukufunda esikoleni, Ukusa High, eHammarsdale izolo ngemuva kokubulawa konogada ababili okusolwa ukuthi bashaywe bafa begadile ebusuku bangoLwesithathu esikoleni.Isidumbu sikaMnuz Mncedisi Ntuli (29) okuthiwa bekuwusuku lwakhe lokuqala esebenza esikoleni nesikazakwabo uMnuz Thandazani (46) zitholakale kwelinye lamakilasi esikole izolo ekuseni, uzakwabo wesithathu obesaphila uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela elimele kanzima.Kusolwa ukuthi abahlaseli bebefuna ukhiye wegumbi elihlala ama-laptop nezinye izimpahla ezibalulekile zesikole, ongahlali konogada.Ngokuthola kwaleli phephandaba ngomthombo ongaphakathi esikoleni, unogada ongena ekuseni ufike kukhiyiwe esangweni, wama ngaphandle kwaze kwafika uthishanhloko.“Uthishanhloko uthe unogada makangene ngaphakathi ayobheka ukuthi akukho yini lapho belele khona. Unogada ujombe uthango wangena ngaphakathi wabuya esethi ozakwabo ubafice belele edamini legazi akazi noma kukhona yini kubo osaphila. Uthishanhloko umlandele wangena naye baphuma sebeyofuna abosizo oluphuthumayo,” kusho umthombo.Uyise kaMncedisi, uMnuz Thembinkosi Ntuli, uthe nguye obegqugquzela indodana yakhe ukuthi ingahlali ekhaya isalinde ukuthi kulungiswe okuthile emaphepheni ayo ayigunyaza ukuthi ibe ngunogada ogcwele.“Emasontweni amathathu edlule ungitshele ukuthi uqashwe yinkampani egada ezikoleni, ugada ePhezulu High, bengingazi ukuthi usegada la, eKusa High,” kusho uNtuli.UMfowabo kaThandazani, uMnuz Muntu Majola, uthe akazange asole lutho umfowabo engabuyi emsebenzini ekuseni izolo ngoba kuyenzeka aqale ezindaweni zakhe ngaphambi kokugoduka.“Kuneminyaka egada kulesi sikole akakaze ahlaselwa yize engaphathi lutho oluyisikhali sokuzivikela,” kusho uMajola.UMnuz Mondli Dlamini ongomunye wabanikazi benkampani yonogada iMI Trading ebiqashe labo nogada, uthe sibethuse kakhulu lesi sigameko sokubulawa kwabantu ebebezinikele ekuvikeleni impahla yomphakathi.“Lo msebenzi siwenza ngoba sinothando lomphakathi, akukho nzuzo esiyenzayo yingakho siqasha abantu abangenawo amaphepha ngoba abanamaphepha bazofuna ukukhokhelwa imali esingenayo. Onogada bethu basuke bengahlomile babekelwe ukuthi bafone uma bebona okusolisayo,” kusho uDlamini.Usihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole, uMnuz Aaron Cele, uthe badumele ngalesi sehlakalo, bebezitshela ukuthi ukuba khona komuntu ogadile esikoleni kuzokwenza izigilamkhuba zisabe ukungena.Unobhala weSadtu kulesi sifundazwe uMnuz Bheki Shandu uthe bahlale belugcizelela udaba lokuphepha ezikoleni emnyangweni, wathi ukubulawa kwalabo nogada kuveze ukuthi kumele ukugada kubhekwe ukuthi kwenziwa kanjani.UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu, obezifikele kulesi sikoleni uthe uphoxeke kakhulu. Uthe kukhomba ukuthi kumele kubuyiswe amakomiti emigwaqo ngoba onogada kabanele ukuthi bagade izikole.“Lokhu kusho ukuthi izingane ezifunda emalokishini nasemakhaya ngeke zithuthuke, ngoba uma kufakwe izinsiza zokuthuthukisa izikole izigebengu ziyangena. Uma kungathiwa onogada abahlome nakhona bazoba sengcupheni yokuhlaselwa kufunwa izibhamu,” kusho uMshengu.Izolo abafundi baphindiselwe emakhaya, uMshengu uthe kuzoze kufundwe ngoMsombuluko.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, uthe amaphoyisa athole onogada (29) noneminyaka ewu-46 beshonile ekilasini eceleni kwabo kwatholakala i-crowbar.

Ngaphansi yok'uMthetho Wezotshwala Kazwelonke, abanikazi be-18 bezakhiwo abanamalayisense otshwala abavumelekile ukudayisela umuntu oneminyaka engaphansi kweyi-18 utshwala. Kumele bathathe izinyathelo ezifanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi noma ubani odayiselwa utshwala.

text: IPHITHENE amakhanda imindeni yabesifazane abathathu baseThekwini ababoshwe ngezinsolo zokushushumbisa izidakamizwa e-United States.Ababoshiwe ngoNksz Londiwe Shange (27), Wandile Mhlongo (29), Thembeka Sokhulu (36) baseThekwini noNksz Viwe Tshaka (23) ongowaseLusikisiki e-Eastern Cape. Baboshwe ngoNovemba 17 emkhumbini abebesebenza kuwo weMSC. Bavela enkantolo yeMantshi yaseFlorida eMiami ngoMsombuluko.Ngokwemibiko e-US babanjwe necocaine ka7kg. Uma betholwa benecala bangase bagwetshwe iminyaka eyishumi kuya kudilika jele.UNtokozo Mlambo, ongumzala kaWandile Mhlongo, uthe ube ngowokuqala emndeni ukwaziswa ngokuboshwa kwakhe kanti nguye okudingeke ukuthi atshele umndeni ngalezi zindaba. Uthe uNksz Mhlongo ubesekwinkontileka yakhe yesithathu esebenza kulo mkhumbi.“Unina zimuphathe kabi lezi zindaba. Uyazama ukuziqinisa kodwa uyambona uma uhlezi naye ukuthi umqondo wakhe ukwenye indawo,” kusho uNtokozo.Uthe umndeni uyahluleka ukuqonda ukuthi uzibandakanye kanjani nezidakamizwa.FUNDA:“Besingakaze sizitshele ukuthi angazibandakanya nezidakamizwa. Ngesikhathi sithola izindaba bengizitshela ukuthi mhlawumbe utholwe nesikali esincane abesisebenzisa kodwa uphathwa yi-Asthma futhi uyaziqhelelanisa nezinto ezingabeka isimo sempilo yakhe engcupheni. Ngibone ukuthi lubucayi kangakanani udaba ngesikhathi sengaziswa ngezinsolo ababhekene nazo."Uthe umndeni awunayo imali yokuya e-United States.Umfowabo kaNksz Sokhulu, uMnuz Lindokuhle Sokhulu unqabile ukukhuluma nephephandaba elinguzakwabo weSolezwe, iThe Mercury.“Sisathukile, siyibone emaphepheni lento umndeni kungakakhulunywa nawo. Okwamanje akukho esingakusho,”usho kanje.Unina kaNksz Shange, ongalidalulanga igama lakhe naye uthe ngeke aphawule ngento asiyibone emaphepheni.Okhulumela uMnyango woBudlelwano Namazwe Angaphandle (International Relations and Co-operation)  uMnuz Ndivhumo Mabaya uthe bayaxhumana nababoshiwe.
Kunyakamali owedlule, umsebenzi weFusion Centre wasiza ngoku phenywa kwamacala okukhwabanisa nenko hlakalo angama-276. Cishe izigidi ezingama-R613 zemali eyamiswa kuqulwa amacala obugebengu.
Izikhalo zibandakanya amacampanisiko, ukuphathwakho nokukhululwakho ezinhlalo zokusungulweni amakomidisiko omphakatsiko kanye nezimiso zokuziphathwakho.

INHLANGANO elwela amalungelo ezingane, i-Operation Bobbi Bear, isinxuse abesilisa, ikakhulu obaba ukuthi bazivikele izingane kungabi yibo abazidlwengulayo.Lokhu kulandela ukuboshwa komlisa (38) waseMfazazane, eMthwalume, osolwa ngokudlwengula indodakazi (14) yakhe angayizali nokusolwa ukuthi useze wayikhulelisa. Kuthiwa lo mlisa onengane eneminyaka emihlanu nonina wale ntombazane uqale ukuyidlwengula ineminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye.Lo mlisa obevele eNkantolo yeMantshi eMzumbe, uzophinde avele ngesonto elizayo lapho okulindeleke ukuthi afake isicelo sebheyili.UNksz Sibongile Ngcobo we-Operation Bobbi Bear unxuse obaba ukuthi bazivikele izingane ngisho kungathiwa abazizali.“Siyabancenga obaba ukuthi babe ngobaba bangempela kungabi yibo abahlukumeza izingane. Sibona izigameko eziningi zezingane okuthiwa zidlwengulwe ngobaba. Nobaba osuke engayizali ingane usuke ewubaba wayo,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.Kubuhlungu ukubona lesi simo ikakhulu njengoba kusazongenwa kumkhankaso we-16 Days of Activism for No Violence Against Women and Children obanjwa ngoNovemba 25 kuya kuDisemba 10.UNksz Ngcobo uthe omama kubalulekile ukuthi banakekele izingane zabo futhi baxoxisane nazo ukuze zikwazi ukubatshela uma kukhona izinkinga ezibhekene nazo.Uthe lokhu akushoyo akusho ukuthi unina wale ngane ubengayinakekeli.Uphinde wanxusa abazali ukuthi bangagcini kuphela ngokunaka ezabo izingane kodwa banakekele nezingane zasemiphakathini abavela kuyo.“Kufanele sithi uma sibona ingane emgwaqweni siyithathe njengeyethu. Masibe nomcabango wokuthi ingane yomuntu ingane yami,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.

ABEVALWE ngezingidi amasango amasonto amabandla amabili aKwaMashu izolo, bekhala ngabefundisi.Izolo amaLuthela akhonza egatsheni laKwaMashu, eSangweni,elikwa-F, elidume ngokuthi yisonto loZalo ngenxa yokuthi umdlalo we-tv, Uzalo lusebenzisa leli sonto uma ludlala indawo yesonto, agcine ebamba umhlangano lapho kupakwa khona izimoto, isango lesonto likhiywe ngezingidi, ezintsha.Esangweni bekunanyathiselwe amaphepha athi umfundisi (KB Maseko) onezinyanga ezintathu engalubhadi kuleli gatsha, uyalixova, futhi unabantu abathandayo nangabathandi.Kuthiwa izinkinga ziqale kuleli gatsha ngesikhathi umfundisi nowakwakhe bekhombisa ukungaseseki isigungu esisha sokuphathwa kwesonto esikhethwe ngoMashi, ngoba kuphume abantu abefuna babuyele kulo mkhandlu behlulwa okhethweni.Kuthiwa isigungu esisha sokuphathwa kwaleli gatsha esiholwa uNkk Nonhlanhla Khanyile asizange sinikwe ngokusemthethweni izintambo obekumele kwenziwe ngoMeyi.Kuthiwa umkhandlu omdala bekumele ubikele ibandla ukuthi ushiye kukhona imali engakanani esikhwameni sebandla, uchaze wenzeni kule minyaka eyisithupha uphethe, uchaze nangezinkontileka zaleli bandla nabathile okubalwa neyoZalo, kodwa alizange likwenze lokho. UNkk Khanyile uvumile ukuthi leli gatsha linezinkinga, wathi umkhandlu awuholayo uhambise uhla lwezikhalo enhlokohhovisi, kodwa kwathiwa abayilandelanga imigomo yokufaka izikhalo.“Namhlanje bekumele sibikele ibandla ukuthi sesihambe sagcina kuphi, sesifika kuvalwe amasango,” kusho yena.USihlalo womkhandlu waseNtuzuma, igatsha laKwaMashu elingaphansi kwaso, uMnuz Thabani Mazibuko, uthe abanalo igunya lokungena bagxile edabeni oselwedluliselwe ezingeni elingaphezulu kwabo, njengoba selubikwe kumphathi wesifunda saseThekwini. Uthe udaba lokungeneliseki kwamanye amalungu ebandla lwadingidwa umkhandlu omusha ngoMeyi asibanga khona isisombululo base bethumela amaminithi alowo mhlangano kwisekethe (eThekwini).Uthe bezwile ukuthi kube nokuphazamiseka kwenkonzo ekuseni, okuyinto ebashaqisile nabo.E-Apostolic Faith Mission, KwaC, KwaMashu ebuye yaziwe ngeMaranatha nakhona amalungu aleli bandla abegcwele ngaphandle, amasango ekhiywe yingxenye yamakholwa aleli bandla abebhikisha ethi umfundisi wawo akayindawo.Abesho kanjena nje ngoba isifunda saleli bandla saseThekwini besizobikela amakholwa ukuthi umfundisi waleli gatsha uzogcina ezinyangeni ezimbili ngoba utholakale enamacala okwephula imithetho yebandla.Abahambisana noPastor Simon Mdletshe bebethi uboshelwe amanqina enyathi wethweswa amacala osekuthiwa utholakale enecala kuwo.Ngaphandle kwesango amakholwa abehlukene kabili amanye ethi akahambe, amanye ethi akayindawo.UPastor Tyrone Goliath wesifunda saseThekwini uthe uMdletshe ubephenywa ngamacala yinhlokohhovisi, okukhona kuwo awokusebenzisa budlabha imali, ukuhlanganisa igatsha laKwaMashu nelaseNanda wakha igatsha elilodwa elaziwa ngeMaranatha engayitholanga imvume kwabamphethe.Uqhube wathi uMdletshe wawavuma amacala ayebekwe wona. Kusukela izolo uthe leli gatsha lizolawulwa yisifunda, uma esehambile kuzolethwa umfundisi omusha. Lezi zindaba zimenyezelwe ngombhobho khona ngaphandle kwesonto.

Lokhu bekuhambisana nesifiso sokuthi sikhulume nangokuya ocansini kusetshenziswa umgudu ongemuva. Nizongivumela ukuthi la mathafa womabili - untwentwesana esilubiza ngokuthi yiso nalolu hlobo lokuya ocansini - ngakunye yingosi ezimele. Iso liyatholakala ezilwaneni ezifana nezindlovu namahhashi. Izizathu zalokhu ziningi, zihlanganisa: Ukulangazelela kwabesifazane abasebancane ukugcina umgudu wezocansi ongaphambili ungabanga yingxenye yokuzithokozisa Ubumnandi obukhethekile obunanelekayo kule nhlobo yocansi Ukulangezelela ukuklama indima engesiye undabuzekwayo Ukuvuleleka ekuphileni ubulili oyibona. Uthe kwathatha isikhathi ukuthi unina amazi ukuthi ukuliphi izwe kodwa wamfuna waze wamthola, wamvakashela.“Ngaqala ngaya eTanzania ngesikhathi ngisuka eNingizimu Afrika, ngagcina sengiseSoviet Union. Inhlangano ayisungulile iwaxhumanisa womabili lawa mazwe njengoba enehhovisi eLamontiville nelinye elise-England. Naye uyabuya ukuzobheka umsebenzi kuleli kodwa uxhumana nehhovisi nsuku zonke ngeSkype. Inhlangano wayisungula ngo-2015 emuva kokushona kukanina ngo-2012. Ubuchopho abukwazi ukuzwela ubuhlungu ngoba abunazo izinsiza zokubuzwela. Ebuchosheni kunenqwaba yemithambo nemizwa futhi zikhona nezicubu ezizungeze intamo nobuso konke lokhu kuyakwazi ukuzwela ubuhlungu. Ubuhlungu obuzwelwa yilezi zingxenye bugcina buzwele okungathi ubuhlungu osebusuka ebuchosheni uqobo ngenxa yokuthungelana kwemizwa. Namhlanje ngikhethe ukukhuluma ngamakhanda ambalwa alandela imigujwana ejwayelekile. Kunamakhanda anomkhuba wokuqala ukuhlasela emini yasekuseni okanye njalo ntambama. Kuphinde kube namakhanda aqala njalo ebusuku, ngesikhathi cishe esisodwa, ikhanda elikuvusa njalo ngezinhlungu. Kunamakhanda ankenketha uma uya ocansini, avele abhebhetheke kakhulu uma ufika kuvuthondaba. Angikwazi ukushiya ikhanda elibamba lisonte uhlangothi oluthile lobuso, elifika ngezikhawu linkenkethele ukuthi hayiza. Ngikhethe ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinhlobo, sike siziyeke lezi ezinye esizijwayele ngoba sesike sakhuluma nzulu ngazo phambili. Ekugcineni bazokunikeza okokuthomolalisa izinhlungu uma bengashongo ukuthi hamba uyobona nodokotela woluleko lwezengqondo. Akukho okubi ngokuthi udokotela wakho akuse olulekweni lwezengqondo uma isimo sisho njalo. Engikushoyo ukuthi lokhu makwenzeke sekuhlolwe ngokwanele kufunwa isizathu esiwumsusa wekhanda. Akekho umuntu ongenayo ingcindezi yomqondo kodwa akusiyena wonke umuntu le ngcindezi emphathisa ngekhanda elingalawuleki. Kungumsebenzi kadokotela ukuphanda isizathu esiwumsusa walezi zinhlungu. Abantu bakithi bakhathele ukuzibona bethalaliswa, benyanyalatwa. Ikhanda eliqala emini yasekuseni nantambama Kunamakhanda abangelwa ukushintsha kwamakhemikhali agcwalelene egazini. Isibonelo salapha yikhanda elidalwa utshwala. Ikhemikhali ewutshwala ingena ithontelane egazini bese ichamsela izinhlotshana zamanye amakhemikhali athi angafinyelela ezingeni elithile bese edala ikhanda elibihlungu. KUSASA, iNingizimu Afrika izobe igubha usuku oluthinta abaningi kuleli, uSuku lweNtsha. Ngokomlando uJuni 16 waba wusuku olubalulekile ngo-1976 eSoweto lapho kwabhikisha khona izinkulungwane zabantu abasha begqoke imifaniswano yabo yezikole belwisana nokufundiswa nge-Afrikaans ezikoleni. Kwabhikisha abafundi ababalelwa ku-20 000.Ngokwezibalo ezivela kwaSA History kwabulawa abafundi ababalelwa ku-176 kulo mbhikisho. Omunye walabo bafundi kwaba nguHector Pieterson (13), isithombe sakhe esasabalala umhlaba wonke esezingalweni zikaMbuyisa Makhubu owayeneminyaka engu-18 ngaleso sikhathi.Lesi sithombe sathathwa uMnuz Sam Nzima, odlule emhlabeni nonyaka.Kubafundi ababoshwa ngaleso sikhathi kubalwa nesazi sezomnotho nezepolitiki kuleli, uSolwazi uBonke Dumisa. UDumisa waboshwa ngoJuni 28, 1976 waze waphuma ejele ngoJulayi 28 ngo-1977.Engxoweni neSolezwe ngokubaluleka kwalolu suku, uthe kuyamjabulisa ukuthi ukuzinikela kwabo kusathela izithelo. “Kuyangijabulisa ukubona sivuna izithelo ezinhle ngokuzinikela kwethu ngaleso sikhathi. Kwaba yisikhathi esinzima kimina ukuba sejele isikhathi esingaka kodwa ngangiqonda esasikulwela ukuthi kubalulekile.”Ngemuva kokuphuma ejele uDumisa akazithelanga ngabandayo kwezemfundo njengoba namhlanje eneziqu ezihlukene okubalwa kuzo nezeMasters of Laws (LLM).Ngendlela ecishe ifane no-1976, eminyakeni edlule izitshudeni zakuleli beziyigxoba ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi #FeesMustFall, befuna imfundo yamahhala ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni owayengumengameli kuleli uMnuz Jacob Zuma ngoDisemba nyakenye amemezele imfundo yamahhala kuleli, waveza nokuthi izovivinywa eminyakeni emihlanu kusukela nonyaka.Abaningi basithakasela lesi simemezelo, nokho uDumisa uthe asiguqulanga okuningi. “Ngokubona kwami kwenziwa isimemezelo ngento ebesivele ikhona futhi yangabe isalandelelwa. Izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme besezivele zizama ukwamukela izitshudeni ezivela emakhaya ahlwempu ngohlelo lweNSFAS, umehluko ukuthi sebamukela nzivela emakhaya aphila ngemali engaphansi kukaR600 000 ngonyaka. Kodwa into ebalulekile kakhulu wukuthi nalezo zitshudeni kumele zigqugquzelwe ukuthi ziphase kahle uGrade 12 ukuze bezothola amaphuzu anele ukwena izifundo ezinamathuba omsebenzi.”UDumisa uthe intsha kumele igqugquzelwe ukuthi ifundele ukungena emkhakheni wamakhono ashodayo kuleli ukuze ihlomule kahle. “Sesikhathele ukugqokisa izingane zethu amajazi amnyama bese ziyohlala emakhaya zingawutholi umsebenzi. Ukuze zihlomule kahle ngemfundo ephakeme kumele zingene emkhakheni enamakhono adingekayo emnothweni wakuleli.”

Abadilizelwe imijondolo eCato Manor ngoba kuthiwa bakhe esizeni sesikole ngaphandle kwemvume bathi akukho okubambekayo okukhombisa ukuthi umhlaba abakhe kuwo ngowesikole ngoba awubiyiwe. Abahlali abaficwe yiphephandaba izolo behleli esigangeni, bethi badilizelwe imijondolo yabo ngoMgqibelo, bathi wunyaka wesibili behleli kule ndawo. Ngaphambi kokuthi bakhe baya ekhanseleni beyocela ukwakha labachitha labatshela ukuthi abaye ophikweni lwezindlu kumasipala. UMnuz Vusimuzi Mhlanga, okwabadilizelwe, uthe babengeke bayilandele imigomo abayitshelwa yikhansela ngoba abanayo imali yokugibela baye emahhovisi. "Ngesikhathi siya ekhanseleni sasivele sesiphelelwe yimisebenzi singasenayo imali yokukhokha emqashweni. Kubalwa amahhovisi angekho endaweni kuthiwa asiye kuwo, sizoya ngani? Sabona ukuthi into esingeke siyenze kungcono sakhe imijondolo ukuze babone ukuthi yini esiyifunayo," kusho yena. Uqhube wathi sekukaningi bedilizelwa imijondolo babuye bayivuse ngoba bengenayo indawo yokuhlala. "Kulokhu umasipala udilize imijondolo wathatha othayela bethu wahamba nabo, kwashishwa izimpahla zethu abanye bashiselwa nomazisi kodwa kulindeleke ukuthi sivote. Uthishanhloko uma sicela ukukhuluma naye usibizela amaphoyisa ekubeni indawo engayibiyile," kusho yena. UNksz Xolo Miya uthe izingane zabo sezihlala zigade 'omalume' abadilizayo. "Zithi zidlala zibe zigadile ukuthi ayikho yini imoto yakwamasipala emayo bese ziyamemeza siphume ezindlini," kusho yena. UMnuz Msawakhe Mayisela okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uthe umasipala ukhathazekile ngokwanda kwezigameko zokudliwa komhlaba. "Siyakuqonda ukuthi isidingo sezindlu kumasipala sikhulu, sinohlelo lokwakhela abantu abahlala kulo masipala izindlu kodwa asikwazi ukumelana nomthamo wabadinga izindlu ngenxa yokuthi abantu bafudukela kuleli dolobha bezofuna imisebenzi," kusho yena. Uqhube wathi uma kukhona abaphula umthetho bakhe ngokungemthetho, imijondolo yabo izodilizwa. "Abadilizelwe imijondolo uma bebona ukuthi kukhona ukwephulwa komthetho kumele bayobika emaphoyiseni," usho kanje.

ITHOLAKALE ibulewe yaphonswa esimobeni esiseduze kwasemzini wayo ingoduso ebihlale ihlukunyezwa umnyeni wayo. UNksz Nompumelelo Shangase (46) waseMontebello eNdwedwe ogane eGqugquma, KwaSwayimane utholakale ngeSonto eshonile esimobeni esiseduze komuzi wakhe engenalo inxeba kodwa evuvukele ebusweni. Uyise kamufi, uMnuz Nicholas Shangase uthe, washayelwa ucingo umkhwenyana wakwakhe ngeSonto ekuseni ebuza ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ayikaze ifike yini kubo ngoba iduke ngayizolo? Uthe ushiye amagwinya emafutheni waphuma akamazi ukuthi uyephi usebheke waze wadela, akamtholi. Akuphelanga isikhathi eside wasishayela, wathi utholakale esimobeni esisekupheleni kwegceke emzini wakubo abahlala kuwo. Uthe bafike isidumbu singakathathwa babona ukuthi uma usegcekeni izinyawo zikamufi ziyabonakala emobeni neduku lakhe lasekhanda beliwele khona. Iyangixaka le nto, kwenziwe yini ukuthi abasemzini womntanami bangamboni umuntu obesobala kangaka? Isidumbu sakhe kubonakala sengathi uqale washaywa, wase waklinywa futhi kubonakala sengathi uphonswe esimobeni eseshonile ngoba akukho okukhombisa ukuthi kuke kwashuduziswana. Uthe indodakazi yakhe nyakenye ike yalimala kanzima ishaywe umkhwenyana wayo. "Ubehlale eshaywa nguye umyeni wakhe kodwa ebekezele. Incazelo engitshelwa yona ngabasemzini nayo ayingenelisi. Bathi wayepheke amagwinya ngoMgqibelo ebusuku waphuma, wangasho ukuthi uyaphi wangabe esabuya. Bathi akekho ayexabene naye futhi akuzange kube khona ukuhilizisana noma ukulwa nomkhwenyana wakhe. Kuyangixaka lokhu, umuntu onjani ongashiya ibhodwe linamagwinya angasho lutho kumuntu ahleli naye ekubeni amagwinywa kuyinto esheshe ivuthwe noma ngabe ubeya ethoyilethi? Nakuba engeke esavuka umntanami kodwa ngiyafisa ukwazi ukuthi ubulelwe ngubani?" kusho uShangase. UNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza, ukhathazekile ngokubulawa komunye umuntu wesifazane. Lihle iqiniso, lokho kwaba yingcwaba lokugcina kumuntu omnyama. Umuntu omnyama kuqale lapho ukuthi kuthiwe akenze izinto eziphambene nesiko nesintu sakhe, okugcine kumngcwaba okokugcina.Uma ingane izalwa emandulo bekwaziwa ukuthi uma uyise nonina bengashadile leyo ngane ingumlanjwana, iyohlale ingeyakoninalume. Namhlanje uma ingane izalwa esibhedlela akubuzwa nakubuzwa kuvele kuthiwe ayibhalwe ngesibongo sikayise, lawo maphepha ayogcina eseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya, nakhona ingane igxivizwe ngesibongo sikayise. text: SIYANDA isibalo sabafundi ababhekana nokuhlukunyezwa nokunukubezwa ngothisha ngokocansi ezikoleni zaKwaZulu-Natal.Ngokwempendulo kangqongqoshe wezeMfundo kulesi sifundazwe, uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane, abalelwa ku-33 amacala okunukubeza ngokocansi avuliwe ngo-2017/18. Angu-22 awokushaywa avulwe ngesikhathi esifanayo. UDlungwane udalule lezi zinombolo kulandela umbuzo weDA ePhalamende. Uqhube waveza nokuthi bangu-231 abafundi baKwaZulu-Natal abalulekwa ngokwengqondo.Okhulumela iDA esifundazweni uMnuz Rishigen Viranna, uthe leli qembu likhathazekile ngokungabikwa kwezigameko ezenzeka ezikoleni njengoba besola ukuthi othishanhloko bavikela abenzi bobubi nezikole zabo.“Lolu lwazi lukubeka kucace ukuthi izingane zethu azivikelwa ngendlela efanele ezikoleni. Izikole zethu kumele ngabe zindawo zokufunda eziphephile, kodwa kubukeka engathi liyakhula izinga lobugebengu njengoba ilokhe yande njalo imibiko ngothisha abahlukumeza abafundi,” kusho uViranna.Uthe ngesonto eledlule kubikwe ukuthi uthisha wakulesi sifundazwe usekhulelise abafundi abahlanu abafunda ezikoleni ezihlukahlukene eManguzi eminyakeni emihlanu edlule.“Noma sikushayela ihlombe ukuthi iSouth African Council of Educators (SACE) iyaphenya ngalolu daba, umbuzo uthi; kungani umnyango neSACE besukumele lolu daba sekukhuleliswe abafundi abahlanu?”Empendulweni yakhe uDlungwane uphinde aveze ukuthi babalelwa ku-16 othisha abahlaselwa abafundi kulesi sifundazwe.UViranna uthe uMnyango wezeMfundo uhlulekile ukuvikela othisha nabafundi, wathi kumele kuqashwe onogada ngokushesha ezikoleni ezishoda ngabo. Uthe kumele kube nendlela yokuqopha bonke othisha abatholwa benecala lokunukubeza ngokocansi ukuze bengakwazi ukubalekela kwezinye izifundazwe.

USATHUTHUMELA owesifazane osinde ngesikhathi indoda yakhe idutshulwa ngentululwane yezinhlamvu ngamaphoyisa okuthiwa abephenya entathakusa yangoLwesine eNseleni.UNksz Sihle Mdletshe ubesendlini ngesikhathi kuhlaselwa emzini wabo noMnuz Bhekizenzo Msweli (66), odutshulwe amanxeba amathathu esifubeni wadlavazeka nengalo. UNksz Mdletshe uthe bebelele ngezithuba zabo-1 entathakusa ngesikhathi bezwa kukhonkotha inja egcekeni.“Sesake sangenelwa izigebengu phambilini zizogqekeza imoto. Izimoto ezimbili ubesezipaka eduze komnyango wendlu ukuze ezwe uma kukhona okungahambi kahle. Ngesikhathi inja ikhonkotha wavuka wathatha isibhamu sakhe esisemthethweni, wayovula umnyango wasekhishini lapho bekukhonkotha khona inja,” kuchaza uNksz Mdletshe.Uthe umufi ubesawuvula nje umnyango wezwa kuqhuma isibhamu. Uveze ukuthi wesabile ukuphuma, wezwa umufi ekhala ngokuthi uyafa.“Ungene ekamelweni esaphethe isibhamu, opha kakhulu esifubeni, wafike wawa. Ngizwe kukhona okuqhuma sengathi yibhomu ngasemnyango, ngavele ngaphuma sengiphakamise izandla ngizikhalela kuleli qulu lamadoda ebelisegcekeni. Bangiphushele emnyango bangena endlini bebuza ukuthi ngobani abanye abakhona. Ngibatshele ukuthi kunezingane ezilele kwelinye ikamelo,” kuchaza yena.Uthe kuleli qulu lamadoda bekukhona eyodwa egqoke umfaniswano wamaphoyisa. Usola ukuthi lama doda eqe uthango ngesikhathi engena egcekeni ngoba ebehamba ngezinyawo. Ubone kamuva ukuthi nephoyisa lidubulekile. Uthe la madoda acele awavulele isango efuna ukuvulela i-ambulensi. Emuva kwalesi sigameko uNksz Mdletshe uthe kufike amaphoyisa okuyilapho eqinisekise khona ukuthi nguzakwabo odutshuliwe.Uveze ukuthi usamangele ukuthi ubulaweleni uMsweli ngoba nesibhamu besisemthethweni. Umufi, okuthiwa ubethutha izingane zesikole, ushonele esibhedlela ngoLwesine ekuseni. UNksz Mdletshe uthe ngesikhathi behlaselwa yizigebengu ngo-2016 umufi waqhumisa isibhamu wagcina eboshiwe, waphucwa nesibhamu kodwa icala labuye laphela, nesibhamu sabuyiselwa kuye.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe amaphoyisa abelandela uphenyo ngabasolwa abebefuneka ngamacala okuphanga nawokudlwengulwa enziwa ngo-2017.“Amaphoyisa angqongqozile azazisa kodwa kwakhona odubulayo ngaphakathi endlini kwadubuleka iphoyisa ekhandla. Amaphoyisa aphindisele ngenhlamvu kumufi odubuleke esifubeni.“Umufi utholakale nesibhamu ngaphambi kokuthi bayiswe esibhedlela nephoyisa. Kuvulwe icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala, idokodo ladluliselwa kwi-Independent Police Investigative Directorate”.

UKUSHODELWA yimali yokuthenga abaqwayizi kuholele ekutheni umfundisi osindisiwe adlwengule izingane zamantombazane ezingaphezu kuka-15, ezineminyaka esukela kwewu-3 kuya kwewu-12, emijondolo yaseLouisiana ePort Shepstone.Lezi zindaba zidalulwe wumndeni walo mfundisi, uThokozani Mvalelwa (34), ogwetshwe yiNkantolo yesiFunda yasePort Shepstone odilikajele abahlanu ngemuva kokuzivumela yena ukuthi ubedlwengula laba bantwana qede ababonge ngamaphakethe ama-chips noR2.Yize uMvalelwa, odabuka eLusikisiki, e-Eastern Cape, etshele inkantolo ukuthi zingaphezu kuka-15 izingane azidlwengula, kodwa kwafakaza ezinhlanu kuphela.Inkantolo ithole ukuthi lo mfundisi wadlwengula lezi zingane ezingomakhelwane phakathi kukaJuni no-Okthoba ka-2016.Imikhuba yalo mfundisi yavela ngesikhathi umzali wengane yentombazane eno-6, ethi uthuma indodakazi yakhe esitolo kanti izohlangana noMvalelwa, wayithatha wayiyisa endlini yakhe yomxhaso lapho ayidlwengulela khona maqede wayivala umlomo ngoR2.Ekhuluma neSolezwe ngoMgqibelo unina wale ntombazane, uthe wathi uma ezwa le mihlola wayobikela ikomiti.“Wafike wazivumela yena ukuthi wayidlwengula ingane yami futhi wathembisa ukuthi uzohlawula ngenkukhu. Waveza nokuthi ziningi izingane abezibiza bese elala nazo,” kusho lo mama elifihliwe igama lakhe ukuvikela ingane.Uthe izingane zonke zayiswa esibhedlela lapho odokotela bafike bakuqinisekisa ukuthi nebala zadlwengulwa.Ilungu leCommunity Policing Forum (CPF), uMnuz Simon Mthembu uthe babe sebebiza amaphoyisa ukuba ambophe uMvalelwa njengoba amanye amalungu omphakathi ayesefuna ukumudla amfele futhi efuna anqunyiswe okwembuzi.“Sathi uma simbuza ukuthi wayezidlwengulelani izingane ezincane kanje, wathi ubeswele imali yokuthenga abaqwayizi,” kusho uMthembu othi uMvalelwa ubaziwa njengekholwa ebelikhonze ukuzidumisela iNkosi kuphela.Le ndaba yaziwa ngisho nayizingane ezincane zaseLouisiana njengoba nasejoyintini lendawo isabhungwa.NoNksz Phumzile Khawula, oyisihlobo sikaMvalelwa, uthe naye wamtshela ukuthi usuke waphelelwa amatoho, wangabe esakwazi ukuthenga abaqwayizi.Eqhuba uNksz Khawula uthe uMvalelwa waqala wasonta eZayoni ngaphambi kokuyothwasa. “Indaba yonakala ngesikhathi esethi usindisiwe ngoba ubesenza nezinto ezingaqondakali. Wazivumela yena kimina ukuthi nonina wayemdlwengula njengoba egcine eshonile. Nezingane zezihlobo zakhe ubezidlwengula nje. Kukhona nje neyakithi ayidlwengula,” kusho uNksz Khawula.Umama (47) wengane eno-10 uthe wubulwane obenziwe nguMvalelwa ezinganeni zabo ngoba eziningi ziphazamisekile engqondweni futhi azisenzi kahle ezifundweni zazo esikoleni sendawo iLouisiana Primary.UMnuz Thozamile Zomba, obengumakhelwane kaMvalelwa, uthe naye waqala wangakholwa esezwa ukuthi uMvalelwa wenze la manyala. “Ngahluleka ngisho esezivumela yena kodwa ngangingakholwa. Uze wagwetshwa nje ngingakholwa ngoba ubewumntwana ohloniphayo obekhonze ukusonta. Ubungaze umfake nasekhukhwini. Ubehlale engungwe yizingane, kungasoli muntu,” kusho uZomba.Onina bezingane bathe nakuba benelesekile yisigwebo kodwa okwenziwa wuMvalelwa ezinganeni zabo kuyisihluku esingefaniswe.

UMA uzwa ngempumelelo yesikole iZama High, yaseManzana, Osizweni, eNewcastle, ungacabanga ukuthi ngesinye salezo zikole zasemalokishini noma emadolobheni kanti ushayephansi. IZama High eqala kwaGrade 8 iye kwaGrade 12, ngesinye sezikole eziphakamisela phezulu ifulegi lezikole zasemakhaya futhi ezibhukulile zavala igebe ebelikhona phakathi kwalezi nezikole nezasemadolobheni uma kuziwa ngasohlangothini lwemiphumela. Kubhekwe lukhulu nakwimiphumela yalo nyaka ka-matric yeZama High njengoba kusukela ngo-2010, lesi sikole sihlale sithola u-100%. Kusukela ngo-2010, lesi sikole sihlale sikhiqiza iziqengqe zabafundi abamenywa nguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ngokwenza kahle kwabo uma kukhishwa imiphumela ka-matric. IZama High ibihlonishwa ngisho nawu Mnuz Senzo Mchunu oke waba nguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo esifundazweni ngamagalelo ayo kwezemfundo. Lesi sikole esingaphansi kwesi Funda iMajuba siyahloniswa ezweni lonke kanti amagalelo aso aziwa ngisho nawu Ngqongqoshe weMfundo eyi Sisekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga. Lesi sikole ngesinye sezikole ezamenywa ngu Nkk Motshekga ukuba zibambe iqhaza ohlelweni lomnyango, iThe Schools That Work, oluhlose ukuzama ukuqeda inkinga yokufeyila kwabafundi ezikoleni kuzwelonke. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, lesi sikole sike sahlonishwa ngomklomelo wokulala isibili kuma National Matric Excellence Awards. Lesi sikole sachonywa uphaphe legwalagwala inkampani i-ATKV ngokuhlale senza kahle, ukuhlomula kwaso kuholele ekutheni le nkampani igcine isisiza nezinye izikole ezingomakhelwane baso. IZama idumile futhi ngokwenza kahle emculweni njengoba iqembu lomculo lesikole eliphekwa nguthishanhloko uMnuz Oscar Kubheka lihlale lizitamuzela izindondo kusukela ngo-2010. IQEMBU lomculo lesikole iZama High, sas Osizweni eNewcastle elidume ngokwenza kahle emculweni Njalo lesi sikole sihlale simele isifundazwe kuma National Finals of South African Schools Choral Eisteddfod manje aziwa nge-ABC Motsepe Choral Eisteddfod. Ngo-2017, lesi sikole sawina kwiminxa emine kulo mqhudelwano womculo, umlawuli weqembu lomculo yena wanqoba indondo ye National Best Conductor. Ngo-2018 seyibe yizingqwele kwiminxa emibili, yalala isibili kweminye iminxa emibili. Lesi sikole sesiqophe amacwecwe amathathu ngosizo luka Dkt Lucky Nkosi wo Khozi FM. IQEMBU lomculo lalesi sikole selike lamenywa ngisho nobengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma ukuthi lizomculela kweminye yemicimbi yakhe. Engxoxweni ne Solezwe, uthishanhloko u Kubheka uthe impumelelo yesikole sakhe incike ekubambisaneni okuhle phakathi kwabo bengothisha nabazali. "NoNkulunkulu wangibusisa ngezingane ezifunda lapha esikoleni, ingane uma ifika ingqondo yayo ivele ishintshe izimisele njengezinye izingane," kusho u Kubheka. Uthe abazali babambe iqhaza elikhulu empumelelweni yesikole ngoba bahlale benza isiqiniseko sokuthi yonke into ihamba kahle. UKubheka uphinde wabonga nomholi esifunda sabo uMnuz Zembethe Nkosi ohlale emgqugquzela ukuthi enze kahle. "Umhloli wethu akathi ngoba izinto zihamba kahle bese eyayekelela kodwa uyaqhubeka angiphushe lokho kusiziza kakhulu isikole," kusho u Kubheka. UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo eyisi Sekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga, uthishanhloko wase Zama High uMnuz Oscar Kubheka ne Phini lika Ngqongqoshe weMfundo eyisi Sekelo uMnuz Enver Surty be kweminye yemicimbi yokuklomelisa iZama ngokwenza kahle ku matric. Uphinde wabonga no thishanhloko obekhona ngaphambi kwakhe uNkk Sbongile Mazibuko, wathi nguyena owakhe isisekelo esiqinile sesikole. USihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole uMnuz Nhlanhla Kubheka naye uhambe emazwini kathishanhloko wathi ukubambisana okwenza isikole siphumelele. AMANYE amakhosi awafuni nakuyizwa indaba yeNgonyama Trust njengoba ethi afuna ukuziphathela wona umhlaba wawo, azilawule nemali eyenziwa ngawo. Inkosi Mzabane Makhoba yaseKokstad eNingizimu yeKwaZulu-Natal ithe yize yabekwa yiSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu futhi iyawuncoma umsebenzi owenziwa Ingonyama Trust evikela umhlaba wamakhosi ukuthi uthathwe wuhulumeni kodwa amakhosi kufanele aziphathele umhlaba wawo. "INgonyama Trust kufanele inike amakhosi ilungelo lokuthi aziphathele imali ekhokhwa abatshalizimali abasuke besebenzisa umhlaba. Njengamanje yonke imali eyenziwa emhlabeni wamakhosi iya kwiNgonyama Trust. Amakhosi nezizwe zawo awahlomuli ngalutho," kusho uMakhoba. Uthe amakhosi kufanele aziphathele wona umhlaba wawo nemali eyenziwa kuwona ukuze kuzohlomula izizwe zawo. KwaZulu-Natal angu-303 amakhosi ahambisana nokuthi umhlaba wawo uphathwe iNgonyama Trust futhi awafuni ukuthi uhulumeni asondele kulo mhlaba. INgonyama Trust iphethwe yiSilo, inomhlaba ongu-2.8 million hectares okungumhlaba wasemakhaya omningi kanti ngonyaka iqoqa uR90 million kosomabhizinisi abasebenzisa lo mhlaba. Inkosi Bhungane Hadebe ithe isizwe sayo esise-Estcourt asiyazi iNgonyama Trust ngoba asikaze sithintwe ngesikhathi isungulwa. "Sihambisana neSilo ekutheni umhlaba ngowamakhosi akusiwo okahulumeni kodwa asihambisana neNgonyama Trust ngoba yasungulwa ngaphandle kokwazisa amakhosi," kusho uHadebe. Umholi we-IFP, Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi ngokubambisana nohulumeni kaMengameli owayephethe ngaleso sikhathi uMnuz FW de Klerk, yasungula Ingonyama Trust ngo-1994. Nesonto eledlule uButhelezi uthe wasungula iNgonyama Trust ukuvikela umhlaba wabantu basemakhaya. Enye inkosi ecele ukungadalulwa ithe iSilo asinawo umhlaba ngoba ngowokhokho bamakhosi abawudlulisela kwizizukulwane zabo. Asihambisani nokuthi umhlaba wethu uphathwe Ingonyama sifuna ukuziphathela wona njengoba sasiwuphethe kudala," kusho le nkosi. Enye inkosi ikhale ngokuthi kudala ibizithathela izinqumo ngomhlaba wayo kodwa manje sekufanele ibhalele Ingonyama ngaphambi kokusebenzisa umhlaba wayo. Inkosi Nhlakanipho Maphumulo enguNobhala weCongress of Traditional Leaders of South Africa (Contralesa) ithe wonke amakhosi anelungelo lokuphatha umhlaba wawo kodwa abatshalizimali okufanele basayine isivumelwano sokusebenzisa umhlaba neNgonyama Trust. UMchunu uyilungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC aphinde abe yilungu lekomiti elibheka ukusebenza kwansuku zonke lale nhlangano.Echaza ngokwamfikela kuze kube nomqondo wokuthi kube nesikole esifuze lesi, uMchunu uthe wayefuna abantu baseNdumo ukuthi bazuze inkululeko njengoba babengakaze bazuze lutho selokhu izwe lakhululeka.Uthe inhloso kwakuwukuthi izingane zakule ndawo zithole imfundo esezingeni eliphezulu zisemakhaya.UMchunu ubalule nokuthi wafike wakhomba indawo okwakuzokwakhiwa kuyona lesi sikole kwathi noma abadweba amapulani bechitha indawo esegqumeni ayefuna sakhiwe kuyona kodwa waqhubeka wama ekutheni ufuna sibe kule ndawo ngoba wayefuna abafundi ukuthi uma befunda babuke indawo ekude ababengafisa ukuya kuyona.UDKT Bhekisisa Mthabela uthishanhloko waseMandla Mthethwa School of Excellence eNdumo emi egunjini lamakhompyutha Izithombe: SIBANI NGOBESE“Abadwebi babuya bathi kuzodla enkulu imali ukwakha isikole kule ndawo ngoba iphezulu futhi iyiwa. Ngabatshela bahlengezela izinyembezi ukuthi uma behluleka ukusakha kule ndawo engangiyikhombile, ngizobashintsha ngithole abanye ababezosakha lapho ngangifuna khona.” Uthe umbono wakhe wukuthi kube nesikole esizoba sendaweni yasemakhaya esifana nezenza kahle emadolobheni okwakuzofunda wonke umuntu ikakhulu abakule ndawo okuyibo ababencishwe amathuba. “Kuyangijabulisa ukuthi sigcine sivuliwe isikole. Sasifuna ukukhuphula izinga lezemfundo ngokwakha izikole zesimanje. Noma ngingakaze ngiye kosibona kodwa abantu bakhona bayangithinta njalo bafune ukuthi ngize ngizosibona lesi sikole. Nezinye esasizakha ngisasemnyangweni noma zazingeke zifike kulesi saseNdumo kodwa zazizoba sezingeni eliphezulu zifane nalezi ezisemadolobheni ezihlinzeka ngemfundo esezingeni ekubeni zisemakhaya,” kusho uMchunu.Uthe naseMsinga kwakunezinhlelo zokuthi kube nesikole esifuze lesi esasizofaka zonke izinto njengoba kwakuzohlanganyela yonke iminyango kahulumeni njengoba kwenzeka eNdumo kodwa akazi lolu hlelo lwaphelelaphi ngoba waxoshwa njengoNdunankulu.Lesi sikole kumanje sinoGrade 8, ngonyaka ozayo sizoba noGrade 9 kuthi ngo-2022 sigcine sesinawo wonke amabanga kubalwa * -matric.UDkt Bhekisisa Mthabela, uthishanhloko walesi sikole olandwe umnyango esethathe umhlalaphansi, uthe okwamanje bangu-135 abafundi bakwaGrade 8.Othisha bangu-10, amaHead of Department (HOD) mathathu.“Sekuvuliwe ukufakwa kwezicelo zokufunda ngonyaka ozayo kwaGrade 8. Asithathi kwaGrade 9 ngoba sihamba nabafundi abebefunda kulesi sikole. Abafundi sibasusa phansi size sifike nabo kwa-matric. Zingu-150 izikhala zakwGrade 8 ngonyaka ozayo, abeze abasafuna ukuthola izikhala ngoba ziyashesha ukuphela ngoba baningi abafuna izingane zabo zizofunda kulesi sikole.”Lesi sikole sinamagumbi angu-40 okufundela, i-swimming pool, amahhovisi ama-HOD, igumbi lamakhompyutha, izindawo zokukhanda izimoto, isayensi lab nokunye. Sinezindlu ezingu-10, ezinhlanu ezihlala abafana nezinhlanu ezihlala amantombazane. Indlu ngayinye ihlala abafundi abangu-20.“Kunabaqeqeshi bebhola, rugby, tennis, abokubhukuda ne-netball. Asigxilile kuphela ekufundeni kodwa nakwezemidlalo ngoba umfundi kumele kuvele ikhono lakhe bese eya lapho likhona leli khono.”ABAFUNDI baseMandla Mthethwa School of Excellence eNdumoPhezu kokuba kukhokhwa uR12 000 kwabahlala emakhaya noR32 000 kwabahlala ngaphakathi kodwa isikole sikleliswe saba nguQuintile 1 ngoba sisemakhaya futhi nezinga lokungasebenzi kompakathi liphezulu.UMthabela uthe njalo ngemiSombuluko baqeqesha othisha lapho besuke beshoda khona.Nabafundi bahlonyiswa ngemikhakha ehlukene kulandwa abantu abavela emkhakheni ehlukene ukuzokhuluma nabafundi.“Njengoba sisemakhaya nje sifundisa isiNgisi njengolimi lokuqala kanjalo nolimi olwengeziwe. Lokhu sikwenza ngoba uma kukhona umfundi esibonayo ukuthi uzoshayeka ngoba efunde ezikoleni obekungakhulunywa kusona isiNgisi enze lolu limi njengolwengeziwe. Kodwa uma ephuma esikoleni abefunda ngaso isiNgisi engenankinga yokusikhuluma alwenze njengolimi lwasekhaya.”UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane, evula ngokusemthethweni lesi sikole muva nje, uthe esakhula wayengakaze acabange ukuthi kunesikole esisendaweni yasemakhaya esingaba nedamu lokubhukuda.Uthe sakhiwe ngoR298 million wathi sikwelinye izinga. “Ngijabula ngokuthi kumanje lesi sikole sesiqalile siyasebenza. Ngonyaka ozayo sizoqhubeka nokwamukela izingane ezivela kuzo zonke izinkalo, yize sizobe sigxile kakhulu kule miphakathi eseduze.”Uthe bazohlinzekwa ngokudla kwasekuseni nsuku zonke abafundi nantambama kuzoba yiso leso.Abafuna izikhala bangathinta uMthabela ku-0849897711.

UNksz Vezi uthe yena walala kwamakhelwane nezingane. Kwelinye ikamelo elingaphandle elixhumene nendlu obekuxatshanwa kuyo, bekujwayele ukulala uLanga uma evakashelwe intombi yakhe.UNOMASONTO ZUMA oshe nesoka lakhe kuhlaselwa umjondolo abebelele kuwoKuthiwa kwezwakala ngezithuba zabo 2 ekuseni kusha endlini, izicishamlilo zafika emuva kwendaba. Kutholakale isidumbu sikaNomasonto nesikaLanga endlini.UMnuz Sthembiso Xulu onguyise kaNomasonto uthe ubengazi ukuthi uyathandana nomufi. Uthe waphuma ephethe ibhuku lesikole kungathi uyofunda. Uveze ukuthi ubehlakaniphile esikoleni futhi ethanda nokubhala izinkondlo.Oyisihlobo sikaLanga, uMnuz Thokozani Ntuli uthe ubenenyanga efike eThekwini ephuma KwaMaphumulo.“Intombi kamfowethu besiyazi ngoba ibijwayele ukumvakashela futhi ibingaqali ukulala. Ngesikhathi kuvalwe izikole yahlala isonto lonke. Umfowethu ubeya kule ndlu ngoba eseyolala ngoba lapho efikele khona indawo ayanele kahle. Sisola ukuthi umsolwa ubengazi ukuthi kunabantu abalele kwelinye ikamelo, ubethi ulaya intombi yakhe,” kusho uNtuli.Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe kuphenywa amacala amabili okubulala emuva kokutholakala kwezidumbu ezishile eNanda. BAKHALA ngesiteleka esinodlame abaqashi bemboni yocwazi njengoba bethi amalungu eNational Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa) ahlasela ozakwabo abangatelekile acekele phansi nempahla emafemini ahlukene.Isiteleka seNumsa siqale ngo-Okthoba 15 futhi sisaqhubeka namanje asikatholakali isixazululo sabasebenzi abafuna ukunyuselwa amaholo ngo-15% nokuthi abasebenzi abasezingeni eliphansi okuwuGrade H bahole uR40 ngehora esikhundleni sikaR20 ngehora. Bafuna ukubuyiselwa imihlomulo yokuphumula nebhonasi itholakale minyaka yonke.UMnuz Johan Pieterse oyisikhulu sePlastic Convertors Association of South Africa uthe bakhathazekile ngokuthula kwabezindaba ngodlame oluqhutshwa ngamalungu eNumsa atelekile.“Abasebenzi banelungelo lokuteleka kodwa abanalo ilungelo lokucekela phansi impahla nokuhlasela ozakwabo abangatelekile. Kuyasikhathaza ukuthi abezindaba ababiki ngalolu dlame kodwa bebe bebikile ngemashi yeNumsa ngesikhathi kuqala isiteleka. Siyalugxeka udlame lwamalungu eNumsa ngoba abanye abasebenzi bafuna ukondla imindeni yabo futhi akufanele bahlaselwe abatelekile,” kusho uPieterse.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba uPieterse uthembise iNumsa nobuholi bayo ukuthi bazoziphenya izigameko zodlame baqinisekise ukuthi abathintekayo bayaboshwa.UNkk Phakamile Hlubi-Majola okhulumela iNumsa uthe bayakuchitha ukuthi amalungu eNumsa ahlasela abantu noma acekela phansi impahla emafemini kacwazi.“Abaqashi bavele basukele amalungu eNumsa bathi anodlame ekubeni kunezinyunyana ezimbili ezitelekile okuyiNumsa neMewusa futhi kukhona nabasebenzi abangewona amalungu ezinyunyana abatelekile. Amalungu ethu ayawuhlonipha umthetho futhi ngisho eqhinqa ngaphandle kwamafemu anokuthula. Kudala sizama ukuxoxisana nabaqashi bemboni kacwazi ukuze kutholakale isixazululo kodwa ababuyeli kuthina,” kusho uNkk Hlubi-Majola.

UBUMBANO, ezemfundo, ukubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, ezempilo, ukufukula ezomnotho, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ngezinye zezinto okulindeleke ukuthi zibe seqhulwini enkulumeni yaminyaka yonke ye-ANC ezothulwa nguMengameli wale nhlangano, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa.Le nkulumo ibhekwe ngabomvu, ikakhulu kulo nyaka wokhetho, njengoba le nhlangano izobe ikhankasela ukuwina ukhetho ukuze igcine amandla okuhola uhulumeni kuleli ngaphandle kwaseWestern Cape lapho kuphethe iDA.Umgubho iJanuwari 8, uzoba senkundleni yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida eThekwini kusasa. Le nhlangano imemezele ukuthi ilindele ukugcwalisa le nkundla emumatha abantu abangu-87 000.Abahlaziyi bezombusazwe abakhulume neSolezwe, bathe lezi zinto ezibalwe ngenhla yizona ezizobe zihamba phambili enkulumeni kaRamaphosa.Umhlaziyi, uMnuz Protas Madlala, uthe ucabanga ukuthi inkulumo kamengameli izogxila kakhulu odabeni lokudala amathuba emisebenzi nokufukula ezomnotho.“Angingabazi ukuthi uRamaphosa imkhathaza kakhulu indaba yomnotho wezwe osuhlale isikhathi eside ungasimami yingakho enza konke okusemandleni ukuba kuguqulwe isimo somnotho wezwe,” kusho uMadlala.Uthe ngeke ayishiye ngaphandle indaba yobumbano ikakhulukazi njengoba uhlangothi obeluhamba noDkt Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, ngesikhathi kuyiwa eNasrec, kade lungamfuni.“Enye into engicabanga ukuthi uzoyikhuza, isihlava sokubulalana kosopolitiki esenzeka kakhulu lapha KwaZulu-Natal,” kusho uMadlala.Omunye umhlaziyi wezepolitiki ozimele, uMnuz Bukani Mngoma, naye uhambe emazwini kaMadlala wathi ubona inkulumo kamengameli izogxila kakhulu ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi nokufukula umnotho.“Udaba lwamathuba emisebenzi nezomnotho kuyahambisana. Enye into engicabanga ukuthi uzoyithinta, wudaba lwezemfundo nodaba lokubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwezinxephezelo,” kusho uMngoma.Uthe ezemfundo zibalulekile ngoba ziyisikhali sezwe.Naye uRamaphosa ekhuluma kuleli sonto emgubheni weminyaka engu-107 kwabunjwa i-ANC oHlange, eNanda, ubalule ibanga eselihanjiwe kwezemfundo kuleli.Ubale ukunyuka kwemiphumela ka-matric unyaka nonyaka, isibalo esiphezulu sabafundi ababhala leli banga, ukudla ezikoleni, ukuthuthwa kwabafundi njengezinye zezinto le nhlangano ezenze ngempumelelo selokhu yathatha amandla ombuso.Ukhale ngabafundi abaqala isikole kodwa bangafinyeleli kwa-matric, wathi lokhu kuyabakhathaza.Ubalule nokuthi uhulumeni wandise isibalo sabantu abasebenzayo kuleli.“Sathatha izintambo abantu abangu-8 million ababesebenza kuleli, sengeze ngabanye abangu-7 million asebesebenza manje selokhu sathatha izintambo.“Umhlaba sizowuthatha ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Sizobhekana nokwahlukana, sizobumbana,” kusho uRamaphosa ngamafuphi eNanda.Kuleli sonto, abaholi abahlukene abaphezulu bale nhlangano bankanise isifundazwe sonke benxenxa abantu ukuthi bathamele le nkulumo eMabhida.UMnuz Zizi Kodwa, obhekele ezokuxhumana ehhovisi likaRamaphosa kwi-ANC, uthe abantu bazogcwala nakwenye indawo abazobe behlelelwe kuyona uma sekugcwele eMabhida.“Zintathu kuphela izinhlangano ezikwazi ukugcwalisa izinkundla kuleli. I-ANC, iChiefs uma idlala nePirates nebandla iZCC. Sizoyigcwalisa iMabhida,” kusho uKodwa.Le nhlangano ithe yonke into isimi ngomumo ngalo mgubho.

UMnuz Stan Chidavanzi ongomunye wabagqugquzeli bale nhlangano ozinze e-England, uthe kusenzima ukusiza abanalesi sifo ngoba nohulumeni akabaxhasi. Uthe ngisho izinhlangano ezisiza abaneDementia azilutholi uxhaso. Uveze ukuthi lesi sifo sesibulala abesifazane ukwedlula ezinye izifo e-England.“Silwela ukuthi uhulumeni asithathe njengokukhubazeka lesi sifo ngoba sibucayi kakhulu. Inkinga esibhekene nayo wukuthi abantu abayazi i-dementia, abayiqondi futhi abafundisekile kahle ngayo. Kusanezinkolelo zokuthi onalesi sifo uyathakatha noma uthakathiwe.”Enaba ngalesi sifo uthe kusuke kufe ama-brain cells.Uveze ukuthi onaso akawuboni umehluko phakathi kobusuku nemini, yingakho abanye bebanjwa bentwayiza emgwaqweni ngisho ebusuku. Ukhale ngokuthi lesi sifo aselapheki kodwa kunemishanguzo edambisa kuphela ukukhohlwa okwesikhashana. Yize lesi sifo kuthiwa sihlasela kakhulu izalukazi, uChidavanzi uthe siyenzeka nakulabo abasebasha. Uthe izidakamizwa nazo zinomthelela kulokhu.UNkk Madanda Mabizela ongumnakekeli wabanalesi sifo, uthe unina ongasekho wayenaso. Uthe uma unalesi sifo udinga ukugadwa ubusuku nemini. Ulinganise ngonina athe wake wazama ukuphuza upharafini.“Kumele bahlale benakiwe, bangasitholi isikhathi eside sokuba bodwa. Kumele kungapheli amahora amabili onalesi sifo engakaze anyakaze. Kufanele bazivocavoce, ngisho elele umuntu ujwayele ukumelula umzimba.”Uthe ukulala isikhathi eside kudala izilonda, ezingakubulala uma zinganakiwe.UNksz Shanice Moodley oyiSpeech Therapist, uthe abanalesi sifo kumele bakhunjuzwe njalo izikhathi osukwini. Uthe lokhu kubalekelela ekutheni kubuye umqondo ngoba bayakhohlwa. Ulinganise ngokuthi bakhonjiswe ikhalenda, bakhunjuzwe ngezinsuku ezibalulekile. Uthe kuyasiza nokuthi ubakhombise izinto kunokubatshela ngomlomo ngoba bayakhohlwa. Kuvele ukuthi uma sebehanjelwe wumqondo bakhohlwa ngisho amagama abo. I-BMF yasungulwa nguNksz Bessie Makatini waseLamontville osezinze eLondon ngokusebenza. Ngo-1976 intsha yakuleli yayilwa namaBhunu ifuna ukuqedwa kokufunda ngesibhunu zonke izifundo, kodwa eyanamuhla enye yayo ingene shi kwizidakamizwa.Ucwaningo olwenziwe ngabomkhankaso oqwashisa ngokucwila otshwalweni i-Aware Organisation.Lolu cwaningo luveza isithombe sokuthi lapha eNingizimu Afrika kuthengwa utshwala buka-R3.8 billion ngonyaka. Kubantu bakuleli balinganiselwa ku-60% abaphuza utshwala kanti kubona bangu-34% abaphuza ngokweqile. Kulesi sibalo isilinganiso sekota ngabesilisa abamnyama abaneminyaka eqala ku-24 kuya ku-35 abazithola becwile kubona ngendlela exakile.Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi iningi lentsha yakuleli kuthi ineminyaka engu-12 isuke isilingeka ifise ukuzwa ukuthi utshwala bunambitheka kanjani.Enye iyadikila ingaphide ibuthinte ngenxa yokungathatheki kodwa enye iyabuyela kubona igcine isibujwayele. Ngeshwa enye iyedlulela igcine isiyimulutha yotshwala. Le ntsha isuke inezizathu ezahlukene ezisuke siyiholele kulo mbulalazwe. UNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, izolo utshele abezindaba ukuthi uNkk Gumede, iMeya yaseNewcastle, uDkt Ntuthuko Mahlaba, nekhansela laseThekwini, uMnuz Mondli Mthembu, bazoqhubeka nokuhlala ekhaya kuze kube bathatha isinqumo ngabo okulindeleke ukuthi basikhiphe esontweni lokuqala ku-Agasti. “Ubuholi besifundazwe bathatha isinqumo sokuthi iMeya yaseThekwini, eyaseNewcastle nekhansela uMthembu ukuba baye ekhefini lenyanga. Lesi sinqumo sisamile ngoba isinqumo ngekusasa labo besingakasithathi. Silindele ukuthi sisikhiphe esontweni lokuqala ku-Agasti emuva kokuthola umbiko esizobe siwunikwe yisigungu esibhekelele ukusebenza kwesifundazwe,” kusho uNtuli. Uthe balindele ukuthi amaqabane ahloniphe isinqumo esathathwa wubuholi besifundazwe ngokuthi angabuyeli emsebenzini. Uthe isinqumo sekhefu lenyanga kwaba yisinqumo sepolitiki. “Isicelo sokuhlaba ikhefu sifakwa emsebenzini. Umasipala wuhlaka oluzimele ngakho kasiluqondi uhlelo lwakhona ukuthi luhamba kanjani uma kuphoqeka ukuthi uqhubeke nekhefu,” kusho uDube. Amanye amakhansela asondelene noNkk Gumede kodwa angagunyaziwe ukuthi akhulume nabezindaba acele ukuthi angadalulwa athe amagatsha awaneme ngokuthi imeya kusamele iqhubeke nokuhlala ekhaya. “Adiniwe amaqabane, asazi ngempela ukuthi kuzokwenzekani,” kusho ikhansela. KUBHUNTSHE umngcwabo abamakhaza begoloza nesidumbu befuna imali okuthiwa bebengavumelananga ngayo nomndeni kamufi.Umndeni wakwaMohlakwana eMzongwane, eMatatiele, ukhala ezimathonsi ngezindleko othi ufakwe kuzo yinkampani yabangcwabi iHambakahle Funeral Parlour ekwaV eMlaza, kulandela ukunqaba nesidumbu sikaNksz Buhle Mohlakwana (35) okuthiwa ushonele esibhedlela iKing George eThekwini ngesonto eledlule.Isidumbu bekulindeleke ukuthi sifike eMatatiele ngoLwesihlanu. Kuthiwa bese kwenziwe zonke izinhlelo zokuthi afihlwe ngoMgqibelo.UNkk Mavundle Khoza waseMatatiele ethintwa yiSolezwe uthe bezwe ubuhlungu obukhulu ngesikhathi bethintwa ngocingo wudadewabo kamufi uNksz Busisiwe Mohlakwana, ebazisa ukuthi abamakhaza abebeke kuwo udadewabo, bayanqaba nesidumbu.“Sihlale kwaze kwasa silindile ukuthi isidumbu kuzothiwa siyeza, hleze abamakhaza bashintshe umqondo kodwa lutho. Omakhelwane abebezosikhalisa kudingeke ukuthi babuyele emakhaya. Sifile ngezindleko esingene kuzo kulungiselelwa umngcwabo ebesazi ukuthi uzoba ngoMgqibelo,” kusho uNkk Khoza.UNksz Mohlakwana uthe usola ambize ngomnikazi wenkampani yabangcwabi uMnuz Ndabezinhle Manzi ngokubalutha ethi uzobagcinela isidumbu emakhazeni ngemali encane okuthe uma sebesayinile washayela ucingo amalungu omndeni wafuna imali enkulu.“Ngesikhathi ngithola ucingo lokuthi udadewethu ushonile, ngiphuthume esibhedlela. Osebenza emakhazeni kahulumeni othe ungowakwaKhanyile, usitshele ukuthi kubiza kakhulu ukugcina umuntu emakhazeni kahulumeni ngakho kungakuhle sithole awethu amakhaza lapha sizomgcina khona,” kusho uNksz Mohlakwana.Uthe bacele umsebenzi ukuthi abaxhumanise nenkampani yabangcwabi engabasiza njengoba bengenayo imali eyisamba yokukhokhela amakhaza, wabe esebaxhumanisa noManzi.Uthe ufike kubo wathembisa ukuthi uzobenzela konke bese bona bemkhokhela imali abanayo ngohlelo lwesitolimende.Uveze ukuthi bavumelane ngoR11 000 kuhlanganisa ibhokisi nemali yokuhambisa isidumbu eMatatiele.“Sekumele kuthathwe isidumbu, uManzi ufune uR17 000, wasinqabela nokuthi sibone isidumbu ethi sikhona emakhazeni kodwa sizosibona uma sesikhokhile.”Kuthintwa uManzi, uthe umndeni yiwona ozikhethele uhlobo lokungcwaba olubiza uR17 000.“Bakhethe ibhokisi oluwuhlobo olubizayo ngoba udadewabo kamufi ubethenjiswe abaqashi bakhe ukuthi bazomnika imali enguR10 000. Uthe omunye uR10 000 uzowuthola kusonhlalakahle obelandela udaba lokugula kukamufi,” kusho uManzi.Ukhale ngezindleko athe ungene kuzo eya ezihlotsheni zikamufi, ehla enyuka ngemoto yomsebenzi eyobanxusa ukuthi bakhokhe ngenxa yokuthi bebengasamthinti kwaze kwaphela izinsuku ezintathu kungaxhunyanwa.Emuva kokungenelela kweSolezwe namaphoyisa asesiteshini saseMlaza umndeni ogcine ubike kuwo, uManzi uthe bavumelene nomndeni ngokuthi isidumbu uzosihambisa namuhla.UNksz Mohlokwana ukuqinisekisile ukuthi bavumelene noManzi, ngokukhokha imali enguR7 500.Uthe babikele amaphoyisa aseMlaza agcine esebaphelezela ukuyoxoxa noManzi.

Kwavulwa ngisho isikhwama somnikelo esafinyelela kuR100 000 emuva kwesonto sivuliwe. Umjaho wokuqala wamabhayisikili uwungenele ngo-Agasti oyingxenye yokukhumbula uMnuz Nelson Mandela. Waqala ukugijima ngo-Okthoba emjahweni we-5150 African Triathlon eGoli.“Ngaqala ngokungenela owamabhayisikili ngoba bekungakalulameki kahle ukugijima. Ngenze kahle kulo mjaho ngoba ngaphuma isikhombisa kubantu abangaphezu kuka-100. Emkhakheni wontanga yami obizwa ngo-25-29 ngaphuma phambili,” kusho yena.UGwala uphinde wenza umjaho we-031 eSuncoast noweFNB lapho egijime khona u10km. Ngenyanga edlule ubekomunye umjaho eHowick kanti ngoMgqibelo uzongenela owamabhayisikili wakwaMr Price wokuqokelela uR1 million kubafundi abaswele. Njengoba abaningi bejwayele ukubhala incwadi emuva kwezigameko ezibavelele, uGwala uthe akakucabangi lokho. Uthe usafuna ukugxila emsebezini wakhe ukuze angenele imijaho yakwamanye amazwe.“Mhlawumbe ngelinye ilanga ngiyoyibhala incwadi. Bakhona abebecela ukubhala incwadi ngami kodwa ngabamisa ngoba kuzongiphazamisa.”Udaba lwakhe lusaqhubeka nokuxoxwa emazweni njengoba esanda kuvakashelwa yiBBC neCNN okuyimithombo yezindaba esakazela umhlaba wonke. Ebuza ukuthi bayithathaphi imali yokuqhuba imikhankaso yokweseka uZuma, uNgcobo uthe bacela kosomabhizinisi baphinde basebenzise izinsiza zamabandla abo. KUPHELA ngisho ubungani kwabesifazabe uma kubangwa indoda, bagcina sebelwa bodwa. Akujwayelekile ukuthi uma abesifazane sebethole ukuthi indoda ibabhangqile balwe nayo kodwa baklwebhana bodwa. Lo mkhuba kade waqala njengoba nasezikoleni bekunomkhuba odume ngokuthi ipero, lapho abesifazane babelindana sekuphume isikole belwela ukuthi bajola nomfana oyedwa. Yize nabesilisa belwa bebanga intombi, uNksz Zola Dudeni oyiPsychologist uthi abafana kuyenzeka badlulise uma bebanga intombi kusajolwa nje. Kwehlukile lokhu kwabesifazane athe ngisho bekade bengabangani uma kuke kwabangwa indoda kuphela konke. Uthe yindlela abadalwe ngayo abesifazane eyenza ukuthi bebodwa bangasekani futhi bangaziboni bebalulekile. Uthe isikhathi esiningi abakwenzayo ukujabulisa owesilisa abazi ukuthi yilona joka abanalo. "Owesifazane wadalelwa ukujabulisa owesilisa ngoba ngisho intombazane ingakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yasendlini, abadala bayibuza ukuthi iyokwenzenjani endodeni. Lokhu kwenza owesifazane akhule azi ukuthi kumele ajabulise indoda kukho konke akwenzayo. Uma owesifazane ethole ukuthi babanga indoda eyodwa nomunye, ulwisa umnakwabo hhayi indoda." Uveze ukuthi kumele ngabe yindoda okuliwa nayo ngoba iyona eshelayo kodwa akwenzeki lokho. "Kuke kwaduma indaba yokubizana ngo-star kwabesifazane ababanga indoda. Lelo gama alipheli ngisho indoda ingasathandani nabo. Uma abesifazane beke babanga indoda abaphinde bazwane. Abafana kwesinye isikhathi uma bebanga intombi bagcina bezwana bodwa, babone owesifazane kunguye onephutha bambize nangamagama alumelayo." Umbhali uNksz Nancy Roxanne waseKenya, esihlokweni esikhuluma ngombango wamadoda kwi-website, i-Eve Woman uthe kuwubuwula ukuthi abesifazane balwe bodwa. Uthe kumele balwise indoda bobabili. Uthe indoda emthanda ngempela owesifazane ngeke imbeke esimeni sokuthi kumele ancintisane nomunye othandweni. "Kuyihlazo futhi kwehlisa isithunzi ukubona abesifazane abahle bechitha isikhathi ngokubanga indoda. Abanye bathukana ngisho ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bebanga indoda yona esuke iziphumulele. Uma ujola kumele wazi ukuthi asikho isiqiniseko sokuthi indoda izothembeka kuwena." Ukhuthaza ukuthi uma owesifazane ebamba ukuthi indoda imbhangqile, ungalinge ulwise umnakwenu, ilwa nendoda. Uthe abanye baze baqhoshelane ngokuthi ubani oyintombi yangempela neshende kodwa iqiniso ukuthi bobabili basuke benziwe izilima yindoda. "Asikho isicoco sokulwela indoda. Kunalokho indoda inibona nobabili ngingaphusile ukuthi ningalwa nodwa nibanga yona."

Kubikwa ukuthi lo wesilisa ubehamba nalolu gebhezi ngisho eya ezitolo noma ebhange, njengendlela 'yokuzivikela'. UColonel Moatshe Ngoepe uthe umsolwa wakhipha ugebhezi lukanina emathuneni nyakenye ngoDisemba. "Amalungu omphakathi ambona ehamba endaweni ephethe ugebhezi lomuntu, axhumana namaphoyisa. Ngesikhathi efika amaphoyisa athola ugebhezi lomuntu endlini yomsolwa. Kwakugcwele namathambo enkomo," kusho uNgoepe. "Ngaphezu kwalokho, sesitholile futhi ukuthi umsolwa ubephatha ugebhezi lukanina ngesikhwama uma eya ezitolo noma emabhange, ngoba ubekholelwa ukuthi luyamuvikela ezingozini," kuqhuba yena. Lo wesilisa uzovela eNkantolo yeMantshi eLebowakgomo ngecala lokucekela phansi ithuna maduze.- African News Agency/ANA

Silwela ukuthi uhulumeni asithathe njengokukhubazeka lesi sifo ngoba sibucayi kakhulu. Inkinga esibhekene nayo wukuthi abantu abayazi i-dementia, abayiqondi futhi abafundisekile kahle ngayo. Kusanezinkolelo zokuthi onalesi sifo uyathakatha noma uthakathiwe. Ukhale ngokuthi lesi sifo aselapheki kodwa kunemishanguzo edambisa kuphela ukukhohlwa okwesikhashana. Yize lesi sifo kuthiwa sihlasela kakhulu izalukazi, uChidavanzi uthe siyenzeka nakulabo abasebasha. Uthe izidakamizwa nazo zinomthelela kulokhu. Kumele bahlale benakiwe, bangasitholi isikhathi eside sokuba bodwa. Kumele kungapheli amahora amabili onalesi sifo engakaze anyakaze. Ngokusho kwakhe umfowabo wacelwa uthisha ukuthi ayobiza abantu ababengawenzanga umsebenzi wesikole ababebhalwe epheshaneni okwakufanele lifundwe ekilasini. Uthe wanika umfundi okunguye oyi-prefect ukuthi enze lokhu. Kuthe uma lo mfundi ememeza amagama kwakhona umfundi omphuca iphepha walidabula. Uthe abanye abafundi babiza umfowabo bembikela lokhu. UMarcus uthe kuyishwa ukuthi iSouth African Social Security Agency (Sassa) yaze ngoNovemba ukuthi ngeke ikwazi ukuholela abantu kulo nyaka kodwa yalinda ukufaka isicelo sokuthi kululwe inkontileka yeCPS njengoba isifake ngoFebhuwari.UMarcus uthe njengoba kunomengameli omusha noNgqongqoshe omusha wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNkk Susan Shabangu, banethemba lokuthi izinto zizoshintsha.ICPS ithe iwenza kahle umsebenzi wokuholela izibonelelo zikahulumeni njengoba isikhokhe uR720 billion selokhu yathola inkontileka ngo-2012.Isinqumo asikakakhishwa kulolu daba.

UShange ubhekene namacala amane, okungamabili okudlwengula, elilodwa lokuthumba nelinye lokuhlukumeza ngokocansi amantombazane aneminyaka aphakathi kuka-14 no-18. Lawa macala kuthiwa uShange wawenza eLeisure Palace eNewlands West kusukela ngo-2014 kuya kuNovemba 12, 2018.IMantshi uBusisiwe Mkhulisi imnqabelile uShange ibheyili ngoba ithi wahluleka ukunikeza inkantolo izizathu ezinqala zokuthi kungani kufanele anikezwe ibheyili futhi waqamba amanga. Ngemuva kokuchitha isicelo sebheyili, uShange uqale wafaka phansi ikhanda ngaphambi kokuthandaza isikhathi eside. Uthe esuka lapho wagqolozela uMshushisi uSbongile Ngcobo isikhathi eside futhi engacwayizi.UShange ubuke uNksz Ngcobo waze wayosithela emgodini, elokhu emgqolozele.Abazalwane bavele basikhihla isililo futhi abanye bathandaza. Kukhona intokazi esencane ebigqoke izibuko yona evele yazigingqa phansi.Abesifazane abadala bathwale kanzima bethulisa amantombazane abegqoke izikibha ezinobuso bukamfundisi.Kulokhu uShange ungene enkantolo eswenke ngesudi ephuzi nehembe eliyisikotshi.Inkantolo beyigcwele phama abazalwane abebezoseka uShange. Isicelo sebheyili saqala sachithwa ngumphenyi wecala uSergeant Nomathemba Khwela owaveza ukuthi uShange uzophazamisa uphenyo futhi nempilo yakhe isengcupheni.Nomshushisi uhambe emazwini kaSergeant Khwela futhi wathi kuzodingeka uShange aqhamuke nento ephathekayo engenza anikwe ibheyili.Ngemuva kwesinqumo uNksz Ngcobo uphume ngomnyango ongemuva njengoba amakholwa abelokhu emkhombe njalo ngeminwe, emsola ngokuthi nguye obecindezela uShange.UShange ubemelwe wumnikazi wenkampani yabameli uMnuz Sandile Shoba weShoba Sandile Attorneys. text: UBUKEKA uthela izithelo ezinhle umkhankaso we-IFP wokuthi uhulumeni avume ukutshalwa kwensangu ezosetshenziselwa ukulapha abantu.NgoLwesithathu, uSotswebhu we-IFP ePhalamende, uMnuz Narend Singh, ubuze uNgqongqoshe wezoLimo, amaHlathi nokuDoba, uMnuz Senzeni Zokwana, ukuthi ngabe useyithintile yini iminyango efanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni uphasisa ukusetshenziswa kwensangu ukulapha izifo ezithile.UZokwana uthe bamatasa nezingxoxo ezizoqinisekisa ukutshalwa kwensangu ukuze ilaphe izifo ezithile kulandelwa umthetho.“Umthetho othinta ukusetshenziswa kwensangu ukulapha izifo ubhekelelwe nguMnyango wezeMpilo nowezoBulungiswa ngokomthetho wemithi wango-1965. Siyithintile le minyango nowezoHwebo neziMboni namaphoyisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukutshalwa kwensangu ngeke kuphule imithetho ethile,” kusho uZokwana.Uthe ucwaningo olwenziwayo lokuthi izokwazi yini ukusebenziseka njengomuthi nokuthi izothengwa ngabantu abangaki luhamba kahle.“Njengamanje umnyango wethu nowezempilo umatasa ubheka imithetho yokulawula ukutshalwa kwensangu nemikhiqizo ezokwenziwa ngayo,” kusho uZokwana.Uthe bayitshelile iminyango ethintekayo ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi insangu ibhekwe ngeso lokwelapha. USEKOLUNYE utaku uMnuz Mduduzi Manana osule esikhundleni sokuba yilungu lePhalamende kuleli sonto njengoba amalungu ekomiti ebelizomqondisa ubugwegwe efuna akhokhe izindleko zawo. UManana owayeyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme kodwa wasula ngemuva kokushaya abesifazane endaweni yobumnandi, uzisulele ePhalamende ngoLwesibili wathumela incwadi ehhovisi likaSotswebhu we-ANC izolo emazisa ukuthi useyasula. Izolo amalungu ekomiti lezimilo acele iPhalamende ukuthi liphoqe uManana ukuthi akhokhe izindleko zawo zokusuka lapho abe khona ngoba eze esigungwini sokumqondisa ubugwegwe. Isigungu sokumqondisa ubugwegwe bekufanele sibe izolo kodwa ngenxa yokuthi uye wasula emsebenzini asihlalanga. USihlalo waleli komidi, uMnuz Aumsen Singh, uthe uManana ubazi ukuthi kufanele avele ekomitini lokuqondisa ubugwegwe ngodaba lokushaya abesifazane ngonyaka odlule kodwa wasula emsebenzini. Amanye amalungu ePhalamende athe uManana bekufanele asule ngonyaka odlule emva kokulahlwa yicala lokushaya abesifazane kodwa yena wakhetha ukusula izolo ngaphambi kokuthi aqondiswe ubugwegwe. Amalungu amahlanu ePhalamende aphoqeleke ukuthi asuke ezindaweni ezihlukene aye eCape Town lapho bekuzolalelwa khona udaba lwakhe. Lilodwa ilungu lePhalamende ebeliseKapa, lilinde uManana okunguNksz Liezl van der Merwe we-IFP. USingh usuke eThekwini, uNkk Annelie Lotriet weDA noNkk Sam Matiase we-EFF basuke eBloemfontein baya eKapa. UNkk Rosalia Morutoa we-ANC usuke eGauteng. UMnuz Lemias Mashile we-ANC usuke eMpumalanga ngoba naye ubazi ukuthi kuzoqondiswa uManana ubugwegwe. USingh uthe bazocela usizo lwezomthetho ePhalamende ukuze uManana akhokhe izindleko zabo. Uthe bebephoqelekile ukuthi baye eKapa ngoba bekufanele. "Sicele uSotswebhu we-ANC, uMnuz Jackson Mthembu, ukuthi sibheke icala likaManana ukuze uma sekuqala umsebenzi wePhalamende kungabikho okusiphazamisayo. Asazi ukuthi uManana kungani esule sekusele usuku ukuthi avele ekomitini lethu ngoba kudala aziswa ukuthi uzoqondiswa ubugwegwe," kusho uSingh. Ukusolisa kwalolu daba kuholele ophenyweni olwenziwa amaphoyisa eminyakeni emine edlule kanti abasolwa okunguPillay, abammeli bakhe ababili uMnuz Rodney Reddy noP. Ramjatham, bavele okokuqala enkantolo yamacala athinta imali ngoLwesine oludlule. Babhekene namacala enkohlakalo, ukukokotela kanye nokushushumbisa imali. UMdlovu uvulele uPillay icala ngosizo lommeli obengumakhelwane kaNkk Davies, uMnuz Ferdinand Zondagh kanti njengamanje ungaphansi kohlelo lokuvikelwa kofakazi njengoba esabela impilo yakhe. Lokhu kukhathazeka kwenza ukuthi ngizihlole ukuthi ayikho yini indlela engingaphuma ngayo. Isu elaqhamuka elokuthi ngivule inkampani yami. Ucwaningo engalwenza lwangikhombisa ukuthi uma ngingqongqoza eminyangweni efanele ngizoluthola uxhaso, ekupheleni kwenyanga ngithole imali engcono. Ngaqala ngokuthi ngingene emkhakheni wamathenda,” kusho yena.Ngo-2012 kuya ku-2014 uthe ungene emkhakheni wamathenda wathola umsebenzi wokuthi athengele izibhedlela zaseMpumalanga izingubo zokulala nezingubo ezigqokwa yiziguli.Uqhube wathi ngesikhathi enza lokhu wayefuna izinkampani lapho ezothenga khona bese edayisela umasipala. Wathola ukuthi ayikho inkampani yomuntu wesifazane omnyama angathenga kuyo. Ezikhona wabona ukuthi azikwazi ukukhiqiza umthamo odingekayo uma zithola i-oda elikhulu.“Ngabona ithuba lokuthi ngivule inkampani ngisebenze nabantu besifazane sibe yinkampani ekhiqizela izinkampani izingubo zokusebenza nemifaniswano kanjalo nezingubo zokulala. Ngahambisa umbono wami kwaSAB bawubona uphusile bangixhasa,” kusho yena.Kule nkampani uthe kusebenza abesifazane kuphela bonke baneminyaka engaphansi kuka-35.Nyakenye ungenele umncintiswano wabantu abasha abanamabhizinisi enza kahle ohlelwa yiSAB, waphuma ku-top-21 ezweni lonke.INGAPHAKATHI lendawo ekhiqiza imifaniswano nezimpahla zokusebenza, Ikhethelo Clothing and Textile eseMlaza Isithombe: Sithunyelwe“Ibhizinisi lokukhiqiza impahla ngingene kulona ngo-2017. Nyakenye ngiqokwe ngaba ngomunye wosomabhizinisi abenza kahle ababili. Ukuqokwa kungenze ngabona ukuthi ngempela ngiwusomabhizinisi osenganyukela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngemuva kwalokho ngivakashelwe ngongoti bokukhiqizwa kwezimpahla ezenziwe ngendwangu baseNerthelands bezobona indawo engisebenzela kuyo, baphinde bangicobelela ngolwazi lokukhulisa umkhiqizo wami,” kusho yena.Uthe bamsiza ngokuthi indawo yakhe ayihlele ngendlela ezokwenza ukuthi akhiqize ngendlela eyiyo.Muva nje uthe usebenzisana nenye inkampani ekhiqiza ama-duvet, amashidi nezinye izinto zokulala zikanokusho.“Lezi zimpahla sizokwazi ukuzidayisa emazweni aphesheya. Amakhasimende athenga lezi zimpahla ngabantu abangenqeni ukukhipha imali futhi abangazithandi izinto ezifana nezabanye. Kubo sibala namahhotela aphambili,” kusho yena.
