OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma usazolinda uphenyo lweKhomishana kaJaji Raymond Zondo ngezinsongo zokubulawa abhekene nazo ngaphambi kokuba afake isicelo sokuba kwengezwe ezokuPhepha kuye.Lokhu kuvezwe umkhulumeli wakhe, uMnuz Vukile Mathabela emuva kokuba kube nezinhlangano eziphazamise ukuba kuqiniswe ezokuphepha kuZuma, ummeli wakhe u-Advocate Muzi Sikhakhane nomndeni wakhe uZuma.“UJaji uZondo ukucacisile kwikhomishini yakhe ukuthi lolu daba lwezinsongo zokubulawa ezibhekiswe kuZuma zizophenywa abaphenyi bekhomishini ukuze bathole ukuthi ziqhamukaphi.“Kuyothi uma sebesithulele umbiko bese uMengameli Zuma ethatha isinyathelo. Okwamanje lukhona uhlelo lwamaphoyisa ngokuphepha kukaZuma njengoba amaphoyisa ehlale emqaphile,” kuchaza uMathabela obexoxa neSolezwe. NgeSonto eledlule, inhlangano elwisana nezimpi zamatekisi KwaZulu-Natal okuwuBumbano lokuThula Forum, iphakamise ukuthi kuqiniswe ezokuphepha kuZuma. Ikusho lokhu esitatimendeni sayo emuva kokuba uZuma edalule kwiKhomishini kaZondo ukuthi kukhona abasongela ngokumbulala nomndeni wakhe.Usihlalo woBumbano lokuThula, uMnuz Andile Hlatshwayo, uthe babona kuyisikhathi sokuba uZuma avikelwe ngoba sekuyacaca ukuthi impilo yakhe isengozini.“Ngemuva kwezinkulumo ezethulwe uZuma kuKhomishini yokuLawulwa kombuso yiDlanzana ngoLwesibili, kusicacele thina njengoBumbano ukuthi uyakudinga ukuthola ezokuphepha ezengeziwe kulezi anazo. Yingakho sicela kuMengameli wezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ukuba alubukisise lolu daba ngoba angeke sibe nokuthula uma kubakhona okwehlela uZuma,” kusho uHlatshwayo.Kule khomishini uZuma uveze ukuthi kuye kwafona umuntu ongaziwa kumsizi wakhe obhekene nezindaba zakhe ku-ANC esabisa ngokuthi bazobulala uZuma nomndeni wakhe kanye nommeli wakhe okungu-Advocate Muzi Sikhakhane.Lezi zinsolo uZuma abeziveza bezilandela nezinye azidalule ngoMsombuluko zokuthi kwakunetulo elaphekwa izinhlaka ezithile lokuba asocongwe emcimbini kaKhuzani owawungoMashi eMoses Mabhida Stadium.Inhlangano eyeseka uZuma, okuyi-Radical Economic Transformation (RET) nayo inanele ikhwelo loBumbano yathi ifuna uZuma avikelwe kuphinde kuqiniswe ezokuphepha kwakhe ngoba ayisathembi lutho.UMnuz Nkosentsha Shezi we-RET, uthe bashaqekile ngezinsongo ezidalulwe uZuma kwiKhomishini kaZondo.“Okwamanje asikalibhaleli ihhovisi likaMengameli nelikaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa ukuze bahlinzeke uZuma ngezokuphepha ezengeziwe kodwa sifuna avikelwe manje nomndeni wakhe ngoba basengozini. Empeleni sekuyacaca ukuthi kade uZuma abasengozini kodwa inkinga ukuthi abafisa ukumsoconga bayehluleka ukuthola ithuba elikahle,” kusho uShezi. Uthe uZuma ungubaba we-Radical Economic Transformation abafisa avikelwe ngakho konke ukuze aphephe.Le nhlangano yiyo eqashe amabhasi abethwele abantu abebesuka KwaZulu-Natal beyokweseka uMnuz Jacob Zuma ngesikhathi evela okokuqala ngoMsombuluko kwiKhomishini kaZondo. Okhulumela uMengameli, uNkk Khusela Diko, ucele ukuba athunyelelwe umyalezo ngalolu daba kodwa ugcine engaphendulanga kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.

SIKHULU isililo ngokubulawa kwevolontiya le-ANC laseMfume ebeligqugquzela ukuvota.Kuthiwa uMnuz Nqobizwe Mkhize (46) waseSimahleni, eMfume uhlaselwe abalisa abangaziwa abathathu elele nomkakhe ezintatha kuzosa kube nguMgqibelo. Kuleya ndawo kuphinde kwabulawa abalisa ababili, uMnuz Sibonelo Hlongwane noMnuz Nathi Hlengwa abatholakale bedindilize emgwaqweni buqamama nalapho okuhlala khona uMkhize.Kuthiwa laba balisa bangene batshela umkakhe okhulelwe ukuthi akamboze angababuki base bedubula uMkhize kaningana. Kuthiwa izinhlamvu ezintathu zingene ekhanda.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uCaptain Nqobile Gwala uthe amaphoyisa aphenya amacala amathathu okubulala.“Kukholakala ukuthi kuthe uma kugamanxa ihora lesibili ekuseni kwatheleka abasolwa abathathu abebehlome ngezibhamu, bakhahlela isicabha bangena kwaMkhize bamdubula. Udubuleke amahlandla amaningi kwesingenhla. Isizathu sokubulawa kwakhe asikaziwa,” kusho uCaptain Gwala.Isigameko sesibili kukholakala ukuthi senzeke ngaphambi kwehora lesithathu lapho okuhlaselwe khona uHlongwane noHlengwa abadutshulwe abalisa abangaziwa abebehamba ngemoto. Lesi sigameko senzeke emuva kokubulawa kukaMkhize.UCaptain Gwala uthe laba balisa bashonele endaweni yesigameko. Uthe isizathu sokubulawa kwabo asikaziwa.Ikhansela lakuleya ndawo, uMnuz Ayanda Ndlovu, lichaze uMkhize njengomuntu obezinikele emsebenzini weqembu nasekusizeni umphakathi. Uthe nguye obenikwe umsebenzi wokugqugquzela abantu ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota.“Ubengumuntu obethandwa kakhulu wumphakathi. Silahlekelwe njengeqembu nomphakathi ngoba ubezinikele futhi esebenzisa ngisho imali yakhe ukwenza imisebenzi yeqembu. Kubuhlungu kakhulu okwenzekile. Sishaqekile nangokubulawa kukaHlongwane noHlengwa abatholakale befile. Sinxusa noma ubani ongaba nolwazi ukuthi asebenzisane namaphoyisa ukuze kutholakale izigilamkhuba,” kusho uNdlovu.UNdlovu uthe inkosikazi kaMkhize okulindeleke ukuthi ibelethe kule nyanga isesimeni esingesihle ngokomphefumulo ngenxa yokubulawa komyeni wayo ibhekile.UMxhumanisi wekomiti lesikhashana le-ANC KwaZulu-Natal Mnuz Sihle Zikalala uthe bashaqekile ngesigameko esenzeke kuleya ndawo. Uthe banethemba lokuthi amaphoyisa azosebenza kanzima ukuthola abathintakayo.Izolo uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele uye kuleya ndawo eyokhuluma nomphakathi. UCele uthembise amalungu omphakathi ukuthi amaphoyisa azophenya ngesigameko sokubulawa kwalaba bobathathu. Uqhube wathi amaphoyisa azophenya nangamacala osekunesikhathi engaphothulwa. Elinye lalamacala uthe ngelokubulawa kowayengunozinti wePirates neqembu lesizwe, uSenzo Meyiwa, elisahlalise kabuhlungu izihlobo zakhe nomphakathiwonkana.“Sicele umphakathi ukuthi usebenzisane namaphoyisa uphinde ubike amaphoyisa angenzi kahle kodwa uthi uwabika nawo ube ukhumbula ukuthi akhona amaphoyisa enza kahle nokufanele usebenzisane nawo,” kusho uCele.Uthe uxoxe nenkosi yendawo wathola ukuthi lesi sigameko kungenzeka ukuthi asihlobene nezepolitiki.Noma kunjalo uCele unxuse amaphoyisa ukuthi asebenze kanzima ukuthola abenzi bobubi ngisho kungathiwa abantu abaphezulu.

text: I-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal isiphumele obala yathi ifuna uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli ukuthi akhethwe njengoNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal engqungqutheleni yesifundazwe okulindeleke ukuthi isingathwe ungakapheli uJulayi.Ekhuluma emcimbini wokusonga inyanga yabantu abasha ehholo lomphakathi iMichael Gwala eNtshangwe, uMgcinimafa we-ANCYL uMnuz Thobelani Ncampalala, uthe bafuna ukuthi abantu abasha bangene ezinhlakeni ze-ANC ukuze nabo bahlale etafuleni uma sekuthathwa izinqumo.“Yingakho siyi-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal sithi sifuna uqabane uMdumiseni Ntuli akhethwe njengoNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, asididekile ngalokho esikushoyo, uMdumiseni uke wahola i-ANCYL eKZN futhi uyiqabane ekade lalinethwa zimvula uphinde abeyisibonelo kithina, sifuna ukuba yisifundazwe sokuqala lapho uNobhala we-ANC esifundazweni kungumuntu omusha,” kusho uNcampalala.Uthe i-ANC eKZN idinga umuntu onjengoNtuli kwesikanobhala njengoba isemkhankasweni wokuqeda indaba yezinhlangothi.NoSihlalo we-ANCYL eThekwini uMnuz Thembo Ntuli uhambe emazwini kaNcampalala wathi bangajabula ukubona uNtuli engunobhala wenhlangano esifundazweni.UNtuli uphakanyiselwa esikhundleni obekuhleli kuso uMnuz Super Zuma. Nakuba liphakanyiswa igama likaNtuli kodwa akhona amanye amaqabane afuna kubuye uZuma.UNcampalala uqhube wathi enye into abafuna ukuyibona ukuthi uNobhala-jikelele we-ANCYL, uMnuz Njabulo Nzuza, akhethwe njengelungu lesigungu esihola isifundazwe.“Sifuna ukuthi uNzuza uma esebuya eLuthuli House eseqede ihlandla lakhe abuye KwaZulu-Natal azoba essigungwini esibhekelele ukusebenza kwesifundazwe, iProvincial Working Committee,” kusho uNcampalala. Uthe uNzuza usesebenze ezinhlakeni ezahlukene enhlanganweni waze wafika eLuthuli House.“Omunye umholi esifuna akhethelwe esigungwini esihola inhlangano nguSihlalo wethu esifundazweni uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu,” kusho uNcampalala.Uthe njengobuholi besifundazwe baphinde bavumelana ngokuthi baseke unobhala wabo uMnuz Thanduxolo Sabelo kwesikamengameli we-ANCYL njengoba kuyiwa engqungqutheleni ngoSepthemba.Uthe bafuna ukubona abantu abasha babambe iqhaza kuyo yonke imikhakha kubalwa ekuholeni nakwezomnotho.Isolezwe lizamile ukuxhumana noMdumiseni Ntuli ngenhloso yokuthola ukuthi uzamukela kanjani izindaba zokwesekwa wuphiko lwentsha kodwa ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa.

Uveze nokuthi kumele ngisho engekho onomdlavuza abantu bazijwayeze ukuhlolelwa ama-genes ukuze babone uma kukhona osengcupheni yokuwuthola.Kulo mcimbi kuvele ukuthi imali isayinkinga kakhulu kwabanomdlavuza ngoba ukwelashwa kumba eqolo. text: UVALE amasango kamasipala, izolo umphakathi waseMooi River othi awusayifuni imeya yawo othi ayizi uma uyibizela emihlanganweni kodwa iphendula ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Lo mphakathi obukhala ngokuthi iMeya kaMasipala iMpofana, uMnuz Xolani Duma iqasha abangani bayo ezikhaleni zemisebenzi ezikhangisiwe, uthi kunomyalezo osabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana okuthiwa ubhalwe ngothile obebonga umsebenzi ekubeni umphakathi usaqhubeka nokuletha ama-CV awo ezikhaleni ezingu-13 zamaGeneral Worker ezikhangisiwe kodwa kube usuku lokuvalwa kokufakwa kwezicelo kungoLwesithathu.Umphakathi okuthiwa ubuholwa yintsha kuthiwa ugasele kwamasipala ngoLwesibili wavala amasango uthi ufuna ukuthi imeya izophendula ngalokhu okubone kuFacebook, iphinde ichaze ukuthi yini eyenze ukuthi lezi zikhala zincishiswe ngoba phambilini bezingu-50. Abantu bathi kwasha amahhovisi akwandabazabantu kulo masipala abantu sebezifakile izicelo zomsebenzi, kwase kuthiwa zizobuye zivulwe kabusha kodwa sezibuya sezingaphansi kwesibalo esasikhishwe.Abasolwa ngokuthi bahola lo mkhankaso wokuvala umasipala baboshiwe ngalo uLwesibili ntambama besolwa ngokulimaza impahla kamasipala, badedelwa ngesexwayiso izoloUMYALEZO okuthiwa ubuthunyelelwe imeya kaMasipala waseMpofana osatshalaliswe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, oholele ekutheni umphakathi uvale umasipalaAbangaboshwanga babuyele kuwo lo masipala ekuseni, izolo baphinde bavala umasipala.Elinye ilunga lomphakathi elingathandanga ukudalulwa lithe: “Zishonephi izikhala ezingu-37, njengoba sekukhangiswe ezingu-13? Uneminyaka emithathu ehleli esihlalweni sobumeya kodwa akezi emhlanganweni uma simbiza, ugijima ayobhala kuFacebook.”UDuma akatholakalanga ocingweni lwakhe kodwa kwi-akhawunti kaFacebook okuthiwa eyakhe uphendule wathi: “Izindaba ezingamampunge ziholele ebugebengwini. Umasipala uvulele amacala izigebengu ezingu-17, ezidabule ama-CV abantu emahhovisi alo mkhandlu.”Uqhuba athi uyazi ukuthi lo mkhankaso uqhutshwa ngabantu ababehola imashi eyayithi akaphume esikhundleni nyakenye. Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi ungadidiswa ngabantu abanezinhloso zezepolitiki.Umthombo waleli phephandaba uthe umphakathi awuzange ungene kwamasipala, ubume ngaphandle futhi ubungenalo udlame, kodwa kubonakale imeya isifaka izithombe zama-CV kuFacebook, agcwele phansi ethi kwenziwe ngabebevale umasipala.UNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Zulu okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal uthe abakukhuthazi ukuthi kuqashwe ngobungani. “Ukuvala amasango kamasipala ngento esabalele kuFacebook nakho kuyiphutha. Siyakuphenya ukuthi ngabe kukhona yini asebeqashiwe ekubeni lungakafiki usuku oluwumnqamulajuqu kodwa sithi umphakathi awungathathi izinqumo ngezinto ezisatshalaliswa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.”

Kuthiwa amadoda akhombe abagilwa ngesibhamu abaphoqa ukuthi bangene ebhuthini yemoto.Isitatimende samaphoyisa siveza ukuthi abagilwa bathathwe bayiswa kwenye indawo egcina amaloli emgwaqweni uPeters lapho amadoda efike afuna uR50 000 ngodli. text: OMUNYE wabaqokwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuheha abatshali bezimali uthi abantu kumele babekezele ngoba kusazothatha isikhathi ukuguqula isimo sezwe.UNksz Phumzile Langeni, oyiPresidential Investor Emissary, ubekhuluma nosomabhizinisi izolo esithangamini senhlangano iBusiness Leadership South Africa (BLSA) eThekwini. Uqokwe ngo-Ephreli nabanye abathathu ukuthi bazame izindlela zokungenisa ezweni li * $1 billion eminyakeni eyisihlanu. Utshele osomabhizinisi ukuthi umkhankaso kamengameli obizwa ngeThuma Mina, ngeke uphumelele uma engalekelelwa.Uvumile ukuthi isimo ezweni simanzonzo kuzo zonke izinhlangothi, ikakhulukazi kwezomnotho.“Abantu balahlekelwe yithemba, kubonakala ngokwanda kwemibhikisho nsuku zonke. Awulula umsebenzi esinikwe wona kodwa okuhle wukuthi umengameli uhambe phambili wadlulisa umyalezo. Kuzothatha isikhathi ukuthola izindlela zokuheha abatshali bezimali nokudayisa kahle izwe lethu. Emazweni angaphandle uma ufika khona babuza ngesimo sezepolitiki esingesihle nenkohlakalo. Lezi ngezinye izinto ezixosha abatshali bezimali,” kusho uNksz Langeni.Yize ethe kuzothatha isikhathi ukulungisa isimo, uNksz Langeni uthe kukhona okuthembisayo osekwenzekile selokhu kuthathe umengameli omusha. Phakathi kwakho ubale ukuqokwa kukandunankulu omusha eNorth West emuva kwezinkinga nokungalawuleki kwesifundazwe. Unxuse osomabhizinisi ukuthi basizane nohulumeni ukushintsha isimo, wathembisa ukuthi bazohlangana nabo ezifundazweni zonke ukuzwa umbono wabo. Ugcizelele nokuthi balekelele ukudala amathuba omsebenzi ngoba uhulumeni ngeke akwazi eyedwa.UMnuz Bonang Mohale oyisikhulu seBLSA, uthe osomabhizinisi bahlalelwe wumsebenzi omkhulu wokubuyisa isithunzi sezwe. Uthe inkinga yamazwe ase-Afrika akukona ukuthi ahlwempu kodwa ukuthi awalawulwa ngendlela efanele.“Inkinga yisekutheni sikhetha abaholi abangafanelekile kodwa sinayo ingcebo. Umsebenzi esibhekene nawo manje wukubheka ukuthi silwa kanjani nokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana. Kumele sibheke nokuthi sizozinciphisa kanjani izindleko zikahulumeni nengqalasizinda ebizayo engadingeki,” kusho uMohale.Uthe osomabhizinisi kumele babe phambili ekusizeni umengameli emkhankasweni wokuthunywa. Njengoba bezohambela zonke izifundazwe bebonisana noso­mabhizinisi, kumele basho ukuthi kungani bengafuni ukutshala izimali kuleli. Abanye osomabhizinisi izolo bakhale ngezinga lokwehla kwemfundo abathe linomthelela ekungaqashweni kwentsha.

UNGQONGQOSHE wezeMpilo kuleli, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi noNgqongqoshe walo mnyango KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, banelisekile ngokusebenza kwenkampani ekhiqiza amakhondomu, eseDube Trade Port.Ngemuva kokuvalwa kwengqungquthela ebidingida izinto ezithinta isifo sofuba, eThekwini, ngesonto eledlule uDhlomo noMotsoaledi bavakashele isikhungo esakhiwe ngokusebenzisana nenkampani yase-United States, iHBM neSA Potection Services. Lesi sikhungo sibizwa ngokuthi iHBM-SA.Lesi sikhungo sikhiqiza amakhondomu angu-700 000 ngosuku. Lawa makhondomu aphakelwa ezikhungweni zezempilo zakuleli, amanye adayiswe emazweni angaphandle. Kulindeleke ukuthi le nkampani yenyuse isibalo somkhiqizo wayo kungekudala njengoba iqhubeka nokunweba ibhilidi esebenzela kulo.Amakhondomu akhiqizwa kulesi sikhungo, iMax Condoms, angene esikhundleni seChoice azosatshalaliswa ezikhungweni zikahulumeni.Le nkampani, eyakhiwe ngoR150 million, iqashe abantu abangu-150 bendawo. Ngaphambi kokuthi kusungulwe le nkampani, uMnyango wezeMpilo bewuwathenga eChina amakhondomu asatshalaliswa ezikhungweni zikahulumeni. Ngemuva kokuthi uhulumeni esungule uphiko oluyisipesheli lokuthuthukiswa komnotho, eDube Trade Port, uthathe isinqumo sokuthi le nkampani ibe kulesi sikhungo esenzelwe ukuthi kube lula ukuthi kuthunyelwe izimpahla kwamanye amazwe.UDkt Dhlomo uthe: “Ungqongqoshe kumjabulisile akubone kulesi sikhungo waze wethembisa ukuthi uzobuya maduze azosivula ngokusemthethweni. Okumjabulise kakhulu ukuthi lesi sikhungo singakwazi ukukhiqiza amakhondomu angu-1.4 million ngosuku. Thina kulesi sifundazwe sishaye izinyoni ezimbili ngetshe elilodwa ngokuvulwa kwalesi sikhungo esifundazweni sethu, ukuba khona kwaso kusho ukuthi ngeke sishodelwe ngamakhondomu njengoba ezobe ekhiqizwa lapha. Kuzoba lula ukuthi athunyelwe ezikhungweni zezempilo kulesi sifundazwe,” usho kanje.Amakhondomu athathwa njengesivikeli esiphephile esingavikela ukukhulelwa okungadingekile nokudluliselana ngezifo socansi.Izibalo zezempilo kuleli zikhombisa ukuthi amantombazane aneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 no-24 kunamathuba amaningi okuthi athole igciwane lengculazi nokuthi akhulelwe engahlelile. Lokhu kunomthelelela wokuthi kube nabafundi abaningi abaphume esikoleni bengaziphothulile izifundo zabo ezikoleni zamabanga aphezulu nasezikhungweni zezemfundo eziphakeme.UDhlomo uthe uhulumeli usaqhubeka nokugqugquzela ukuthi abantu basebenzise uhlelo lokuzivikela oluhlanganisa izindlela ezembili ngesikhathi esisodwa, iDual Protection. Abesilisa basokwe kodwa baqhubeke basebenzise amakhondomu, njalo uma beya ocasini, abesifazane basebenzise amaphilisi noma umjovo wokuhlela nekhondomu, njalo uma beya ocansini.

KUSUKELA eminyakeni edlule kuze kube yimanje kuvela abaculi bekhala ngokuthi umculi othile untshontshe ingoma yakhe.Muva nje, kwiSolezwe kubhalwe ngoMalibongwe Mhlauli osola uMlindo The Vocalist ngokweba ingoma yakhe ethi Usukulude. Lolu daba seluphenduke inkombankombane njengoba uMalibongwe ethi wabhala ingoma esaphethe iqembu loMlindo iWhite Bread. Ngakolunye uhlangothi uMlindo uthi ingoma eyakhe inkinga ukuthi izingoma akazibhali, ngakho kungaqhamuka noma wubani athi umculo wakhe ngowakhe. Kumanje udaba lusezithebeni zabameli kwazise uMalibongwe ufuna uR500 000.Olunye kube wudaba lomculi wegqom’ osafufusa uNolwazi “Lwazi M” Mdluli nomculi wekwaito uTipcee.ULwazi M usola uTipcee ngokuthatha izinhlamvu zengoma yakhe azifake kweyakhe.ULwazi M usola ukuthi uTipcee izinhlamvu wazithatha benandisa emcimbini ndawonye oPhongolo.“Kulo mcimbi esasiqashwe kuwo uTipcee wangena kuqala mina ngalandela ngemuva kwakhe. Ngiyasola ukuthi wachazeka ngengoma yami wabe esentshontsha ulayini othi bayale bayale nangu uLwazi M. Engomeni yakhe ayiphushayo ezophuma kwi-albhamu yakhe, iThe Snyper ayikhiphe ngoNovemba 1, uthi yena ngiyale ngiyale nanguTipcee girl,” ucashunwe esho kanje.Ethintwa uTipcee uziphikile lezi zinsolo usole uLwazi M ngokufuna ukuduma ngaye.“Angimazi nokuthi ungubani lo sisi nokuthi ucula muphi umculo. Ufuna ukuduma ngegama lami. Emcimbini wasoPhongolo ngazifikela ekuseni sengizovala umcimbi, angikhumbuli ngimbona,” kusho uTipcee.Uthe lo mcimbi ufike esakade aqeda ukuqopha i-albhamu yakhe, ngakho akho okuzophazamisa ukuphuma kwayo ngo-Novemba 1.Imenenja jikelele yakwaSamro, uJacqui Mabuza, ithe kubalulekile ukuthi abaculi babhalise umsebenzi wabo nabo ukuze bezolandelela ukusebenza kwazo ezindaweni ezinjengasemsakazweni nakwithelevishini futhi benze isiqiniseko sokuthi bayakhokha, imali bayidlulisa kumaciko.Uthe uma kunombango bayakwazi ukungenelela ngokuthi bamise inkokhelo ebitholwa wumculi osolwayo.“Sigqugquzela ukuthi kuxoxiswane,” kusho uJacqui.Uthe uma lokho kuhluleka bamema bonke abathintekayo ukuthi babe nomhlangano nemenenja yabo ngenhloso yokuthola isisombululo.“Uma kuhluleka kuba nesigcawu esihlelwa yiSamro nomxazululi ongummeli ogxile kwi-intellectual property ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo.”Uthe iSamro ibe isiyenza okunqunywe ngumxazululi.UJacqui uthe ababhali bezingoma nabaqambi bazo kumele babhalise mahhala kubo. Amafomu akwi-website yabo noma emahhovisi aseThekwini, eGoli naseKapa.“Kumahhala kodwa iSamro ikhona imali eyithathayo uma usuqalile ukuthola inkokhelo ngomsebenzi esiwubhekelele.”Umengameli womfelandawonye wezinyunyana zamaciko, iCultural and Creative Industries Federation of South Africa, uJoy Mbewana, uthe abaculi abayeke ukuhamba benikeza abanye izingoma bengazibhalisile.“Ubezwa bethi ngicela ungilalele, ungifake. Isikhathi esiningi kuba yiciko elingaziwa okugcina kuba sengathi linamanga,” kusho uJoy.Uthe amaciko kumele azinike isikhathi afunde kabanzi ngomkhakha angena kuwo.“Kukhona abantu abanjengoKwaZulu-Natal United Music Industry Association abahlela izigcawu zokucobelelana ngolwazi futhi amaciko awajoyine izinyunyana ngoba kubalulekile ukuba nekhaya,” kuphetha uJoy.

text: INYUNYANA iNational Education, Health and Allied Workers’ Union (Nehawu), ithi zisaqhubeka iziteleka emanyuvesi ahlukene kuleli, ezinye eziqale ngeledlule.INehawu ithumele isitatimende kwabezindaba izolo icacisa ngokwenzeka e-Unisa, DUT, Wits nase-University of Pretoria. Esitatimende kuthiwa abasebenzi base-Unisa abangaphansi kwale nyunyana abasebenzi kuzo zonke izikhungo zenyuvesi kuleli. Lokhu kudalwe ukuthi abaphathi benyuvesi banqume ukuhoxa ezingxoxweni baya enkantolo yabasebenzi ngoba befuna ukuthi isiteleka esiqale ngeledlule sithathwe njengesingekho emthethweni kodwa bahluleka. Isitatimende siveza ukuthi izimfuno zisamile njengoba befuna ukunyuselwa umholo ngo-10% kuzo zonke izigaba. Bafuna kuqashwe ngokugcwele abasebenzi betoho abasemkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe okuthiwa sebebe yitoho iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-15. Le nyunyana ithi i-Unisa icabanga ukuthi ingaphezulu komthetho njengoba ingafuni ukuhlonipha iLabour Relations Act ngokuthi ibaqashe ngokugcwele yize benazo iziqu.Le nyunyana isicele iCCMA ukuthi izame ukulekelela izinhlaka ezithintekayo ukuthi zifinyelele esivumelwaneni ukuze kuqhubeke ukubhaliswa kwabafundi. Inyunyana inxuse amalungu ayo ukuthi angadidiseki, akaqhubeke nesiteleka kuze kube izimfuno zawo ziyabhekelwa.E-DUT nakhona le nyunyana ithe sisazoqhubeka isiteleka kuzo zonke izikhungo njengoba kungakafinyelelwa esivumelwaneni. Le nyunyana isikhabe ngazo zombili isiphakamiso somqashi sika-6%. Isamile ekutheni ifuna kunyuswe ngo-10%, kunyuswe nomhlomulo wezindlu ngoR400 nebhonasi kaR9 000.EWits le nyunyana iqale emasontweni amabili ukuthi njalo ngesikhathi sesidlo sasemini kube nombhikisho ngoba ifuna umqashi ukuthi abuyele etafuleni lezingxoxo. Le nyunyana ithe lesi siteleka sizoba sikhulu namuhla. Ifuna umqashi anyuse umholo ngo 8%, imali ye-medical aid ngo-1%, ukubuyiswa kwemihlomulo yemali kulabo asebesebenze isikhathi eside. Inyunyana ithi abasebenzi base-University of Pretoria bafuna ukunyuselwa umholo ngo-9.5% kanti umqashi uthi uno-6%.

Umkamufi uthi wahamba kwakhe ngoJanuwari nezingane zakhe ezimbili waya eGoli.Uthi wayeyophumuza ikhanda ngoba umufi ubemhlukumeza emshaya ngesibhamu.Uveze ukuthi wamazisa u-anti wakhe wasemzini ngokuhlukumezeka kwakhe kodwa waqhubeka nokumhlukumeza.NgokukaNksz Mchunu, ngesikhathi eyopholisa ikhanda eGoli, wayezitshela ukuthi uzoshintsha umyeni wakhe, azisole kodwa lutho.Eseshonile umyeni wakhe uthi ngoLwesibili yena nodadewabo baya kobona emzini, waxoshwa.Uthi isono sakhe esiholele ekutheni axoshwe, wukuthi uveze iqiniso ngomyeni wakhe ukuthi akazalwa kwaNgubane.“Umyeni wami esaphila wacela ukuthi uma eseshonile akothintwa abantu bakwaMbatha, okuyisibongo sakhe sangempela. Badinwe bagana unwabu abakwaNgubane ngibatshela lokhu, bangixosha.“Iningi labo angilazi, bengiqala ukulibona selokhu ngagana kulo muzi,” kusho uNksz Mchunu.Ukhale nangokuthi usephucwa nendodakazi yakhe endala eyahamba ngonyaka odlule iyofunda uGrade 8 ku-anti wayo.“Ayisangifuni nalapho ngihambe khona. Uma ngiqhamuka iyabaleka, ize yajahwa kodwa yangavuma ukuza kimina.“Asazi nokuthi sizoya kanjani emngcwabeni. Sizibona singaphephile uma siya,” esho ekhihla isililo. UMnuz Lucky Ngubane (68) othe unguyise kamufi, uthe basashaqekile ngalesi sigameko futhi akuvumi ngisho akhulume.Uthe umakoti abamxoshanga kodwa uzihambele ngoba bebefuna ukwazi ukuthi ubekuphi ngesikhathi indodana yakhe izibulala.Uthe yena ubazi ukuthiumufi uganiwe. Umngani kamufi ocele ukuthi angadalulwa, uthe umufi ubehlala ekhala ngokuthi umoya wakhe ukhubekile ngokuhamba kwenkosikazi yakhe.Uthi ubesesaba nokuphumela emphakathini, ebona sengathi abantu bayamhleka futhi nemfuyo yakhe izolahleka njengoba naye engahlali ekhaya ehlala emsebenzini.Uqhube wathi umufi wafika ngoLwesihlanu ecele izinsuku ezimbili emsebenzini.Uthi ngoMgqibelo wazivalela endlini belokhu bemduduza.Wagcina ukuxoxa naye ngeSonto, kwathi ngoMsombuluko ngezikhathi zamadina, wayombheka, wamemeza, wangasabela.Uveze ukuthi wazama ukuvula umnyango wamfica esebanda, enenxeba enhliziyweni negazi selomile, kukhona incwadi eceleni kwakhe, echazayo ukuthi kungani ezibulele.Umndeni wakwaMbatha uthe umufi ubeyindodana yawo, wahlatshelwa nembuzi engeniswa ngokusemthethweni kodwa akukho abangakwenza uma abakwaNgubane bethi bazomngcwaba.Bathe umakoti nguyena ozothatha isinqumo sokuthi uzoqhubeka nasiphi isibongo.

Lokhu kusanda kuvela engqungqutheleni eyaziwa nge-Abortion and Reproductive Justice: The Unfinished Revolution III ebikuleli ebidingida izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo abantu besifazane uma bezama ukuyothola izinhlelo zokuhushula izisu nokunye.Umbiko we-Amnesty International wango-2017 usanda kuveza ukuthi yize sekuneminyaka engu-21 kwaphasiswa umthetho ovumela abesifazane ukuthi bazithathele bona isinqumo sokuhushula izisu kodwa ziseziningi izinkinga.Ngokusho kwalo mbiko, zingaphansi kuka-7% izikhungo zezempilo zikahulumeni ezihlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuhushula izisu ezikhungweni ezingu-3 880.Lesi sibalo singaphansi kakhulu kunesibalo sezikhungo ezingu-505 uhulumeni ahlele ukuthi zenze lo msebenzi eNingizimu Afrika.Yize ukuhushulwa kwezisu kusemthethweni kuleli, kukholakala ukuthi izigameko eziphakathi kuka-52% kuya ku-58% zenziwa ezikhungweni ezingekho emthethweni.Ingqungquthela ebingesonto eledlule e-Eastern Cape, obekukhona kuyona abantu abalinganiselwa ku-285 basemazweni angu-26 emhlabeni wonke, ilandela eyayiseCanada ngo-2014.Imibiko yakamuva yoMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal ikuvezile ukuthi abantu besifazane bagcina benezinkinga ngenxa yokuhushula izisu ezikhungweni ezihushula izisu ngokungemthetho.Lokhu kugcina kuholele ekutheni abantu besifazane babe nezinkinga ezehlukene okubalwa kuzo ukulimala kwesibeletho, ukuphuphuma kwezisu nokunye.Umbiko wakuleli weSaving Mothers wango-2012 uveze ukuthi abantu besifazane abangu-186 abaphuphunyelwe yizisu balinyalelwa nayizibeletho ezikhugweni zikahulumeni.UMnuz Jacques van Zuydam, ongumqondisi jikelele wezokuthuthukiswa kwabantu kuMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi kuzwelonke uthe kubajabulisile ukuba yingxenye yengqungquthela. Uthe ngesikhathi bebheka izinhlelo ezifakwe emuva kwengqungquthela i-International Conference on Population and Development Programme of Action ebiseNingizimu Afrika ngo-2014 bathole ukuthi ziningi izingqinamba ezikhona kuleli okufanele babhekane nazo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo abantu okuhlela aba yinto ekhona ngempela (awagcini ngokubhalwa phansi).“Izinkinga zokungalingani kwabantu ngokobulili, ngokwezezimali nangokwendlela umphakathi oyiyona ziyaqhubeka nokucindezela amalungelo okuhlela abantu besifazne. Ngo-2015 iKhabhinethi yaseNingizimu Afrika yanquma ukuthi amalungelo abesifazane okuhlela abe kulawo amqoka emigomeni yakuleli,” kusho uVan Zuydam.Uthe la malungelo ayehlanganisa namalungelo entsha okuhlela nokusungulwa kwemithetho ezosiza ekutheni amalungelo afezwe ngendlela kuzo zonke izindawo.Ingqungquthela beyihlelwe yizinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa kuzona uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi kuzwelonke, uphiko olwaziwa ngeCritical Studies in Sexualities and Reproduction Research Programme olusesikhungweni semfundo ephakeme iRhodes University nabanye.USolwazi Cathi Albertyn ongusolwazi kwezomthetho esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme i-University of the Witwatersrand uthe imithetho ehambisana nokuhlela ihambisana nokuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo zokuhlela.“Abantu besifazane bayadinga ukuthi banikwe indawo yabo emphakathini nakwezezimali nasekutheni bazikhethele izinhlelo zokuhlela. Abesifazane badinga ukunikwa inkululeko yokuthi bazikhethele ngabakwenza emizimbeni yabo,” kusho uSolwazi Albertyn.Ngo-2015 iKhabhinethi yaphasisa uhlelo olubhekele izinhlelo ezithinta amalungelo okuhlela ezibandakanya intsha, iNational Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Healthand Rights Framework Strategy (2014-2019).UVan Zuydam uthe uhulumeni uzimisele ngokuqhubeka nokulwa le mpi nokusabalalisa ivangeli lokulwela amalungelo abantu besifazane okubalwa kuwo amalungelo okuhlela nakwamanye amazwe.Uthe bazimisele ukwenza konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo abesifazane okuhlela ayahloniswa.

UZILENGISILE umfundi wesilisa okuthiwa ubezama ukuqabula omunye umfundi wesifazane abafunda naye ekilasini, wazama nokumdlwengula.Kubikwa ukuthi uNkosinathi Thusi (17) obekade enza uGrade 9 e-Allenridge Secondary eTembisa, uzame ukuqabula omunye umfundi wesifazane abafunda naye, umphathi wesikole wamsola ngokuthi udlwengulile, okuyinto okubikwa ukuthi iholele ekutheni umfundi osolwayo agcine esezibulele.Uyise walo mfundi ufuna izimpendulo ngokuzilengisa kwengane yakhe njengoba ethi isikole asifuni ukuphumela obala ngokwenzekile.Ngokusho kukayise kaNkosinathi, uMnuz Richard Thusi, indodana yakhe izilengisele kwenye indlu kwakhe ngentambo eyibophele emapulangweni asophahleni lwendlu ebingakaqedwa ukufulelwa.Ngokusho kukaThusi, bathole emuva kokuzilengisa kwendodana yakhe ukuthi kunencwadi eyayiyinikezwe esikoleni, yokuthi ibuye nomzali njengoba isolwa ngokuqabula omunye umfundi nangokumdlwengula.Kule ncwadi ebukeka eyifomu, kubhalwe ukuthi ‘ukuhlukumeza ngokocansi’, nokuthi ‘ukudlwengula’.Kuphinde kwabhalwa ukuthi lo mfundi uzame ukuphoqa ukuthi agibele phezu kwalo mfundi, okuyinto okuthiwa ubeseyenza okwesibili.UThusi uthe bathole le mininingwane emuva kokuthi indodana yakhe isizilengisile, ukuthi kunencwadi ebinikezwe yona nguthishanhloko walesi sikole, echaza ngesenzo okuthiwa isenzile.Ngaphandle kwencwadi ebivela esikoleni etholakale ezincwadini zendodana yakhe, uthe uphinde wathola enye incwadi ebhalwe yashiywa yindodana yakhe ngokuzibulala kwayo.“Uthishanhloko uvumile ukuthi nguyena owanika uNkosinathi incwadi. Okungixakayo wukuthi ayisayiniwe futhi ayinaso isigxivizo sesikole,” kusho uThusi.Uthe uma ebuza uthishanhloko ngalokhu akayitholi impendulo ecacile.“Ngiphinde ngabuza omunye wothisha, wangitshela ukuthi akaboni ukuthi wayengakwenza kanjani ukuzama ukuqabula omunye umfundi aphinde agibele phezu kwakhe ekubeni yena wayekhona ekilasini,” kuchaza uThusi.NgokukaThusi, akekho okhuluma into ezwakalayo nebambekayo kulesi sikole uma ebuza ngalolu daba.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo eGauteng uMnuz Steve Mabona, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi lolu daba bayalwazi.“Abahloli yibona abaphenya lolu daba futhi bayaxhumana nomndeni kamufi ukuze kucace ngokwenzekile,” kusho uMabona.Uthe umphumela wophenyo yiwona ozokusho ukuthi yisiphi isinyathelo okumele basithathe, wakucacisa ukuthi ophule inqubomgomo yokusebenza komthetho olawula ezemfundo, bazobhekana naye ngqo.“Ngeke sikubekezelele ukungaziphathi kahle ezikoleni”.Uthe bayazwelana nomndeni ngokwenzekile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseGauteng, uCaptain Mavela Masondo, uthe amaphoyisa akule ndawo aphenya ngokufa komfundi.“Sisazolindela kuqala umphumela wokuhlinzwa kwesidumbu ukuze sithole ukuthi ngempela kwenzekeni,” kusho uMasondo.

Singabantwana baseMabovini sathatha incwadi eyabhalwa yisizwe yokungayethembi inkosi saze sacela owabe engumengameli ngo-2014 ukuba asitholele uNgqongqoshe uNomusa Dube-Ncube nebala sahlangana naye eThekwini. Wabe esethumela ithimba labameli kwathi ngomhla ka 23 ngoDisemba 2014 kwafika ithimba lakwaCogta laba nomhlangano nathi laphinde laba nomunye eceleni neqeqebana lenkosi basitshela izinto ezehlukene. Kwaze kwakhuza omunye wabo wathi akaxolise owayesho lokho kwasibonisa ngokusobala ukuthi umnyango uchemile. Ngo-2004 mhla ka-29 kuJanuwari owayengumengameli uMnuz Thabo Mbeki wayevakashele eMsinga eTugela Ferry ngambhalela incwadi ngimazisa ngobuqili bukaCogta. Ayikho imali yamaholo. Iminyango kuzomele ifune imali ngaphakathi ukuze ikhokhele abasebenzi. Uhulumeni akanalo uhlelo lokwehlisa ikhabhinethi eyanda njalo nokulawula izinkampani ezingaphansi kwakhe.”Uthe bamshayela ihlombe ngesimemezelo asenzile sokuthi ngokuvalwa kwezikhala kwezempilo kodwa besifuna ukuzwa ngendaba yamaphoyisa abalelwa ku-56 000 azinze emahhovisi engabe atshalwa ensimini.Ukhale kakhulu ngokungavalwa kwezikhala zothisha, abahlengikazi, ojele, amaphoyisa nodokotela.UNobhala jikelele weSouth African Federation of Trade Unions (Saftu) uMnuz Zwelinzima Vavi, uxwayise uMboweni ngokuthi bazolwa naye uma ediliza abasebenzi.Uthe kumele ehlise ikhabhinethi kungadlalwa ngabasebenzi abazikhandlayo besebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima.Uqhube wathi agcwele amakilasi, amaphoyisa ayashoda nokutih akumele kwehliswe isibalo sojele.Esithangamini sabezindaba ngaphambi kwesabelo sezimali uMboweni uthe kumele ikhabhinethi ingabi nongqongqoshe abangaphezulu kuka-25 ngoba akuwakhi umqondo.Uthe akuwakhi umqondo ngakwezimali ukuthi kube nongqongqoshe abangu-35, ababa namaphini abo okusho ukuthi ongqongqoshe bangu-70.

UMasina obekhuluma nesiteshi somsakazo iSAfm izolo, uyazichitha izinsolo zethenda kaR1.9bn. UMasina usola ukuthi kunetulo lokumsusa esikhundleni. Uthe kunemiyalezo esabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuthiwa kumele asule. Uveze ukuthi akukho okungahambanga kahle ngesikhathi kukhishwa le thenda. Uthe kwayona ithenda yakhishwa engakangeni esikhundeni ngo-Agasti 2016. "UMasipala wethu ungomunye wabenza kahle kakhulu ngokusebenza nokuyisa intuthuko emphakathini. Angisatshiswa wukuthi abantu bathini futhi ngeke ngisuke esikhundleni. Alikho iphutha elenzekile kodwa kwalandelwa yonke imigomo ngokukhishwa kwethenda," kuchaza uMasina. Uthe uMasipala wakhe usukhiphe amathoyilethi angu-39 000 kubahlali basemjondolo, okuyisibalo esinyuke kakhulu sisuka ku-9 000 ngo-2014. Ecacisa esitatimendeni asifundele abezindaba esithangamini sangoLwesithathu eGermiston Civic Centre, uMasina uthe wuR872 osetshenziswe kwithenda yamathoyitheli. Uthe phezu kwenkampani eyayiqashelwe ukwenza umsebenzi ngo-2014, baphinde baqasha abanye osonkontileka abangu-16. Kwenzeka lokhu nje kumiswe uMnuz Joe Mojapelo obeyisikhulu esiphezulu kulo Masipala. Uthe uMojapelo umiswe emuva kombiko weSpecial Investigating Unit (SIU), esolwa ngenkohlakalo. UMasina uthe uMojapelo kumele avele phambi kwekomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe, aziphendulele kulezi zinsolo zenkohlakalo. Ephawula ngalezi zinsolo uMajapelo, uthe imeya inephutha ngokuthi kunombiko omsola ngenkohlakalo. Ekhuluma emsakazweni uMojapelo uthe unobufakazi bokuthi awukho umbiko oshiwo yimeya. "Bengivele ngazi ukuthi awukho lo mbiko kodwa bekufanele ngenze ucwaningo ukuqinisekisa. Ngaxoshwa ngoMeyi 2 ngaphambi kokhetho, nakho engingeke ngiphawule kakhulu ngakho ngoba angiyena usopolitiki. Ngaxhumana neSIU ukubuza ngombiko ngathola ukuthi awukho. Ngiwumuntu wenkonzo, izindaba ezifana nalezi zicekela phansi isithunzi sami emphakathi," kusho uMojapelo. text: NGITHI angisike elijikayo ngodaba olushicilelwe kulo leli iphephandaba ngeledlule lapho kube nesehlo esibuhlungu sokuphuma komphefumulo ngenxa yokuthi kukhona obethukuthele ngokubizwa ngeShangane ngumufi, wabe esembhokoda ngomkhonto washona.Ngaphambi kokungena engqikithini yodaba kuzomele nginike umlando (omfishane) wakuleli lizwe nomonakalo owenziwa nguMbuso wamaBhunu ekudaleni ukucwasana phakathi kwabampisholo bebodwa.Inqubo yokucwasana yakwazi ukuthola impande igxile kwabampisholo isizwa izinhlaka zokubusa ezazaziwa ngokuthi oHulumeni beZabelo nalabo okwakuthiwa ngoZimele Geqe. IMANQIKANQIKA ukuvota intsha ezobe ivota okokuqala okhethweni lukazwelonke kulo nyaka ngenxa yokunganeliseki ngokufakwa kakhulu kwasebekhulile ezinhlakeni zobuholi. Intsha okukhulunywe nayo ithe ifuna ukubona ushintsho ebuholini bezepolitiki, kufakwe abaholi abazoqonda izidingo zayo. Njengoba ngempelasonto ezayo kulindeleke kubhaliselwe ukuvota okokugcina ngaphambi kokhetho oluzoba ngoMeyi, enye intsha ayikaqinisekisi ukuthi izobhalisa. UMsawenkosi Dlamini (23), ofunda e-University of KwaZulu-Natal, uthe yayisimvumela iminyaka yokuthi avote okhethweni loHulumeni baseKhaya ngo-2016 kodwa wangavota. “Ngathola sekuzovotwa ukuthi kwakufanele ngibhalisele ukuvota eThekwini lapho sengihlala khona uma ngifunda. Nokho angizisolanga ngokungavoti ngoba akukho obekungigqugquzela. Namanje akukho okungenza ngilangazelele ukuvota ngoba akekho nosigqugquzelayo emanyuvesi,” echaza. Uthe uzoya kobhalisela ukuvota ngesonto elizayo kodwa usazibuza ukuthi yiliphi iqembu elifanelwe yivoti lakhe. Ukhala ngokuthi amaqembu akhona awagculisi futhi alikho iqiniso. “Ngibona sengathi uma ngivota ngizobe ngifaka imali ephaketheni lomuntu. Sishoda ngabaholi abakhathalele abantu ngokweqiniso. Abanye bayathembisa kodwa bangazifezi izidingo zomphakathi. Neqembu elibonakala linentsha eningi lihlushwa wukuthi abaholi balo abavuthiwe ngokomqondo,” kusho uDlamini. Ukhale nangokuthi akayiboni intsha ebuholini bamaqembu ngisho ePhalamende kugcwele kakhulu abadala okwenza intsha ibone singekho isidingo sokubavotela. UZanele Khambule (19) waKwaMashu uthe wakubhalisela ngonyaka odlule ukuvota futhi uzimisele ukuvota. “Ngibona kungifanele ukuvota ngoba ivoti lami lizoletha ushintsho. Ikusasa lezwe lincike evotini lami,” kusho uZanele. Yize ethe ngeke adalule ukuthi uzovotela liphi iqembu, uthe alikhethile ulibona likhathalele imfundo yabamnyama. UZama Khumalo (19), oyokwenza unyaka wokuqala eDurban University of Technology, uthe akanawo umfutho wokuvota futhi akakabhalisi. Uthe ubengazi nokuthi kuyabhaliswa ngesonto elizayo. Uveze ukuthi abazali bakhe abamkhuthaza ukuthi avote ngoba bamtshela ngesimo abaphuma kuso ngezikhathi zobandlululo. “Kunzima kithina esingazazi lezo zikhathi ngoba esikubona manje yinkohlakalo kuphela. Baningi abantu esibabona besahlupheka nezingane zifunda kanzima kodwa sitshelwa ukuthi sikhululekile. Ngicabanga ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki kusamele aqinise ekushintsheni imiqondo yethu ukuthi yiluphi ushintsho esizolubona uma sivota. Kungasiza nokubona intsha inikwa amathuba ebuholini.” Umbiko wocwaningo lwe-Institute for Security Studies, waveza ukuthi intsha isemanqika ukuvota. Ngo-2014 yayingu-33% intsha eneminyaka ewu-18 no-19 eyavota okhethweni lukazwelonke. Egqugquzela iqembu lakhe ukuthi livote eThekwini, uMntwana wakwaPhindangene, uMangosuthu Buthelezi, ukuphawulile lokhu kungabi nkamunkamu kwentsha ekuvoteni. Kuleli sonto kuvele ukuthi ukuthengwa kwalokhu kudla okusuke sekuphekiwe njengopholoni, amasosishi, amaviyena nokunye, kwehle ngo-75%, kwathi ukuthengwa kwemikhiqizo yenyama yengulube kwehla ngo-50%, okuyinto eseyenze ukuthi izinkampani ezidayisa lokhu kudla zehlelwe yinzuzo ngo-40%. UMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, utshele iPhalamende kuleli sonto ukuthi lesi sifo sidale nokuthi kube nabantu abangaphezu kuka-2 000 abalahlekelwe yimisebenzi. Uthe nabantu abazizamela ngokudayisa ukudla, okubalwa amagwinya nokunye okusheshayo njengamasosishi, bashayeke kakhulu ngenxa yale nkinga. "Ngesikhathi kuqala ukuvela izindaba ngalesi sifo, bashayeke kakhulu abantu abadayisa omagwinya, kodwa abanye bazisizile ngokuthi bayeke ukuwadayisa neminye mikhiqizo, bakudayise kodwa lokhu abasuke bezenzele khona," kusho uMengameli Ramaphosa obephendula imibuzo yelungu lePhalamende leDemocratic Alliance, uLindy Wilson, obefuna umengameli achaze ukuthi sekwenzekeni kuleli selokhu kwaqubuka iListeriosis. URamaphosa uthe umbiko awuthole kwiSouth African Meat Processing Association, okuyiyo esekhaleni lokubheka konke okwenzekayo kule mboni selokhu kwaqubuka lesi sifo, ukhomba nokuthi izinkampani ezithintekayo ezikhiqiza lolu hlobo lokudla, zidla ngamapayipi nakwezezimali. Nokho lezi zinkampani sezinxuswe wuhulumeni ukuthi zingafeli ngaphakathi kodwa azifake izicelo zosizo lwezezimali eMnyangweni wezokuHweba nezeziMboni kuleli. Uthe isicelo ngasinye sizobhekwa, ngeke kuthathwe isinqumo esizofaka uwonke wonke. UMengameli uthe njengamanje lokhu okuvelayo kuwumbiko wesikhashana, ukhona umbiko ozophinde ukhishwe njengoba kusabhekwa nokuthi ungakanani umonakalo owenzeke nasezitolo ezidayisa le mikhiqizo. text: UNINA wowesifazane (24) obulawe yisoka lakhe eThornwood, eMariannhill eduze kwasePinetown uthe kudala ayeyincenga indodakazi yakhe ethi ayibuyele ekhaya kodwa inqaba ithi iyohlukaniswa wukufa nesoka layo.UNkk Sindi MaGumede Njakazi (48) uthe uphatheke kabi ngokubulawa kwendodakazi yakhe ngoba indlela ebulawe ngayo iyakhombisa ukuthi bekukhona okonakele othandweni lwayo.UNkk Njakazi uthe indodakazi yakhe, uNksz Philile Gracia Gumede, ibulawe yisoka layo uMnuz Khulekani Dube (21), obulale unina uNkk Thembi Dube (57), waphinde wabulala nendodana yakhe enezinyanga ezintathu uNhlakanipho Dube, wagwaza nendodakazi yakhe uNonkululeko Dube (2) otholwe encela ibele likanina obeseshonile. UNonkululeko usesimeni esibucayi esibhedlela.UNKSZ Philile Gumede kuthiwa kade ayecelwa ukuthi abuyele ekhaya kodwa ethi uzohlukaniswa wukufa nesoka lakhe“Indodakazi yami ibingashadile noKhulekani kodwa bebezalisene futhi abakwaDube bebegcina ngokuthembisa ukuthi bazolobola kodwa bebengakaze bafike. Ngiphatheke kabi ngokuthi indodakazi yami ibulawe wuKhulekani ngoba bengiyincenga ngithi ayibuye ekhaya ingitshele ukuthi uKhulekani wumuntu onolaka okuthi uma esethukuthele kube iyona kuphela ekwazi ukumehlisa. Ibithi uma ingivakashele ayifonele uKhulekani ayibuze ukuthi ibuya nini ibe iqeda kufika,” kusho uNkk Njakazi.FUNDA:Bashaqekile ngoqothe umndeniUthe kwala ngisho eseyisabisa ngokuthi uzoyilanda namaphoyisa kwaDube kodwa ayizange ifune ukubuya.UMNUZ Khulekani Dube obulele umndeni wakhe maqede wazikhunga.“UPhilile wangitshela ukuthi yena noKhulekani bayohlukaniswa wukufa, ngiphatheke kabi ngoba sekwenzekile lokhu ayekushilo. Ngiyacela ukuthi izingane zamantombazane zikhulume uma zinezinkinga othandweni lwazo zingafeli ngaphakathi. Ngiyasola ukuthi bekunezinkinga othandweni lwendodakazi yami kodwa ibifela ngaphakathi,” kusho uNkk Njakazi.Uveze ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ibisihlale kwaDube iminyaka eyisithupha kanti kwaNjakazi abasebenzi njengoba beziphilisa ngokudayisa amashidi ombhede.Mayelana nengane yendodakazi yakhe esindile uthe usazoya esibhedlela aphinde akhulume nosonhlalakahle ngoba izodinga ukwelulekwa ngokwengqondo.IMEYA yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede ithi umasipala uzolekela ukuze kufihlwe umndeni wakwaDube oqothwe yindodana yakhona egcine ngokuzihilela. Video: BONISWA MOHALEIMeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, ibizifikele mathupha kwaDube yathi siyishaqisile isigameko sokuqothwa kwalo mndeni.“Baningi la bantu besifazane abadlule emhlabeni ngesandla somuntu wesilisa osemncane kakhulu, sithinteke kakhulu ezinhliziyweni. Njengomkhandlu onakekelayo sizoqinisekisa ukuthi umndeni ufihlwa ngesizotha. Sizoqinisekisa ukuthi ingane esele, esesibhedlela njengamanje, ithola ukuhlunyeleliswa kwezengqondo ngoba ihlukumezeke kakhulu, ihlale isonto lonke nabantu abashonile incela ebeleni likanina. Kuyinto ebuhlungu kakhulu. Sizoqinisekisa umndeni ozobe uhleli nayo ukuthi sizoyinakekela ngoba uhulumeni wethu unezinhlelo zonke zokunakekela abantwana abangenabo abazali,” kusho uNkk Gumede.Ugqugquzele amadoda ukuthi avikele abesifazane ayeke izidakamizwa ngoba uKhulekani uchazwe njengomuntu obephuza futhi kutholwe namaphilisi eduze kwakhe.UNKK Thembi Dube obulewe yindodana yakhe uKhulekani Dube emgwazile yaphinde yamnquma.Khonamanjalo uNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNkk Weziwe Thusi, uthe uzothumela osonhlalakahle bayosiza umndeni wakwaDube.Uphinde wacela imindeni ukuthi isheshe icele usizo uma inezinkinga kungaze kube nezigameko ezifuze esakwaDube.

Macala ayebhekene noZuma ahoxiswa ngemuva kokuthi kuvele ukuthi ukubekwa kwakhe amacala kwakunenhlese yezepolitiki. Kwavela ukuthi owayeyi Nhloko yezokuShushiswa koMphakathi * -Adv Bulelani Ngcuka, nowayehola uphiko olwalubizwa ngoFezela, uMnuz Leornard McCarthy, babehlela ngasese itulo lokuba uZuma ashushiswe. Kuthiwa uMnuz Philani Msomi uhlaselwe abalisa bangakubo ngeledlule ngoba bemsola ngokuthi ungene endlini wabopha ingane yakhona eneminyaka engu-16 wase ethatha uR50. Umalume wakhe, uMnuz Mpiko Msomi, uthe umshana wakhe uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela emuva kokunenebulwa yilaba balisa okuthiwa bebemshaya ngomphini wepiki bephinde bamshaye nangobhushi ngoba bemsola ngokweba. Uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi laba balisa baboshiwe kodwa babuye badedelwa. "Kubuhlungu kuthina siwumndeni wakhe ngoba ulinyaziwe kabuhlungu waze walaliswa esibhedlela kodwa abantu abenze lokhu badedelwa. Asiqondi ukuthi kanti umthetho usebenza kanjani?" kusho uMsomi. Ukhale nangokuthi lesi sigameko senzeke ngoLwesibili ekuseni futhi sabikwa emaphoyiseni kodwa abasolwa baze baboshwa ngoLwesine khona ngeledlule ngoba naye eselandelele ezama ukuthola ukuthi ababoshiwe ngani?" UMsomi osanda kudedelwa esibhedlela, uthe akaphathekile kahle njengoba abasolwa eseke wababona becanasa ngaphandle. Uthe akukho okucacile ngokuthi badedelwe kanjani laba balisa. text: UMHOLI we-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF), uMnuz Julius Malema usefunge wagomela ukuthi abalandeli baleli qembu bazoqhubeka nokudla umhlaba ongasebenzi njengendlela yokuqinisa ingcindezi kuhulumeni ukuthi abuyisele umhlaba kubantu boHlanga kuleli.UMalema uxwayise uhulumeni ngokuthi intsha yakuleli izizwa inganakiwe selokhu kwaphuma uhulumeni wobandlululo, kwabekwa owentando yeningi ngo-1994.Udaba lomhlaba cishe ngoluhamba phambili ngaphambi kokhetho lukazwelonke ngonyaka ozayo.“Njengamanje kunesizukulwane esisha esiphelelwa ukubekezela,” kusho uMalema ekhuluma ne-AFP.Babalelwa ku-28% abantu abangasebenzi kuleli kanti kwezinye izindawo intsha engasebenzi ibalelwa ngaphezulu kuka-50%.“I-EFF isungulwe ngesikhathi esihle ngoba siyakwazi ukusebenzisa intshisekelo yalesi sizukulwane ukuthi siqinise umzabalazo womnotho. text: IYAVUTHA ikhokhasi yamakhansela e-ANC kuMasipala waseMtubatuba ikhala ngemeya athi ilaxaze imoto ngoba isaba ukuthi inotokoloshe, yathenga entsha ceke ngemali kamasipala.Amakhansela athi iMeya uMnz Velangenkosi Gumede iyeke imoto iJeep Cheerokee emnyama yaze yadayiswa ngoba isaba ukuthi uma ihamba ngayo ingase ibeke impilo yayo engcupheni ngoba icushwe ngotokoloshe.Amakhansela uma ekhuluma le ndaba kuvele kuthi awazisakaze phansi ngoba asola imeya ngokuchitha imali yomkhandlu entweni engenasidingo.Umthombo uthe le moto eyiJeep neshaya ngezinombolo ezithi Mtuba 1, yayihamba imeya eyakhishwa esikhundleni uMnuz Qhina Mkhwanazi.Yiyona leyo moto okuthiwa imeya ibingafuni nakuyithinta njengoba isihamba ngeToyota Fortuner entsha.Imithombo ithi ngendlela amakhansela e-ANC adinwe ngayo, acebe imeya kuNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube.Kuvele ukuthi uNkk Dube-Ncube ubehambele lo umasipala ngoLwesine ngenxa yokukhungathwa yizinkinga.Kuthiwa ngesikhathi kukhona uNkk Dube-Ncube kusukume elinye lamakhansela lamtshela ukuthi abayizwa le ndaba yemeya esaba otokoloshe.Isitatimende esikhishwe wumnyango siveza ukuthi uNkk Dube-Ncube unike imeya ithuba lokuphendula ngendaba yemoto enotokoloshe yavuma ukuthi yayiyeka imoto kodwa yayichitha eyotokoloshe. Ichaze yathi iyibone ingasaphephile ngoba isihambe yafika ku-110 000 km.Okhulumela ikhokhasi ye-ANC kulo masipala uMnuz Siyabonga Khumalo, uthe ziningi izinto ezingahambi kahle kumasipala futhi bazibikile zonke kungqongqoshe.Uthe udaba lwemoto alusalanga ngaphandle ngoba abahambisani nokuthengwa kwemoto entsha.“Le moto endala isesimeni esihle kabi, siyaxakeka uma kuthiwa ayisafuneki sekuthengwe entsha. Lokhu kukatokoloshe emotweni asikwazi kahle sakuzwa nje kuthiwa kuke kwashiwo yiyona imeya ngesikhathi ikhuluma udaba lwemoto,’’ kusho uKhumalo.Imenenja kamasipala uMnuz Jeconia Mngomezulu ukuqinisekisile ukuthi yashintshwa imoto yemeya ngoba yayindala kakhulu.“Kuyiqiniso ukuthi ayisekho iJeep eyayihamba imeya eyaphuma kodwa ngeke ngiyikhulume eyotokoloshe. USolwazi Magwaza uthe ukhwantalala seluyisifo esiyinkinga kakhulu kuleli futhi uma singanakiwe baningi abazophazamiseka ngokomqondo ngenxa yalo. Uveze ukuthi izifo ezithinta umqondo azinakwa kuleli, sekuyinto ejwayelekile ukubona ophazamiseke ngokomqondo emgwaqweni engasizwa.“Ingane ingashaywa esikoleni kuthiwa ayizwa kanti inokhwantalala. Uveze nokuthi ukwanda kwezigameko zokuzibulala kwezingane kwenziwa ukuthi zibona kuyinto enhle ngoba kuvezwa nakwabezindaba. Uthe ezinye zisebenzisa izidakamizwa ngoba ziziba ukhwantalala.Uthe ukugula ngomqondo okubizwa ngeBipolar kuqala ngokhwantalala olunganakiwe. text: MHLELI: Ngicela ukuthi ungidlulisele ukuphatheka kabi kwami ngesenzo esenzeka lapha ebandleni selokhu kwahlala ubaba uNyazi ebandleni. Okokuqala, ngizobeka kucace ukuthi ngokwenqubo yaleli bandla uma kuzongena imihlangano eyaye yenziwe kathathu onyakeni, okuyinhlangano kaJanuwari, Julayi no-Okthoba kumele kuthethelelwe bonke abebemisiwe ngenxa yokuphambana nomthetho webandla noma ngamacala athile abasuke bewenzile, bephula imithetho kaNkulunkulu. Kodwa lokhu sibona sekushaywa indiva nobaba sengathi uyehluleka ukuphuma nento ecacile njengomholi webandla. Abantu bayazenzela nje, akanendaba futhi uyehluleka ukumela iqiniso njengoba kunguye owokugcina okumele aphume nezwi eliwujuqu.Ngikhuluma nje kunabagcotshwa abayilokhu bamiswa. Manje sekungaphezulu kweminyaka eyisithupha udaba lwabo lungakhulumeki, yena ubaba uthulile nje akabashayi mkhuba noma sebekhalela ukuthi phela abaxolelwe, babuyele esontweni. Ngokwenqubo yebandla lokhu akwenzeki.Siyamangala-ke ngoba lokhu kuyaphambana nomthetho kanti nekomiti elimiselwe ukulungisa izindaba zebandla lizithulele nje. Manje angisazi ukuthi leli bandla libhekephi uma kunjalo. Uma yena engabathetheleli njengomnikazi wesonto kanti ngubani okumele abathethelele? Futhi uma yena engabazweli ngubani kanti ozobazwela ngoba uma bexabene, engabalamuli ngabe ulindele ukuthi kuze kuchitheke igazi yini lapha ebandleni? Yonke le mihlangano engiyibalile iyangena nje bamisiwe laba bantu, abasonti ndawo, abasazazi noma basengamaNazaretha noma sebeyini. Uma belahlwa benganakwa kanti yini lena engaka abayona lapha ebandleni edala bangiyitholi intethelelo?Uma bengahamba manje emhlabeni bengathethelelwe kuyothiwani? Sengisola ukuthi naye ubaba akalinakile ibandla ukuthi abantu bayezwana noma cha. Laba bagcotshwa ngingabala oMfundisi Khanyi, Mavuso, Ngema, Mchunu noMvangeli uMtshali. Angisazi kahle noma bamisiwe noma baxoshiwe yini ebandleni. Ngikhuluma nje lona omunye uMfundisi Richard Mchunu wake wazidela weza mathupha ethi uzozicelela intethelelo kuye ubaba uNyazi kepha wavinjwa ngamanye amalungu ebandla, amfaka induku phambi kwakhe ubaba. Ngelanga ashaywa ngalo kwakuyiSabatha kwakukhona ngisho iSilo Samabandla sivakashile, okungavumelekile-ke emthethweni kaNkulunkulu ukuba kwenzeke. Futhi lokhu kwakumele ubaba njengomholi aphume nezwi eliwujuqu ngaso leso sikhathi, ayilungise yena le ndaba yalaba bagcotshwa abathethelele babuyele esontweni nabo bazikhonzele. Kepha yena wathi laba bantu abaxabene bebodwa, abasale bayilungise le ndaba yokuxabana kwabo wasuka washiya kulenga kunjalo.Le nto eyenzekayo lapha ebandleni isiphethe kabi kakhulu ngoba ihlambalaza ibandla likaNkulunkulu wasekuPhakameni. Angikaze ngiyibone le nto ngoba kuyimanje kukhona abanye abagcotshwa abamisiwe futhi nabo okungezwakali kahle ukuthi benze sono sini.UThingolwenkosazana lwalungahambisani nokushaywa nokuxoshwa kwabantu esontweni noma ngabe benzeni. Lwaluze lusho luthi mina angixoshi muntu ngoba nobaba abazange baxoshe muntu. Kodwa manje lokhu sekuyinsakavukela nje ebandleni. Siyibandla siyamangala ukuthi sekuyisonto elinjani kanti leli uma selinjena. Ngiyafisa ukuthi nesigungu esiphezulu silusukumele ngokukhulu ukushesha lolu daba lwalaba bagcotshwa, babuyiselwe ebandleni nabo bakhonze.Le nto ibuhlungu ngoba laba bantu banezingane namakhosikazi abangazi lutho futhi angone lutho. Nabo bayathinteka abasasonti ndawo ngoba kumiswe oyise nabayeni babo. Okwamanje ngeke ngikwazi ukuphawula ngokuthi izinsolo ziyiqiniso noma cha. Ngisalinde ubufakazi. Izinsolo ezibucayi lezi ngakho sidinga ukucophelela,” kusho uMabe. Uthe inhlangano ebusayo ayifisi ukuchitha lezi zinsolo bese kujika kuvele ukuthi bayithola imali kuleli bhange.Okhulumela iDA kuzwelonke uMnuz Solly Malatsi ukukhahlele ngezinyawo zombili ukuthi yake yacela noma yathola uxhaso kwiVBS Mutual Bank.“I-DA ayikaze ithole ngisho isenti kwiVBS. Lezi zinsolo azilona iqiniso,” kusho uMalatsi.NgoLwesine ngesonto eledlule iDA yavula icala ifuna bonke abathintekayo ekudliweni kwemali yeVBS Mutual Bank babhekane nengalo yomthetho. Noma uMatodzi ebalwa njengobhongoza ekudliweni kwemali kwibhange lokuqala ebeliphethwe abantu abamnyama kuphela kuleli, akahlatshwanga ngemibuzo ngesikhathi u-Adv Terry Motau enza uphenyo. UMotau uthe akakhulumanga noMatodzi ngoba ukhombise ukungathembeki ngesikhathi edlelwa impahla yakhe.“Ukuphika kwakhe ukuthi uyingxenye yabantu abadale le nhlekelele ebhange kushayisana nobufakazi obuningi obukhomba ukuthi nguyena obengubhongoza wayo yonke lento. Ngenxa yokuzihlangula kwakhe ngabona ukuthi kuzofana nokumosha isikhathi ukumnikeza ithuba lokuthi abeke uhlangothi lwakhe. Lokho uyokwena kwenye inkundla ngesinye isikhathi,” kusho uMotau.I-EFF ngakolunye uhlangothi ithe izophendula ngalezi zinsolo esithangamini nabezindaba ngoLwesibili.

UHLA LELWE wumsebenzi onzima uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa njengoba yonke iminyakazo yakhe yokuqoka uMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi izoqashwa ngeso lokhozi.Izazi zomthetho zisho lokhu emuva kokuthi iJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga linqume ukuthi ukuqokwa kuka-Adv Shaun Abrahams akukho emthethweni ngoba wangena esikhundleni sika-Adv Mxolisi Oliver Nxasana owaxoshwa ngaphandle kokulandela uMthethosisekelo.IJaji Madlanga lithe u-Abrahams kufanele akhokhe izindleko zecala zabameli bakhe ababili bese uhulumeni ekhokha zonke izindleko zecala.Uyalele uNxasana ukuthi akhokhe uR10.3 million (R10 240 767.47) kuR17.3 million akhokhelwa wona ngesikhathi exoshwa. Uphinde wayalela uRamaphosa ukuthi aqoke uMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi kungakapheli izinsuku ezingu-90.Uthe zonke izinqumo ezithathwe ngu-Abrahams zisemthethweni.USolwazi Pierre De Vos oyisazi soMthethosisekelo esifundisa ezomthetho eNyuvesi yaseCape Town, uthe Ramaphosa kufanele aqoke umuntu ozophatha ezokushushiswa okwesikhashana ngesikhathi esabheka umuntu ofanelwe yilesi sikhundla.“Wonke amehlo azothi njo kuRamaphosa njengoba kufanele aqoke umuntu onesibindi, onesimilo futhi ongahambisani nenhlangano ethile yepolitiki futhi ongahambisana nosomabhizinisi abathile.“Kufanele kube wumuntu ozobeka izidingo zezwe ngoba uma ehambisana nepolitiki uzocabangela inhlangano yakhe futhi uma ehambisana nosomabhizinisi uzocabangela bona angabheki izidingo zesizwe,” kusho uDe Vos.Uthe njengoba ijaji lithe izinqumo zika-Abrahams ngeke zishintshe kusho ukuthi abanamacala ezinkantolo bazoqhubeka nawo kuze kuba yizona ezinquma ukuthi ayabalahla noma ayabathetha.UMnuz Lawson Naidoo weCouncil for Adavancement of the South African Constitution uthe bayasijabulela isinqumo senkantolo yize sifike sekwenzeke umonakalo omkhulu.“Isinqumo senkantolo sizobuyisa uzinzo kwezomthetho eNingizimu Afrika futhi siyasamukela. Sizoqapha ngeso lokhozi ukuthi zonke iziphakamiso zenkantolo ziyenzeka,” kusho uNaidoo.Phakathi kwezinye izinhlangano ebezifake udaba luka-Abrahams enkantolo kubalwa iCorruption Watch neFreedom Under Law.UMnuz David Lewis onguMqondisi weCorruption Watch, uthe inkantolo ithathe isinqumo esifanele ngoba umthetho ubusufile eNingizimu Afrika.“Silindele ukuthi kuqokwe umuntu onesibindi, ongeke asabe ukushushisa izephulamthetho noma ngabe zikuhulumeni. Asifuni umuntu ohambisana nepolitiki noma othanda imali,” kusho uLewis.UNxasana uthe akanankinga nokukhokha uR10.3 million futhi uzolandela okushiwo yinkantolo kodwa uyajabula ukuthi akalahlwanga yicala.

Ngenxa yenkuthazo nosi zo oluvela kuHlelo Lokwe sekwa nokuThuthukiswa Kwabalimi okwamenza wathola isibonelelo Sohle lo Oluphelele Lokwesekwa Kwezolimo (i-CASP) ngowe zi-2015, wakwazi ukubeka isisekelo esiqinile futhi wa -chuma njengomlimi.

MHLELI: Ngoba isiphekiwe sengithi mangiyiphule ngiyihlukanise ngezithebe mayelana nodaba luphakanyiswe ngokubanjwa kwabantu eNquthu obelushicilelwe ephephandabeni lomhla ka-13. Yiqiniso elingephikwe lelo, sengikubone izikhawu kwenzeka phambi kwami kuyilapho ngingeke ngenze lutho. Bayabulala laba bafana abadlali. Imbangela yakho konke lokhu wukucanasa kwabashushumbisi bezidakamizwa ezidayisa udede kuleli dolobha. Ngikusho lokhu ngoba umphakathi namaphoyisa uyabazi laba bantu abashushumbisayo kodwa abathathelwa zinyathelo ngoba wobhululu babo. Okungamaphoyisa bayakucubuzelela. Thina njengomphakathi kasiphephile. Angiphathi uma sekuhwalele kumele wazi ukuthi ungahle ungafiki nasekhaya. Uma ushayisa sekuhlwile kumele uqinisekise ukuthi uthola into ezokubeka ekhaya. Kuke kwatholakala izidumbu ezine zababulawa ngobusuku obubodwa. Ingalo yomthetho kuleli imfishane kakhulu. Lokhu ngikusho ngoba ziningi izigameko zokubulawa kwabantu kodwa kuthuleke kube sengathi akwenzekanga lutho. Amabhubesi uma engaboshwa afuyelwe ukuba asidle asiqede. Kwala noma umphakathi usibambile isigebengu usiyise emaphoyiseni unele ungahamba sidedelwe usibone sesibhampa sinilandela sinichomela ngoba sesidedelwe. Sesiyoqhubeka la sigcine khona. Kwesinye isikhathi umphakathi uwaluma indlebe amaphoyisa baboshwe abenzi bokubi maqede inkantolo ibakhiphe ithi abukho ubufakazi. Ngicela ukuba kujutshwe ithimba elizonqanda ukubhebhetheka kwamaphara adlangile eNquthu.

INYUKE ngokusemthethweni imali yokugibela amatekisi izolo emuva kokuthi iSouth African National Taxi Council (Santaco) imemezele ngokusemthethweni ukuthi izindleko zokusebenza nokukhuphuka umlibe kukaphethroli, kuphoqe abanikazi bamatekisi ukuthi bayinyuse.UMengameli weSantaco uMnuz Phillip Taaibosch, uthe amatekisi azonyuka ngoR1 emabangeni aseduze bese kuthi lawo ahambela ezindaweni ezikude anyuke ngoR10 noR20.“Izindleko zokusebenza yizona ezenza sinyuse imali yokugibela. Kusukela ngoJanuwari wonyaka odlule kuze kube yimanje uphethroli usunyuke ngo-130%. Uma kunyuka ilitha kusho ukuthi nentela kaphethroli iyanyuka.Sinqume ukunyusa imali kaphethroli kusukela manje (Agasti 1) kuze kube wuJuni wonyaka ozayo,” kusho uTaaibosch.Ucele uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuthi eze nezindlela zokwehlisa umthwalo emahlombe osomatekisi nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.Uyichithile imibiko ethi osomatekisi abangaphansi kweSantaco bebesemashini yokuthi kwehle uphethroli ngoLwesibili.Uthe bazomemezela uma sebemasha kwazise kuma yonke into uma kuteleke iSantaco.UMnuz Bhekisisa Nzuza okhulumela iNational Taxi Alliance KwaZulu-Natal, uvumile ukuthi imali yokugibela amatekisi izonyuka ngenxa yezindleko zomsebenzi.“Siyazwelana kakhulu nabagibeli ngoba iningi labo alisebenzi futhi uma lisebenza linezindleko eziningi kodwa-ke izindleko zomsebenzi wamatekisi nokunyuka kukaphethroli yikona okwenza kunyuke imali yokugibela.Sikhokha imali enkulu uma sithenga izinsimbi zezimoto njengoba intela inyuswe yasuka ku-14% yaya ku-15%.Siphinde sikhokhe intela uma sithenga amathayi, izindleko zingaphezu kwamandla ethu yingakho imali yokugibela inyuka,” kusho uNzuza.

Umsebenzi kahulumeni uhlukahlukene, unohlu olukhulu lwamakhono, iziqu kanye namakhono omse benzi. Abasebenzi abaningi bakahulumeni banamakho no akhethekile adingeka ekuhlinzekweni kwezinsiza ngempumelelo. Ngakho-ke akusikho ukuthi sidinga abasebenzi

SIPHINDE safakelwa ezinye izigidi isikhwama okuhloswe ngaso ukusiza intsha enamabhizinisi KwaZulu-Natal, esethulwa ekuqaleni konyaka. Lesi sikhwama esibizwa ngeKZN Youth Fund sethulwa nguNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Sihle Zikalala ngoJanuwari. Ethula isabelozimali sehhovisi lakhe izolo, undunankulu umemezele ukuthi kuzokwengezwa uR50 million kulesi sikhwama.Ngesikhathi sethulwa ngoJanuwari, uZikalala waveza ukuthi wuR50 million obekelwe lesi sikhwama. Emuva kokwethulwa kwaso kwabuye kwaba nesidlo sasekuseni nabanye osomabhizinisi abanikele ngoR20 million, okwenze isikhwama saba uR70 million. Kumanje isikhwama sesinoR120 million.Ekhuluma eSishayamthetho sesifundazwe izolo uZikalala, uthe basabafuna abanye osomabhizinisi abazimele abazonikela kulesi sikhwama.“Siyazi ukuthi kunokuhlobana phakathi kosomabhizinisi nokudaleka kwamathuba omsebenzi.Lesi sikhwama esesinguR120 million sizosiza intsha engosomabhizinisi, ezovulela nabanye amathuba omsebenzi. Siyakujabulela ukuthi ibhange i-Absa selibeke eceleni uR70 million ozosiza intsha efuna ukuboleka imali noR500 million wamabhizinisi amancane,” kusho uZikalala.Uthe basazibophezele ukuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi esifundazweni nokudala amathuba omsebenzi. Uveze ukuthi kulindeleke ukuthi lesi sikhwama senyuke njengoba kusekhona izingxoxo nabanye osomabhizinisi abazimele. UZikalala uthe ithimba lokuqala lentsha elifake izicelo zokuhlomula kulesi sikhwama, lizokwethulwa ngenyanga ezayo.Ngesikhathi ethula isikhwama ngoJanuwari, undunankulu wagcizelela ukuthi sizohlomulisa kuphela amabhizinisi angeke aphele endleleni. Uthe kuzoxhaswa amabhizinisi azokwazi ukudala amathuba omsebenzi kwenye intsha, ikakhulukazi kwiFranchising nasezimbonini zokukhiqiza. Uveze nokuthi isikhwama senzelwe ukusiza intsha engalutholi uxhasho lokuqala amabhizinisi emabhange, ezosizwa nangokuqeqeshwa.

BAVEZE imibono eyehlukene abahlaziyi bezepolitiki mayelana nomhlangano wabaholi abathile be-ANC okubalwa nobengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma lapho kuthiwa bekuboshwa kuwo uzungu lokuketula uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Iphephandaba lesiNgisi langeSonto libike ukuthi uZuma, uNobhala-jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Ace Magashule, obenguNdunankulu aphinde abe nguSihlalo we-ANC eNorth West, uMnuz Supra Mahumapelo, uNobhala we-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thanduxolo Sabelo, noNkk Meokgo Matuba we-ANCWL nabanye bahlangane eMaharani Hotel, eThekwini. Iphephandaba lize laveza nesithombe esikhombisa laba baholi bekuleli hotela.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Ralph Mathekga, uthe izinsolo ziyinto ekhona. Lokhu kufakazelwa wukuthi i-ANC ikhiphe izincazelo eziningi ezehlukene ngazo.“Ukuthi umhlangano waba khona noma cha kukhombisa ukuthi ngaphakathi kwi-ANC bakhona abahlela ukuketula umengameli,” kusho uMathekga.Omunye umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Xolani Dube, ongumcwaningi kwisikhungo iXubera Institute uthe akekho ozokwazi ukuthi bekukhulunywani emhlanganweni kuze kube omunye wabo uphula umgomo wokugcina imfihlo uphumela obala uyasho ukuthi bekukhulunywa ngani.“Iqiniso wukuthi umhlangano ube khona kodwa akekho owaziyo ukuthi bekukhulunywa ngani kuwo,” kusho uDube.Uthe yena akaboni ukuthi le ndaba yomhlangano ingaze isuse umsindo.Ugxeke uSabelo ngokuphumela obala azame ukuziqhelelanisa nezinsolo.Omunye umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Thabani Khumalo, uthe okwamanje kunzima ukusho ukuthi izinsolo ziyinto ekhona yini noma engekho. “NgesiZulu kuyaye kuthiwe ungayibambi isavele ngekhanda kodwa okukhulu kunakho konke wukuthi kwi-ANC akukho ukuthembana. Imihlangano ingenye yezindlela zepolitiki kodwa ngenxa yokuthi akukho ukwethembana sekuvela izinsolo ezifana nalezi,” kusho uKhumalo.Ebuzwa ukuthi ngakube izinsolo aziwulimazi yini umkhankaso kaSabelo ogaqele isikhundla sokuba ngumengameli we-ANCYL, uKhumalo uthe ziwushaye phansi ikakhulukazi njengoba imiphumela yezingqungquthela kwi-ANC igqugquzelwa yizimbangi.“Naye uyabona ukuthi izinsolo ziyamlimaza yingakho komunye umthombo wezindaba ethe ufisa kwenziwe uphenyo ukuze kuvele iqiniso,” kusho uKhumalo.Ilungu lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC, uMnuz Zizi Kodwa, lithe abazi lutho ngomhlangano ngoba kwakungesiwo owe-ANC.“i-ANC ayikaze ibe nomhlangano, kukubona abantu okuthiwa babesemhlanganweni ukuthi basho ukuthi babekhuluma ngani,” kusho uKodwa.Ushaye phansi ngonyawo wathi akekho umuntu ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle kwi-ANC ongaguqula izinqumo ezathathwa eNasrec.

Lesi sigameko sicasule umphakathi osola ukuthi ukungavalwa komgodi yikona okwenze ingane iphonseke futhi kusazodaleka omunye umonakalo.Ilungu lomphakathi, uMnuz Vusi Shamase, uthe umgodi wambiwa ngesonto eledlule wangavalwa kwaze kwangena amanzi emvula.“Bekungafakwanga ngisho izintambo ezibomvu ezikhombisa ukuthi kunobungozi. Kubonakale ezinye izingane zilokhu zikhomba emgodini kanti uLuyanda ubevele engasabonakali. Kube yinhlanhla kwakona ukuthi angene yedwa kulo mgodi ngoba bezikhona nezinye izingane abedlala nazo,” echaza.UShamase uthe kumanje lo mgodi awukagqitshwa futhi kunesalukazi esinendlu eduze kwawo lo mgodi, naso esisengcupheni.UNkk Nontobeko Dlamini othe uLuyanda uzalwa ingane kadadewabo, uthe bashaqekile ngokwenzekile. UBHODLA umlilo unina womfundi oneminyaka ewu-12 wase-Edgerton Primary, eNtsikeni, eMzimkhulu, okuthiwa ubhaxabulwe wuthisha ekilasini, ngoLwesine.Unina womfana ofunda uGrade 5 uthe kuthiwa indodana yakhe nabangani bayo ababili babefunda iphepha behleka ekilasini ngesikhathi kungena uthisha wababiza wabanciza izindlebe. Ababili wabancinza izindlebe wabayeka kodwa indodana yakhe wayincinza indlebe wayishaya ngenduku nangempama kwaze kwakhuza omunye uthisha.“Ingane ibuye imidwayidwa emhlane ihuzukile nasesiphongweni. Anginankinga nokuthi ingane ijeziswe uma yonile okungiphatha kabi ukuthi uthisha ayishaye ize ilimale,” kusho unina wengane.NgoLwesihlanu uthe uyile esikoleni ethi uyobikela uthishanhloko ngalolu daba wafika engekho. Uthisha osolwa ngokubhaxabula umfundi uthe uvele waba nolaka ngoba umfundi ubelubamba uswazi engafuni ukushaywa.Uthisha nomzali, abaganele ndawonye, kuthiwa ababhekani emva kwengxabano yomndeni.“Kuyiqiniso ukuthi asikhulumisani futhi asingenelani. Angazi noma ulaka akhuluma ngalo luvuswe wukuthi ingane izalwa yizitha zakhe yini ngoba phela ezinye izingane ebezihleka neyami azishaywanga ngenduku, zincinzwe izindlebe kuphela,” kusho yena.Umzali uthe ngempelasonto kufike amanye amalungu esigungu sesikole ethi azoxolisela uthisha.“Bathe uthisha uyaxolisa, uma ngiqhubeka nokubika lolu daba kwabaphethe ngizobe ngibeka umsebenzi kathishanhloko engcupheni. Angimangalelanga uthishanhloko mina, ngimangalele uthisha oshaye ingane yami,” kusho yena.UNkk Alberta Tuswa, oyilungu lesigungu, uzihlangulile kulolu daba wathi umzali akakaze ababikele ngalo futhi abakaze baludingide.“Akukho esingakuphawula ngoba umzali ubone singabalulekile wayovula icala emaphoyiseni waya nakodokotela. Manje sesishayelwa ucingo ngabezindaba angiboni ukuthi kukhona esisengakwenza,” usho kanje.UMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uthe bayadumala ukuthi kusekhona othisha abashaya izingane yize bebona ukuthi ozakwabo abenza lokhu bajeziswa kanjani.“Siyajabula ngoba umzali uvule icala kodwa nathi sizokwenza olwethu uphenyo bese sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele,” kusho yena.ULt Col Thulani Zwane okhulumela amaphoyisa uthe kuvulwe icala lokushaywa komfundi okuthiwa kwenziwe uthisha ekilasini. Uthe icala liphenywa ngamaphoyisa aseNtsikeni, akukaboshwa muntu.

Izitshudeni zaseMfolozi TVET College zicasulwe wukuthi sezibekezele isikhathi eside zingayitholi imali yokukhokhela izindawo zokuhlala ekhishwa yisikhwama iNational Students Financial Aid Scheme (Nsfas). Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ngoMsombuluko odlule bafike emakilasini nezimpahla nezingubo zokulala ngoba abanye sebexoshiwe emiqashweni abebehlala kuyo ngenxa yokungakhokhi. Ukulala kwabo emakilasini kuphazamise nokufunda njengoba kuthiwa othisha bagcine bengasafiki yavalwa ikolishi. Okhulumela isigungu sezitshudeni, uMbali Nxumalo, uthe bagcina ukufunda ngoMsombuluko odlule. Izitshudeni bezilokhu zibekezele kodwa inkinga iqale sezixoshwa ezindaweni zokuhlala ebeziqashe kuzona. Inselelo enkulu wukuthi zihlala ezindaweni ezikude futhi zizidinga ngempela izindawo zokuhlala. Kumanje ezinye zimpintshiswe abanezindawo zokuhlala, ezinye zaphindela emakhaya. Uthe izitshudeni azihlangene nokuphazamiseka kokufunda ngoba ukulala kwazo bekungaphazamisi. Uveze ukuthi bamangele uma othisha nabahlanza amakilasi bengasafiki. Bagcina ukulala ngoLwesihlanu emuva kokukhishwa ngamaphoyisa. Kuthiwa le nkinga isiphazamise nezitshudeni ezifunda ngasese njengoba othisha bengasafundisi. Uphikile ukuthi izitshudeni ziqale ukulala emakilasini ngoMsombuluko wathi ziqale ngoLwesithathu. Okumele sikucacise wukuthi asikwazi ukulawula uhlelo lokukhipha imali yezitshudeni kwaNsfas. Izitshudeni zizifakela izicelo ngqo kwaNsfas thina sithole uhla lwabazoxhaswa emuva kwesikhathi. Inkinga iqale ngokuthi kufike uhla lwamagama abazoxhaswa uNsfas ngesikhathi izitshudeni zisemaholidini ePhasika ngo-Ephreli 4. SEZIQALE phansi izinkinga esikoleni samabanga aphezulu eMbumbulu esacishe savalwa ngenxa yokungaziphathi kahle kwabafundi, asebekhala ngesibhaxu kuthishanhloko.Abafundi baseMbambangwe Secondary abafunda u-matric badube amakilasi izolo nangoLwesithathu bekhala ngokuthi abasakwazi ukubekezelela ukushaywa nguthishanhloko, bakhala nangokuthi uyabathuka. Njengoba abafundi abaningi baka-matric bezoqhubeka nokufunda uma kuvalwa izikole namuhla, abaseMbambangwe abacele ukungadalulwa bathe abalubhadi esikoleni. Bathi sekukaningi bekhononda ngokushaywa manje sebenqume ukulusukumela lolu daba. Izolo bathe sebecele ukubonana nothishanhloko bamtshele okokugcina ngezikhalo zabo.Kuke kwavalwa amehlo ngesimo salesi sikole ngo-2014 kukhalwa ngabafundi abangalawuleki. Abanye babesolwa ngokuzihlanganisa namaqembu ezigebengu bese beqhubeka nezimpi zabo esikoleni. Ngo-2015 kwangenelela ikomidi iMbumbulu Education Forum ukulungisa isimo sesikole obesekuhlongozwa ukuthi sivalwe.USihlalo wekomiti inkosi Nathi Maphumulo, uthe bebengakezwa ngezinkinga zabafundi. Uthe uyadumala uma sebeqala olunye uthuthuva phezu kwemizamo yokulungisa isikole.“Uma abafundi bekhala ngokuqiniswa kwesandla nangokushaywa kumele baveze ubufakazi. Asihambisani nokuhlukunyezwa kwabafundi kodwa ngeke sikhulume futhi ngento engenabo ubufakazi. Kuyadumaza lokhu ngoba isimo sesikole bese sibuyela kwesijwayelekile nathi sesigculisekile. Kuningi osekushintshile ngoba nohulumeni uthembise ukulekelela ukuze kunyuke nemiphumela ka-matric,” kusho uMaphumulo.Uthe ungomunye wabanxenxe iMeya yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede ukuthi ivakashele kulesi sikole nonyaka. UNkk Gumede ovakashile lesi sikole ngoFebhuwari, wanikela ngezimpahla zesikole wathembisa nokuqinisekisa ukuthi isikole senza kahle. UMaphumulo uthe konke lokhu bekuyimizamo yokuthi abafundi bakhuthazeke, isikole singabuyeli esimeni sakudala.Uthembise ukuthi bazolulandela udaba nezikhalo zabafundi.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi lesi ngesinye sezikole esike sahlupha ngezinkinga phambilini.“Sizocela umbiko kwisekethe ukuze sithole ukuthi sinjani isimo esikoleni. Kudingeka sazi ukuthi yimiphi imizamo eyenziwayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukufunda akuphazamiseki, ikakhulukazi njengoba kuthinteka no-matric,” kusho uMlotshwa.Mayelana nezinsolo ezibhekiswe kuthishanhloko uthe badinga ubufakazi ukuze baphenye.

Ngisho abe-Unesco bayakukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwalezi zilimi. Ukuthola kwami le ndondo kusho ukuthi nowethu umkhankaso uyabonakala. text: KUZOPHELA ukushaywa umoya emahhovisi kosigaxamabhande bamaphoyisa asebezophakwa emgwaqweni balwe nobugebengu obehlukene, ikakhulukazi ukubanjwa kwenkunzi kwezimoto zemali nokubulala.Izolo ngaphambi kokuthi uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, noKhomishana wamaphoyisa, uLt-General Khehla Sitole, bethule izinhlelo zabo zokulwa nobugebengu esithangamini nabezindaba, kubikwe izenzo ezintathu zokubanjwa kwezimoto zemali eMpumalanga.USitole uthe bazotshala inqwaba yamaphoyisa emgwaqweni khona kungeke kubelula ezigebengwini ukuthi ziqhubeke zenze ubugebengu.“Sizojuba noLt-General ukuthi bahole amathimba ethu esizobe siwaphaka emgwaqweni,” kusho uSitole.Uveze nokuthi bazosebenzisa nezobuchwepheshe angazange adalule okuningi ngazo ukufihlela izigebengu induku emqubeni.“Siyazi ukuthi amanye amaphoyisa ayathinteka ezehlakalweni zobugebengu. Lawo esiwabambayo siyawaxosha embuthweni, siwabeke namacala ayobhadla ejele,” kusho uSitole.Uthe kunoLt- General abathathu ababaxoshile ngoba bebethinteka ezehlakalweni zenkohlakalo.“Siyaluseka futhi uphenyo olwenziwa wuphiko oluphenya amaphoyisa, i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate (IPID).Yize luqhuba uphenyo lwalo nathi siyaqhubeka nophenyo lwethu lwangaphakathi,” kusho uSitole.Ephendula mayelana nophenyo olwenziwa yithimba eliphenya ngokubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal, uCele uvumile ukuthi umsebenzi waleli thimba awujabulisi.Uthe emacaleni cishe awu-40 okubulala mhlawumbe bane abantu ababoshiwe ngawo.“UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wajuba oNgqongqoshe abaphethe izinhlaka zezokuphepha ukuthi bahlanganise amakhanda ukuze balwe nendaba yokubulawa kwabantu eKZN. Ngingasho ukuthi sesiwuhambisile umbiko wethu wokuqala kuMengameli. Ngingakuveza ukuthi akajabule ngokuphelele ngokwenziwayo,” kusho uCele.UMqondisi we-Institute for Security Studies, uSolwazi Johan Burger, ekhuluma nabakwa-eNCA ngemuva kwesithangami sabezindaba sikaCele noSitole, uthe bese belinde isikhathi eside ukuzwa ukuthi iziphathimandla zamaphoyisa zinaziphi izinhlelo zokulwa nobugebengu.UBurger uthe bayakwamukela ukutshalwa kwenqwaba yamaphoyisa emgwaqweni, wengeza ngokuthi wathi naye uyakholwa wukuthi lokhu kuzosiza kunciphise ubelelesi.Uthe kodwa ukutshalwa kwenqwaba yamaphoyisa ngeke kusize ngalutho uma ezobunhloli zingekho bukhali.“Ngisakhala ngithi kumele kubuyiswe uphiko lwamaphoyisa olwavalwa iSerious and Violent Crime Unit. Lolu phiko lwasebenza ngenkulu impumelelo futhi amanye amaphoyisa ayesebenza kulona asekhona embuthweni,” kusho uBurger.Uthe ufisa futhi ukuthi kusungulwe i-Anti Corruption Unit ngaphakathi emaphoyiseni ezobhekana ngqo nenkohlakalo.

INDODA eyabulala inkosikazi iyisola ngokuthi iqomile, iyala abesilisa ababhekene nesimo esifanayo ukuba bangababulali kodwa bebashiye ukugwema ukubhadla ejele njengaye odonsa iminyaka engu-14. UMnuz Thokozani Malloy (48) waKwaNzimakwe ngasePort Edward ugwetshwe ngoMeyi 2016, wanikezwa iminyaka engu-12 ngecala lokubulala uNkk Ntokozo Malloy neminyaka emibili ngelokusabisa indodana yakhe eyayingufakazi ecaleni lokubulala. UNkk Malloy wabulawa ngo-Disemba 2014. Lezi zithandani ezatholana zisafunda isikole ngo-1992 zase zishada ngo-2000, zaba nabantwana abathathu. UMalloy owayeyiphoyisa lomgwaqo ePort Shepstone esesebenze iminyaka engu-20, eseqedile ngempilo yenkosikazi yakhe naye wazama ukuzibulala ngokuzidubula ekhanda, inhlamvu yaphaphalaza yaphuma neso lakhe. Emuva kokwanda kwezigameko zabesifazane ababulawa abathandana nabo, Isolezwe libe nengxoxo ekhethelekile noMalloy ejele laseWestville lapho egwetshwe khona. “Ngifunde okukhulu ngesinqumo esingesihle engasenza sokubulala inkosikazi wami ngoba ngithola ukuthi uyajola. Engifisa ukukutshela abantu besilisa wukuthi uma bezithola kulesi simo, ukubulala umuntu othandana naye akusona isixazululo ngoba ubulala umuntu uphinde umoshe nempilo yakho neyomndeni wakho. Uma kunzima kungcono umshiye phansi ungaze wenze ozozisola ngakho,” kusho uMalloy. Uthe wayengakaze acabange ukuthi empilweni yakhe angathatha isibhamu abulale umuntu amthandayo. “Sihlalile sithandana nonkosikazi, saze sashada konke kuhamba kahle. Ngo-2010 izinto ziqalile ukungahambi kahle. Ngaphenya ngo-2013 ngigcine ngitholile ukuthi kunomuntu athandana naye. Ngabheka kwiselula yakhe emuva kokuba omunye umngani wakhe esifazane engitshelile ukuthi impela unesoka. Ngabona izingqoxo nesoka lakhe kuWhatsApp, saxoxa kwaba sengathi kuyadlula,” kusho uMalloy. Uthe ukuba nolaka nenhliziyo encane ehambisana nokudinwa into ayevele enayo kodwa engazitsheli ukuthi kungaze kufike ekubulaleni umuntu. “Izinkinga phakathi kwami nonkosikazi zaqhubeka, ngo-2014 saze sahlala ngokuhlukana. Kwaze kwaba kufika lapho ngihluleka khona ngoDisemba ngaya kubo ngiyoxoxa naye ngendaba yomshado wethu. Saxabana ngavele ngakhipha isibhamu, wabaleka waya emzini kadadewabo lapho engafika ngamdubulela khona nami ngazidubula,” kusho uMalloy. Uthe akazi wasinda kanjani ngoba wayethi uyaqeda ngempilo yakhe. “Namanje kusangimangaza ukuthi ngaphila kanjani ngoba ngangizibulala. Ngaphaphama esibhedlela emuva kwesikhathi kwenzeke lokhu. Abantu abase bengitshela ukuthi kwenzekani endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uMalloy. Ngenxa yesimo sakhe sempilo uze wagwetshwa ngoMeyi 2016, ngemuva kokuphuma engena ezibhedlela. “Ukubulala kwami unkosikazi kwangilahlekisela ngomsebenzi, nomndeni wami njengoba ngingakwazi ukuhlala nezingane zethu ezineminyaka engu-22, 17 neneyisishiyagalombili. Ukuba nenhliziyo encane, nokudinwa akubuyiseli ngalutho. Abantu besilisa kumele bafunde ukulawula imizwa yabo, kungabi iyona ebalawulayo,” kusho uMalloy. Uthe ukungena ejele kuningi okumfundise khona njengoba efunde ngendlela yokulawula ukudinwa nendlela yokuziphatha nje. “Ngesikhathi sengenza lokhu angizange ngicabange ukuthi ngiwubaba ezinganeni zami, ziyangidinga. Angikucabanganga futhi nokuthi uma sengibulele unina, zizosala nobani uma sengiboshiwe njengoba ngisejele manje. Isinqumo osithatha ungacabanganga siyingozi,” kweluleka uMalloy. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi sewaxolisa kubantwana bakhe yize kwakuyinto enzima kakhulu ngoba babengafuni nokumbona.

LIKHULU isasasa ngombukiso omkhulu wamabhizinisi ozoba KwaZulu-Natal okokuqala ngenyanga ezayo.Kulindeleke ukuthi ihehe osomabhizinisi abaningi i-International Franchise and Entrepreneur Expo eyethulwa Ithala ngokuhlanganyela neFranchise Association of South Africa (Fasa). Kuzobe kuwunyaka ka-21 kwenziwa lo mbukiso ohlose ukunika ithuba osomabhizinisi abancane nemifelandowonye ukuhweba emabhizinisini eFranchising. Oyisikhulu esiphezulu se-Ithala Development Finance Corporation uNksz Pearl Bengu, uthe ukulethwa kwalo mbukiso KwaZulu-Natal kuyingxenye yemizamo yabo yokuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi abancane.“Sacela kwiFasa ukuletha lo mbukiso ukuze sivulele osomabhizinisi bethu amathuba. Lokhu kuyingxenye yokukhulisa nesikhwama sethu iFranchise Fund. Sifuna osomabhizinisi bangathengi nje kuphela amabhizinisi amaFranchise kodwa baguqule ngisho awabo abe yiwona,” echaza.Uthe lo mbukiso uhambisana nemigomo yabo kwezokuthuthukiswa komnotho nokwakha amathuba omsebenzi nokuletha abatshali zimali esifundazweni.UNkk Vera Valasis onguMqondisi oMkhulu kwaFasa, uthe sekuneminyaka engu-20 lo mbukiso wenziwa eGoli.“Ukulethwa kwalo mbukiso KwaZulu-Natal kukhombisa ukuthi uyasabalala. Siyajabula ukuthi osomabhizisi bazothola ithuba lokuhlangana nosondonzima kumaFranchise, bathole nokuchushiswa ngaleli bhizinisi.”Lo mbukiso uzudonsa izinsuku ezimbili kusukela ngoMashi 8 eDurban Exhibition Centre. Bangaphezu kuka-40 osomabhizinisi okulindeleke ukuthi babe yingxenye yalo mbukiso abasemikhakheni ehlukene okubalwa owezobuhle, ubuchwepheshe, ezokuvakasha neminye.Kulezi zinsuku ezimbili kuzoba nezikhulumi ezahlukene ukuchushisa osomabhizinisi abancane kulo mkhakha.Umkhakha weFranchising ubalwa neminye ekhulisa umnotho kuleli. Ngokombiko wangonyaka odlule weFasa kuvela ukuthi lo mkhakha ufaka * -15.7% emnothweni wakuleli. Kuthiwa angaphezu kuka-850 amaFranchise kuleli ezitolo ezingaphezu kuka-41 000.
