KUZOHLOMULA nentsha efuna ukuqala amabhizinisi ohlelweni loxhaso, olwenziwa yinhlangano kaNgqongqoshe woMnyango weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha uMnuz Senzo Mchunu ayisungule nomkakhe. Bangaphezu kuka-60 osomabhizinisi abebeyingxenye yomdlalo wegalofu eMount Edgecombe eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu, obuhlelwe yinhlangano iSenzo & Thembeka Mchunu Foundation. Inhloso yalo mdlalo ukuqokelela isikhwama esizosiza intsha eswele efuna ukuqhubeka nezifundo. UMchunu oke waba ngundunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal nongqongqoshe wezemfundo, uthe ngesikhathi ekulezi zikhundla wabona indlela intsha ethwele kanzima ngayo ngenxa yemali. Wabonisana nomkakhe babona kungcono basungule le nhlangano ukuze bafake isandla ekusizeni intsha, ikakhulukazi kwezemfundo. “Ngesikhathi ngiwungqongqoshe wezemfundo ngaba nethuba lokubona izinselelo ezibhekene nentsha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Nangesikhathi ngingundunankulu kwakunophiko iYouth Desk, olwangenza ngabona ukuthi intsha iyazimisela uma inikwe ithuba. Ngifundile nokuthi ukuxhasa akudingi ube ngusomabhizinisi kodwa noma ngubani angalwenza ushintsho, yingakho nami ngisungule le nhlangano,” kuchaza uMchunu. Uthe ngesikhathi ekwezemfundo bekumphatha kabi ukubona izingane ziphasa ngamalengiso kodwa ziswele imali yokufunda. Uveze ukuthi ubenxenxa osomabhizinisi nezinkampani ezizimele ukuthi zibaxhase. “Sihlale phansi nomkami ngoba sobabili sasingothisha, sabheka ukuthi singasiza kanjani,” kusho uMchunu. Uthe kule nhlangano abazokhetha intsha yalesi sifundazwe kuphela kodwa nakuzwelonke. UMchunu uthe kunebhodi lenhlangano okuyilona elizokhetha intsha edinga usizo. Uthe uzobheka nalabo asebeyeke ukufunda ngoba beswele imali nentsha efuna ukuqala amabhizinisi. Kulo mdlalo uMchunu ubehamba nomkakhe naye obedlala igalofu. UMchunu utshele Isolezwe ukuthi akakabi ngungoti osezingeni likaTiger Woods kulo mdlalo, uthe uyathanda ukudlala igalofu uma engekho emsebenzini. Uhlabe ikhwelo kubo bonke osomabhizinisi ukuthi basize noma yikuphi lapho bengalekelela khona ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile entsheni. Emuva komdlalo uMchunu nosomabhizinisi babe nesidlo, naso ebesiyingxenye yokuqokelela imali yokusiza intsha. Inhlangano wayisungula ngo-2014 kodwa ike yangasebenza kahle njengoba isiqala izinhlelo zokusiza abafundi.

Ngikholwa, ngizolwayo nga-sebenziselo noma izimvume zabhizinisi ezintsha zoku-sebenza ezikhishwe mhla lu-1 kuNtulikazi nazo zabhizinisi kuze kube mhla zingama-31 kuZibandlela 2022, futhi ngikho imali oku zomele uyikhokhele le layisense.

Sizodedela amaphoyisa enze umsebenzi wawo ukuze sithole kahle ukuthi bekwenzenjani,’’ kusho uMazibuko.Kwesinye isigameko ikhansela le-ANC emkhandlwini uMsunduzi ebelibuye libe umholi oqavile esifundeni iMoses Mabhida, nalo lisocongwe ngobusuku obufanayo. UGWETSHWE udilikajele eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu owesilisa ona-29 owayefunda eDurban University of Technology (DUT) owashiya izifundo wayoba yisigebengu.UMsizi Mbutho ugwetshwe ngecala lokubulala isitshudeni uSandile Ndhlovu (18), obenza unyaka wokuqala kwi-Industrial Engineering kusona lesi sikhungo. Umufi wayefunda ophikweni lwaseSteve Biko, eThekwini ngoSepthemba 9, lapho ashaywa khona ekhanda ngesando ngaphambi kokuthi abanjwe inkunzi.Likhipha isigwebo, iJaji uKhosi Hadebe, lithe akusaphephile kunoma yisiphi isikhungo semfundo “kusuka esikoleni samabanga aphansi kuze kufike emanyuvesi”.Ekhuluma ngaphandle kwenkantolo sekukhishwe isigwebo, uyise kamufi, uMnuz Sibusiso Ndhlovu (45) uthe bachitha izinsuku ezingu-10 eceleni kombhede kaSandile e-ICU bethandazela isimangaliso.“Satshelwa ngoSepthemba 10, ukuthi ingqondo yakhe ngeke isaphinde isebenze futhi salulekwa ukuba simkhiphe emishinini emgcine ephila. Sacela isikhathi esengeziwe futhi sathandazela ukuthi alulame ekulimaleni ekhanda. Ngangingakholwa ukuthi ukuphela kwengane esasinayo ayisekho. Manje ngibona sengathi akukho okungikhuthaza ukuthi ngiye emsebenzini ngoba ngisebenze kanzima ukuqinisekisa ikusasa eliqhakazile kuye,” kusho uNdhlovu.Into eyayinzima kakhulu kuye kwakuyilapho indodana yakhe ingasabizwa ngegama layo kodwa ikhonjwa ngenombolo, idluliswa isuka kwamanye amakhaza iyiswa kwamanye.“Usuku lo mame, usuku lobaba noKhisimusi ngeke kusaphinde kufane ngaphandle kwakhe.”Lo mndeni, odabuka eMpumalanga, kaweneme ngalesi sigwebo, ngoba uthi ngeke siyibuyise indodana. Yize kunjalo kodwa ukhululekile ngokuthi icala lifinyelele emaphethelweni.UMbutho, odabuka eClermont, obephume ngoshwele ejele ngamacala okugqekeza izindlu ngo-2014, waya eDUT wahlasela umufi kabili ngesando weba iselula yakhe ne-laptop.Inkantolo izwe ukuthi wake waba ngumfundi oqavile, owaqeda * -matric ngamalengiso, waya eDUT ukuyokwenza izifundo zeSocial Science kodwa wazishiya ngemuva kokuba sengozini yemoto lapho aphuka imilenze yomibili. Walulama ngokuphelele, yilapho-ke aqala khona ubugebenguNgeledlule uMbutho uvume icala lokubulala uSandile. Encwadini yokuvuma icala, efundwe ngummeli wakhe * -Irshad Khan, uMbutho uthe waya eDUT eyontshontsha “noma yiziphi izinto ezikhala kahle”.“Ngikwenze lokhu ngenxa yokuphelelwa yithemba ngoba ngingasebenzi, ngingenamali futhi ngingenamathemba omsebenzi ongangingenisela imali,” kusho incwadi yakhe.UKhan ucele inkantolo icubungule isimo sikaMbutho, ibheke ukushonelwa uyise esafunda kanti unina washona ngonyaka wakhe wokuqala efunda eDUT.Ummeli woMbuso, uMnuz Bonginkosi Mbokazi, ukuchithile lokhu wathi uMbutho wanikezwa ithuba lesibili empilweni ngenkathi enikwa ushwele emuva kokugwetshwa ngaphambilini.“Uneminyaka engu-29, ufundile futhi uhlakaniphile. Kwakufanele azi kangcono.Irekhodi lakhe lezemfundo likhombisa ukuthi uhlakaniphile ngokwanele ukuthi azi ukuthi lokho akwenzile bekungalungile.”Uthe isenzo sikaMbutho asithetheleleki futhi akekho umzali okufanele adlule kulokhu abazali bakaSandile abadlule kukho.UMnuz Alan Khan, okhulumela iDUT, uthe bakhululekile ukuthi ubulungiswa benziwe nokuthi uMbutho utholwe enecala lokuhlasela okunobudlova ngakwenza kuSandile.“Yize sazi ukuthi lokhu ngeke kumbuyise uSandile, siyethemba ukuthi umndeni wakhe, abangani nalabo abefunda nabo bazoduduzwa wulwazi lokuthi umsolwa ubanjiwe, wagwetshwa ngempumelelo futhi wagwetshwa ngokufanele ngokuhlasela okunonya. Sengathi umphefumulo kaSandile ungaphumula ngokuthula,” kusho uKhan.

text: UMBUZO: Ngishade ngo-2015 nomyeni wami ngenqubo yasesontweni yokuthi akujolwa futhi asibonani size sishade. Iqiniso lithi angazi ngaluthwa yini kulo muntu. Akasiyo nhlobo le nto engangiyifisa empilweni yami. Akanakho nokukodwa nje okungijabulisayo.Lokhu ngaqala ukukuzwa ezinsukwini ezimbalwa nje sishadile, ngabekezela ngoba ngithi mhlambe asikazani kahle. Kodwa kuyangicacela manje ukuthi akusilo ubambo lwami lolu, ngehluleka ngisho ukuzenzisa. Manje useGoli ngokusebenza, uma efikile ngifisa ngabe usehambile. Okubi nje sesinomntwana. Ngifisa ngisho ukuduka nezwe kunokuba kulo mshado kodwa uma ngicabanga ngomntwana wethu ngivele ngihlale. Ngicela ningisize.Igama ligodliwe, eThekwiniIMPENDULO:Uma ushada nomuntu, noma ngabe kungaluphi uhlelo, nishada nobabili senikhulile, ninesipiliyoni sempilo ngokwehlukile. Abekho ababili abashada bese bayanamathelana ngokushesha. Kuthatha isikhathi ukunamathela koshade naye.Akekho noyedwa oshadile, oshade ubambo lwakhe. Sonke njengabashadile sifunda ukunamathela omunye komunye nsuku zonke.Uthando akuyona imizwa kodwa ukuthatha isinqumo nsuku zonke ukuthi uzozinikela ngenhliziyo yakho yonke kulo omganile.Bheka ukuthi yini ngempela ongayithandi ngomyeni wakho, bese nihlala phansi nikhulume. Siqinisekile ukuthi kukhona naye angakuthandi ngawe, ngoba sonke njengabantu asimsulwa.Ukuhlala nomuntu nithandane nize nihlukaniswe ukufa isinqumo ozithathela sona wena wedwa kuqala. Uthatha lesi sinqumo wethembise ukuthi uzomthanda lo oshade naye ngaphandle kokunaka amaphutha akhe. Usuke unquma ukuthi ubudlelwano benu bomshado buyobuswa yintethelelo, ukuthula nokwethembana. Ukuthanda umuntu akuzenzekeli, kuyasetshenzwa.UMBUZO:Sesineminyaka cishe ewu-9 sashada. Ngagana indoda emadodeni, sabusiswa nangezingane ezimbili. Akakaze angihluphe ngalutho. Uyena kuphela osebenzayo, njengoba savumelana ukuthi mina nginakekele izingane nomuzi wethu. Wenza konke engicabanga ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe yindoda.Inkinga nje ukuthi nginesizungu emshadweni wami. Ngazinikela kuye nakulo mshado ngale ndlela yokuthi yonke impilo yami ingomyeni nabantwana bami. Anginampilo ngaphandle kwabo. Akukho engingakwenzi ukujabulisa wonke umuntu la ekhaya. Kodwa mina angisenawo awami amaphupho, futhi loku kungiphatha kabi. Ngicela ningisize.Londiwe, eThekwiniIMPENDULO:Akuve kulula ukuzibona usugwinywe umshado unganakile. Loku kwenzeka kakhulu kubantu besifazane ngoba bangabantu abazinikelayo sidalo. Kuyinto enhle ukuthi uyayibona le nkinga kusemanje.Kufanele uzinikele umshadweni wakho ngokuphelele kodwa ungazikhohlwa phela nawe. Qala ngokuthi kube nelanga nje elilodwa lakho esontweni lapho wenza khona noma yini oyithandayo eqondene nawe. Kungaba ukuyozivocavoca noma ukuya ekhaya kini uyobonana nabakini owaziyo ukuthi bayakuthanda. Zijwayeze ukuba nesikhathi esithi wena. Uma wawunabangani ngaphambi kokushada qala uvuselele lobo bungani. Kuyingozi enkulu ukulahlekelwa impilo yakho usesemshadweni ngezinhloso zokujabulisa umyeni wakho.Hlala phansi uvuselele konke okwakuyiphupho lakho. Kungaba ukuqhubeka nezifundo, ukuqala ibhizinisi noma ukubuyela emsebenzini nje. Cabangisisa nokuthi, njengoba ungasasebenzi nje, wawuyingxenye engakanani ekuthatheni leso sinqumo? Olayini kabanciphi ngoba kusukela ekuseni bekugcwele. Besicabanga ukuthi bambalwa abazothenga sekuzovulwa izikole ngoba bathenga nangoDisemba,” kusho uSalie.Uthe bayazama ukusheshisela abathengi ngoba banabasebenzi abangaphezu kuka-100, abanye abaqashelwe itoho ukuze babhekane nomthamo wesikhathi sokuba matasa.“Sandise nonogada ukuze sigweme isiminyaminya. Sicele namaphoyisa ukuthi alekelele ukuqinisa ezokuphepha. Siyazi ukuthi uma kugcwele nezigebengu zithola ithuba lokubamba inkunzi,” kusho uSalie.USalie uthe namuhla bazovula ngaphambi kwesikhathi esijwayelekile ekuseni ukwenzela abazali abazobe bezoqedela ukuthenga njengoba kuvulwa izikole.

text: UTHELEKELWE wumphakathi ngamabhodlela nangezibhakela owesilisa waseMachobeni ngaseLindelani, ngemuva kokuvela kokuthi uvezele izingane ezisencane izithombe zocansi.Lo wesilisa esingeke silidalule igama lakhe njengoba engakasho ukuthi uyalivuma noma uyaliphika icala, kuthiwa ubebiza izingane zamantombazane ezingomakhelwane athi uyazithuma, agcine ngokuzivalela endlini ezibukisa izithombe zocansi, esebenzisa i-lap top yakhe.Indaba idalulwe yintombazane eneminyaka ewu-13, evele yasho ngengila kwaphuma omakhelwane.Ngokuthola kwaleli phephandaba, umphakathi uphimile kwahlatshwa umkhosi, watitinywa owesilisa ngaphambi kokubizelwa amaphoyisa.Unina wentombazane esho ngengila, uthe indodakazi yakhe imtshele ukuthi into eyimemezisile wukubona into engakaze iyibone.“Udinga ukwelulekwa ngokomqondo ngoba bekumele ayobhala namhlanje esikoleni, sahamba sayokhuluma nothisha ukuthi sibona engakulungele selokhu kwenzeke le nto kuyena,” kusho unina wale wentombazanyana eyenza uGrade 7 kwesinye sezikole eLindelani.Unina ucele ukuba indodakazi yakhe izikhulumele ngokwenzekile.“Bengikha amapentshisi kwesinye sezihlahla...uphumile endlini wangitshela ukuthi nguyena ogade abantshontsha amapetshisi.Ngixolisile mina, wabe esethi angingene endlini yakhe. Ngingene wabe esevala umnyango, wathi angizobuka kwi-lap top yakhe. Kuvele abantu abebenza ucansi,” kusho intombazanyana.Iqhube ithe umsolwa uyibuze iminyaka yayo yobudala, okuthe uma imtshela, wayesethi kuhle-ke ngoba isikhulile.Ngemuva kwalesi sehlakalo, kuvele nezinye izingane ezimbili nazo ezitshele abaphenyi becala ukuthi zike zabukiswa izithombe zocansi nguyena umsolwa.Owesilisa osolwayo kuthiwa uhlala nengane yentombazane eneminyaka emibili. Ngokwelinye ilungu lomphakathi, kuthe uma bembuza ukuthi uphi unina wengane, wabatshela ukuthi uyobeletha esibhedlela.Unina wengane okukhulunywe naye, uthe ubonga uNkulunkulu ngokuthi indodakazi yakhe ayidlwengulwanga.“Siyile kodokotela bafike baqinisekisa ukuthi akakaze adlwengulwe,” kusho unina wentombazanyana.Kunezinsolo zokuthi ziningi nezinye izingane okungenzeka ukuthi zike zabukiswa izithombe zocansi.“Siyasola nokuthi nale ngane yakhe ahlala nayo hleze nayo uyihlukumeza ngokocansi,” kusho umzali ophumele obala.Ugogo wengane ebihlala nowesilisa kuthiwa ufikile khona izolo wazoyilanda.Amanye amalungu omphakathi athe afuna kungenele nenkosi yendawo ukuze umlisa adingiswe nasendaweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe amaphoyisa aseNanda abophe owesilisa (33) ngecala lokukhombisa izingane izithombe zocansi.Uthe owesilisa osolwayo uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi eNtuzuma izolo, bekungakacaci ukuthi uyitholile yini ibheyili.“Kuthiwa ngoNovemba 6 umsolwa udobele endlini yakhe owesifazane oneminyaka engu-13 lapho afike khona wamdlalela ama- video ocansi, wamphoqa ukuthi akawabuke,” kusho uCol Thembeka Mbele.

Ngenxa yalokhu umasipala uyaphenya ukuthi isalmonella okuyigciwane elitholakala ekudleni okungaphekiwe, belisemaqandeni yini nokuthi ngempela lezi zakhamuzi ziguliswe wukudla okunalo yini. UMnuz Rowan Holt wenkampani ekhiqiza iBarn Eggs ephakela izitolo zakwaSpar uthe uphenyo lwesikhashana luveza ukuthi leli gciwane alikho emaqandeni abo kodwa wathi bazobambisana nabenza ucwaningo. UKUSHODELWA yimali yokuthenga abaqwayizi kuholele ekutheni umfundisi osindisiwe adlwengule izingane zamantombazane ezingaphezu kuka-15, ezineminyaka esukela kwewu-3 kuya kwewu-12, emijondolo yaseLouisiana ePort Shepstone. Lezi zindaba zidalulwe wumndeni walo mfundisi, uThokozani Mvalelwa (34), ogwetshwe yiNkantolo yesiFunda yasePort Shepstone odilikajele abahlanu ngemuva kokuzivumela yena ukuthi ubedlwengula laba bantwana qede ababonge ngamaphakethe ama-chips noR2. Yize uMvalelwa, odabuka eLusikisiki, e-Eastern Cape, etshele inkantolo ukuthi zingaphezu kuka-15 izingane azidlwengula, kodwa kwafakaza ezinhlanu kuphela. Inkantolo ithole ukuthi lo mfundisi wadlwengula lezi zingane ezingomakhelwane phakathi kukaJuni no-Okthoba ka-2016. Imikhuba yalo mfundisi yavela ngesikhathi umzali wengane yentombazane eno-6, ethi uthuma indodakazi yakhe esitolo kanti izohlangana noMvalelwa, wayithatha wayiyisa endlini yakhe yomxhaso lapho ayidlwengulela khona maqede wayivala umlomo ngoR2. Ekhuluma neSolezwe ngoMgqibelo unina wale ntombazane, uthe wathi uma ezwa le mihlola wayobikela ikomiti. “Wafike wazivumela yena ukuthi wayidlwengula ingane yami futhi wathembisa ukuthi uzohlawula ngenkukhu. Waveza nokuthi ziningi izingane abezibiza bese elala nazo,” kusho lo mama elifihliwe igama lakhe ukuvikela ingane. Uthe izingane zonke zayiswa esibhedlela lapho odokotela bafike bakuqinisekisa ukuthi nebala zadlwengulwa. Ilungu leCommunity Policing Forum (CPF), uMnuz Simon Mthembu uthe babe sebebiza amaphoyisa ukuba ambophe uMvalelwa njengoba amanye amalungu omphakathi ayesefuna ukumudla amfele futhi efuna anqunyiswe okwembuzi. “Sathi uma simbuza ukuthi wayezidlwengulelani izingane ezincane kanje, wathi ubeswele imali yokuthenga abaqwayizi,” kusho uMthembu othi uMvalelwa ubaziwa njengekholwa ebelikhonze ukuzidumisela iNkosi kuphela. Le ndaba yaziwa ngisho nayizingane ezincane zaseLouisiana njengoba nasejoyintini lendawo isabhungwa. NoNksz Phumzile Khawula, oyisihlobo sikaMvalelwa, uthe naye wamtshela ukuthi usuke waphelelwa amatoho, wangabe esakwazi ukuthenga abaqwayizi. Eqhuba uNksz Khawula uthe uMvalelwa waqala wasonta eZayoni ngaphambi kokuyothwasa. “Indaba yonakala ngesikhathi esethi usindisiwe ngoba ubesenza nezinto ezingaqondakali. Wazivumela yena kimina ukuthi nonina wayemdlwengula njengoba egcine eshonile. Nezingane zezihlobo zakhe ubezidlwengula nje. Kukhona nje neyakithi ayidlwengula,” kusho uNksz Khawula. Umama (47) wengane eno-10 uthe wubulwane obenziwe nguMvalelwa ezinganeni zabo ngoba eziningi ziphazamisekile engqondweni futhi azisenzi kahle ezifundweni zazo esikoleni sendawo iLouisiana Primary. UMnuz Thozamile Zomba, obengumakhelwane kaMvalelwa, uthe naye waqala wangakholwa esezwa ukuthi uMvalelwa wenze la manyala. “Ngahluleka ngisho esezivumela yena kodwa ngangingakholwa. Uze wagwetshwa nje ngingakholwa ngoba ubewumntwana ohloniphayo obekhonze ukusonta. Ubungaze umfake nasekhukhwini. Ubehlale engungwe yizingane, kungasoli muntu,” kusho uZomba. Onina bezingane bathe nakuba benelesekile yisigwebo kodwa okwenziwa wuMvalelwa ezinganeni zabo kuyisihluku esingefaniswe.
Lo mkhankaso kuhloswe ngawo ukudingida ukuphulwa kwemithetho kwamanje, nokulandela imikhawulo yamanzi, futhi uqondiswe ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni eziwasha izimoto ngokungekho emthethweni.

UMBUZO: Mhla zingu-30 kule nyanga ngizobe ngihlanganisa iminyaka engu-65 kanti kuzobe sekuyisikhathi sokuya empeshenini. Ngizobe ngiqeda iminyaka engu-42 nezinyanga ezinhlanu ngisebenzela uhulumeni. Sonke isikhathi ngisebenza bengikhokha imali nyanga zonke kwi-GEPF - isikhwama sempesheni sabasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngishadile kanti umhlomulo wami wempesheni uzoba iholo lesibili. Nginemali engiyilondolozile kodwa ngihlela ukungayikhiphi ingakapheli iminyaka emihlanu emuva kokuya empeshenini. Ngihlela ukusebenza izinsuku ezimbalwa ngesonto, ukuze ngikwazi ukuqhubeka nokuhola. Kubukeka ngingeke ngiwuswele umsebenzi. Ngingakhetha kokubili; ukuya empeshenini noma ukwesula emsebenzini. Kepha iningi lozakwethu likhetha ukwesula emsebenzini, lithathe isamba semali kunokuhola impesheni nyanga zonke. Isizathu salokhu wukuthi kungenzeka imali yesikhwama seGEPF isetshenziswe ukutakula iminyango kahulumeni edonsa kanzima. Ukukhula kwemibono mayelana nenkohlakalo kuleli kubhebhethekisa ungabazane. Impendulo: Ukuze ukwazi ukuthola izeluleko ezigcwele kubalulekile ukuqonda kabanzi ngesimo sakho sezimali. Lokhu kubandakanya impahla, izindleko, iholo lazinyanga zonke, intela, isimo sakho sokutshala imali, uhlelo lwefa nokunye. Kuyaye kuhlelwe ngokwezidingo nesimo sakho. Uma ingekho le mniningwane lesi seluleko sizokubeka esithombeni uma ukhetha ukwesula emsebenzini okanye uthathe impesheni. Ukuya empeshenini: Ibhonasi, phecelezi i-13th cheque, ungayilondoloza ukuze kunyuke isamba semali eminyakeni emihlanu. Kuhle ukuba nomshwalense wokungcwaba wenani lika-R7500 kepha kungenzeka ukuba ungeneli izindleko zomgcwabo, itshe nokunye. Kungamele wengeze imali. Imali ekhokhelwa ikhefu inezindleko zentela kepha awulahlekelwa uma wesula emsebenzini. Isibonelelo somshwalense wezempilo sika-R2 159 ngenyanga, ekhuphuka ngonyaka, sikhokhwa impilo yakho yonke. Uma udlula emhlabeni ingakapheli iminyaka emihlanu, umuntu oshade naye uzoqhubeka nokuthola imali bese kuthi emuva kweminyaka emihlanu ahole * -50% wempesheni yakho. Ezinye izimali ziyacwila. Isamba semali yempesheni esingu-R500 000, nangaphansi, asikhokhelwa intela. Ngokwemigomo yezomsebenzi, ingxenye yemali yempesheni ngeke ibe nezindleko zentela ngokomgomo ka-31 March 1998. text: INDODA eyabulala inkosikazi iyisola ngokuthi iqomile, iyala abesilisa ababhekene nesimo esifanayo ukuba bangababulali kodwa bebashiye ukugwema ukubhadla ejele njengaye odonsa iminyaka engu-14.UMnuz Thokozani Malloy (48) waKwaNzimakwe ngasePort Edward ugwetshwe ngoMeyi 2016, wanikezwa iminyaka engu-12 ngecala lokubulala uNkk Ntokozo Malloy neminyaka emibili ngelokusabisa indodana yakhe eyayingufakazi ecaleni lokubulala.UNkk Malloy wabulawa ngo-Disemba 2014.Lezi zithandani ezatholana zisafunda isikole ngo-1992 zase zishada ngo-2000, zaba nabantwana abathathu.UMalloy owayeyiphoyisa lomgwaqo ePort Shepstone esesebenze iminyaka engu-20, eseqedile ngempilo yenkosikazi yakhe naye wazama ukuzibulala ngokuzidubula ekhanda, inhlamvu yaphaphalaza yaphuma neso lakhe.Emuva kokwanda kwezigameko zabesifazane ababulawa abathandana nabo, Isolezwe libe nengxoxo ekhethelekile noMalloy ejele laseWestville lapho egwetshwe khona.“Ngifunde okukhulu ngesinqumo esingesihle engasenza sokubulala inkosikazi wami ngoba ngithola ukuthi uyajola. Engifisa ukukutshela abantu besilisa wukuthi uma bezithola kulesi simo, ukubulala umuntu othandana naye akusona isixazululo ngoba ubulala umuntu uphinde umoshe nempilo yakho neyomndeni wakho. Uma kunzima kungcono umshiye phansi ungaze wenze ozozisola ngakho,” kusho uMalloy.Uthe wayengakaze acabange ukuthi empilweni yakhe angathatha isibhamu abulale umuntu amthandayo.“Sihlalile sithandana nonkosikazi, saze sashada konke kuhamba kahle. Ngo-2010 izinto ziqalile ukungahambi kahle. Ngaphenya ngo-2013 ngigcine ngitholile ukuthi kunomuntu athandana naye. Ngabheka kwiselula yakhe emuva kokuba omunye umngani wakhe wesifazane engitshelile ukuthi impela unesoka. Ngabona izingqoxo nesoka lakhe kuWhatsApp, saxoxa kwaba sengathi kuyadlula,” kusho uMalloy.Uthe ukuba nolaka nenhliziyo encane ehambisana nokudinwa into ayevele enayo kodwa engazitsheli ukuthi kungaze kufike ekubulaleni umuntu.“Izinkinga phakathi kwami nonkosikazi zaqhubeka, ngo-2014 saze sahlala ngokuhlukana. Kwaze kwaba kufika lapho ngihluleka khona ngoDisemba ngaya kubo ngiyoxoxa naye ngendaba yomshado wethu. Saxabana ngavele ngakhipha isibhamu, wabaleka waya emzini kadadewabo lapho engafika ngamdubulela khona nami ngazidubula,” kusho uMalloy.Uthe akazi wasinda kanjani ngoba wayethi uyaqeda ngempilo yakhe.“Namanje kusangimangaza ukuthi ngaphila kanjani ngoba ngangizibulala. Ngaphaphama esibhedlela emuva kwesikhathi kwenzeke lokhu. Abantu abase bengitshela ukuthi kwenzekani endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uMalloy.Ngenxa yesimo sakhe sempilo uze wagwetshwa ngoMeyi 2016, ngemuva kokuphuma engena ezibhedlela.“Ukubulala kwami unkosikazi kwangilahlekisela ngomsebenzi, nomndeni wami njengoba ngingakwazi ukuhlala nezingane zethu ezineminyaka engu-22, 17 neneyisishiyagalombili. Ukuba nenhliziyo encane, nokudinwa akubuyiseli ngalutho. Abantu besilisa kumele bafunde ukulawula imizwa yabo, kungabi iyona ebalawulayo,” kusho uMalloy.Uthe ukungena ejele kuningi okumfundise khona njengoba efunde ngendlela yokulawula ukudinwa nendlela yokuziphatha nje.“Ngesikhathi sengenza lokhu angizange ngicabange ukuthi ngiwubaba ezinganeni zami, ziyangidinga. Angikucabanganga futhi nokuthi uma sengibulele unina, zizosala nobani uma sengiboshiwe njengoba ngisejele manje. Isinqumo osithatha ungacabanganga siyingozi,” kweluleka uMalloy.Uphinde wagcizelela ukuthi amadoda angempela awabahlukumezi abesifazane.“Indoda yangempela ayimhlukumezi umuntu wesifazane. Ayimshayi umuntu wesifazane. Induku ayakhi, ngiyazi sikhule kuthiwa uyakhiwa ngenduku kodwa lokho akusilona iqiniso. Ukuxoxa nokubonisana yikhona okwakhayo uma uthi uyindoda,” kusho uMalloy.Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi sewaxolisa kubantwana bakhe yize kwakuyinto enzima kakhulu ngoba babengafuni nokumbona.

Umngani wakhe uSandile Shange naye ongumgijimi, uthe bazijabule ngezindaba ezimnandi ngoba uGwala ubekhathazeke ngokuthi ngeke esakwazi ukugijima.“Odokotela bathe konke kuhambe kahle kodwa kusazothatha isikhathi ukuthi imilenze iphole ngoba kuthinteke nemisipha. Siyathemba sizombona esengcono namuhla (izolo).”Kushaye isikhathi sokuloba usaqhubeka umkhankaso wokunikelela uGwala izindleko zokumelapha, umnikelo obusifinyelele kuR400 000. UKHOLELWA ekutheni asikho isifundo nomkhakha ongeke ufundwe ngolimi lwesintu, owesifazane ohlonishwe ngendondo ngamagalelo okuqhakambisa izilimi zesintu. UNkk Muhle Sibisi ofundisa emkhakheni wakwaHumanities e-University of KwaZulu-Natal (UKZN), uhlonishwe ngeYoung Linguist Award emcimbini weminyaka engu-20 we-International Congress of Linguists. Bekuqala ukuthi lo mcimbi ubanjelwe kuleli selokhu wasungulwa njengoba ububanjelwe eKapa. UNkk Sibisi ohola nohlelo lwezilimi kwiSchool of Arts, khona e-UKZN, uthe ukuhlabana kwakhe ngale ndondo kusho ukuthi uyabonakala umkhankaso wokuqhakambisa izilimi zesintu. “Umkhankaso wokuqhakambisa izilimi zesintu akuyona into yakuleli kuphela kodwa eyawo wonke amazwe. Ngisho abe-Unesco bayakukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwalezi zilimi. Ukuthola kwami le ndondo kusho ukuthi nowethu umkhankaso uyabonakala. Izilimi zethu zanyathelwa kakhulu ngenxa yomlando wobandlululo, okuyimanje sizama ukulungisa lowo monakalo.” Kusho yena. Uthe zonke izifundo ngisho ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme kumele zifundwe ngezilimi zesintu. Uveze ukuthi e-UKZN sebeqalile ukusebenzisa amanye amatemu ezilimi zesintu abaqhamuke nawo. “Awukho umkhakha noma izifundo ezingeke zingafundeki ngezilimi zesintu. Uma sebefuna ukusigxeka laba abangafuni siqhakambise izilimi zethu, basishaya ngokuthi kunamatemu angeke asebenziseke kahle esiZulwini. Okuhle ukuthi ezinye izilimi ziyahambelana, kungabolekwa amagama ukwakha amanye amatemu. Awekho amagama angeke atholakele uma sizimisele, ngisho emkhakheni wezomthetho nowezesayensi.” Echaza. UNkk Sibisi osefundise iminyaka emine e-UKZN, kumanje wenza iPhD lapho enza khona ucwaningo ngezilimi zesintu. Ucwaninga ukuthi amatemu esiZulu aseqalile ukusetshenziswa kulesi sikhungo ayazisiza yini izitshudeni ukuthi ziqonde kangcono ezifundiswa kona ngolimi lwazo. Ukuthabana kwakhe ngendondo kunezelwe nayindlela alwethule kahle ngayo ucwaningo obeluhambisana nokukhuthaza izitshudeni zale nyuvesi ukuthi zihaye izinkondlo zisebenzisa amatemu emikhakha yemfundo ezikuyo. UNkk Sibisi ubonge umphathi wakhe uSolwazi Heike Tappe, athe nguye omkhuthazayo emsebenzini wakhe kulesi sikhungo. I-international Congress of Linguist yasungulwa ngo-1928 kanti izingcithabuchopho zezilimi zamazwe ahlukene ziyahlangana njalo eminyakeni eyisihlanu ukubhunga ngezokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi.

text: ZINGASE zivalwe ezinye zezikole okuvalwe ngehlahla kwangaphasa ngisho umfundi oyedwa ku-matric KwaZulu-Natal ngo-2018 ngoba ezinye zazo bezinomfundi oyedwa obhalile.UMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni uzobizela esigcawini othishanhloko balezi zikole ukuthi bazochaza ngemiphumela engemihle abayitholile. Sinyukile isibalo sezikole okungaphasanga muntu kuzona ngo-2018 njengoba ziyisishiyagalolunye zisuka kwezintathu ngo-2017.Okhulumela umnyango uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa, uthe bazobiza nothishanhloko bezikole ezithole ngaphansi kuka-60% ukuze kucutshungulwe imiphumela yalezi zikole. Uthe kulezi eziyisishiyagalolunye ezithole u-0% asikho esango-2017 okwakungaphasanga muntu kusona, yizikole ezintsha.“Lezi ezintathu ezazithole u-0% azikho kulezi eziyisishiyagalolunye zangonyaka odlule okungaphasanga muntu kuzona. Ezinye zalezi ezithole u-0% bezinesibalo esincane sabafundi ababhalile njengoba kwesinye ubeyedwa kwesinye bebane. Abazali kumele babambisane nathi uma sifuna ukuvala isikole ngoba ezinye zezingqinamba uma sifuna ukuhlanganisa izikole noma sivale ezinye ngukuthi abazali bayanqaba,” kusho uMlotshwa. Uthe basuke befuna ukuzivala ngoba basuke sebenze ucwaningo olunzulu wathi abamane nje bavuke sebevala isikole.“Nakulezi kukhona okubonakalayo ukuthi azisebenzi ngakho kudingeka ukuthi zivalwe, zihlanganiswe nezinye kodwa sizoxoxa nemiphakathi ethintekayo. Sizokwakha uhlelo lokuphucula imiphumela yalezi zikole ngoba sifuna ukuqeda ngezikole ezithola ngaphansi kuka-0%.”UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane, wayethe ufuna ukuqeda ngezikole ezithola u-0% kulesi sifundazwe. Zingu-12 ezweni lonke izikole okungaphasanga muntu kuzona ngo-2018.Esinye sazo yiMpikayizekanye Secondary ebinabafundi abangu-18. Lesi sikole sike sangena ehlazweni lokukopela kwabafundi ngo-2014. Umnyango waqinisa kakhulu ezikoleni ezathinteka ekukopeleni kwabafundi ngokuthi kube nabantu abazozinza kuzona kuze kuqala ukubhala kwezivivinyo zize ziphothulwe.Ezinye zezikole ezithinteka ekukopeleni kubalwa iMaweni High, Mzoniwe High okubhale kuyo abayisishiyagalombili, Ncwecwe Secondary okubhale abafundi ababili, Nende Secondary okubhale abafundi abangu-10, Sbonginhlanhla Secondary okubhale umfundi oyedwa, Groenvlei Combined okubhale abafundi abayisishiyagalombili, Vuleka School for the Deaf okubhale abane naKwaMpunzi Combined okubhale abafundi abayisikhombisa.

Leli komiti lithi mithathu imicimbi eyahlelwa, uwodwa wabiza uR4 million.USihlalo waleli komiti uMnuz Themba Godi, ugxeke ukungalandelwa kwemigudu efanele ngesikhathi kusebenza imali engaka ngomcimbi owodwa.KuR4 million kuthiwa kwaqashwa itende ngoR485 000, izindlu zangasese ngoR490 000, ukuhlobisa izihlalo ngoR487 000, okokwendlala phansi etendeni ngoR482 000, ukuphekela izicukuthwane kwaba nguR493 000, izinto zokuthutha kwaba nguR493 000, i-sound system yaba nguR492 000, kwathi izipho zaba nguR480 000.Isikhulu seSassa esasibambile uNksz Pearl Bhengu kuthiwa uyagula ngakho akakwazanga ukufika azochazela ikomiti izolo ePhalamende.“UNksz Bhengu waphuthuma ukugunyaza le micimbi, wakwenza lokhu ngaphandle kokufuna ama-quotations amathathu okuyinto edingekayo. Kuyacaca ukuthi kwanyuswa imali kule micimbi,” kusho uGodi.Uthe ibamba lesikhulu esiphezulu uMnuz Abraham Mahlangu, noNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi uNksz Susan Shabangu bazibophezele ekutheni zizothathelwa izinyathelo izikhulu ezithintekayo nemali izobuyiswa uma kunesidingo sokuthi ibuye.“Sinxuse uNkk Mahlangu ukuthi ayibheke indaba yonogada abanikwa uNksz Bhengu kusuka ngo-2012 nemali eyasebenza kulokhu. Sizoyibheka eyokuthi ngelanga esiyophonsa ngayo imibuzo le nhlangano kube nomnyango kamgcinimafa.”UMnuz Tim Brauteseth, okhulumela iDA kwiScopa, uthe bazobhalela uNksz Shabangu ukuze kuthathelwe izinyathelo ngokushesha owayenguNgqongqoshe walo mnyango uNksz Bathabile Dlamini noNksz Bhengu ngokusebenzisa uR16 million ngemicimbi engaqondakali.“Emhlanganweni weScopa kuvele ukuthi uNksz Bhengu wasayina uR16 million ngoDisemba nyakenye ukuze kwenziwe imicimbi yokufundisa kungalandelwanga imigudu efanele.“Baphendula iSassa ibhange labo lokushushumbisa imali ngezinto ezingabasizanga ngalutho abantu abahola imali yempesheni,” kusho uMnuz Brauteseth.Uthe ukususwa kukaNksz Bhengu KwaZulu-Natal akusizi ngoba wenza umonakalo omkhulu wathi kumele amiswe ngokushesha kusenziwa uphenyo, uma etholakala enecala abuyise le mali eyasebenza.

BAKHATHAZEKILE abazali babafundi baseMlazi Com Tech High eMlaza, okuthiwa sebephuthwa ukufunda ngenxa yenkinga yokucishwa kukagesi. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi sekuphele isonto ugesi ungekho kulesi sikole esinabafundi abahlala ngaphakathi. Phezu kokucishwa kukagesi, kuphinde kwaphela namanzi, okwenza ukuthi izingane ezihlala emakubo zisheshe zigodukiswe. Kuthiwa isikole sikweleta uMasipala weTheku imali elinganiselwa kuR4 million. Okukhathaza abazali ukuthi abakaze batshelwe ngale nkinga yesikweletu.Umzali wengane efunda uGrade 9 kodwa engahlali ngaphakathi esikoleni, uthe isimo simanzonzo. Uthe bezwe ngesonto eledlule ukuthi ugesi uphelile. “Sithole ukuthi izingane ezihlala ngaphakathi sezikhanyisa amakhandlela ebusuku, zilale ngesinkwa ngoba akuphekwa. Bazamile abanye abazali ukuyohlola isimo, bavinjwa onogada esangweni.” Umzali onengane ehlala ngaphakathi esikoleni uthe okumphatha kabi kakhulu ukuthi abazi ngokwenzeka ezinganeni zabo. Uthe njengoba izingane zihlala ngaphakathi azivunyelwe ukuphatha amaselula futhi sikaliwe nesikhathi sokuzivakashela. “Ngiphathwa kabi ukuthi zidlani izingane zethu njengoba ugesi ungekho. Sizwe ukuthi ezinye azisayi emakilasini ngoba namanzi okugeza awekho. Kuqale unyaka sibhalisile sangatshelwa lutho ngenkinga. Inkinga ebesiyazi eyokuphuka kwezicabha okwenzeka ngesikhathi kuhlasele umoya ngonyaka odlule,” kusho umzali. Kuthiwa abazali bathunyelelwe uthishanhloko amaSMS ngoLwesithathu ebabikela ngenkinga kagesi, ebatshela nokuthi bayazama ukuyilungisa. Uxolise nangokungasheshi abatshele abazali ngale nkinga. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa, uthe asibaphethe kahle isimo saseComTech. Uthe kukhona abakuhlelayo ukuxazulula le nkinga. UMnuz Mthunzi Gumede, okhulumela ihhovisi leMeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, uthe sekubizwe umhlangano ophuthumayo namuhla ukuxoxa ngalolu daba. Lo mhlangano uphakathi kwemeya nobuholi bomnyango wezemfundo nothishanhloko abathintekayo. Uthe akuyona inhloso yabo ukuthi izikole zicishelwe ugesi futhi bazokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuthi izingane zingaphazamiseki. “Zingu-500 izikole ezikweleta umasipala imali elinganiselwa kuR80 million. Imeya isiyalele ukuthi izikole zingacishelwa ugesi singakatholakali isixaxululo sokukhokha isikweletu ngoba iyikhathalele imfundo. Sinxusa ukuthi izikole esezithikamezekile ukuthi zithintane nomasipala ngokushesha,” kusho uGumede.

ISIMISIWE emsebenzini iMenenja kamasipala waseJozini ngemuva kokukhala kwamakhansela ngo-R11 million osebenze kwakhiwa umgwaqo oyikhilomitha elilodwa eMkhuze nezigidi ezintathu zokulungisa amahhovisi omkhandlu.UMnuz Kuhle Khumalo umiswe ngoMsombuluko ebusuku ngo-9 ngemuva komhlangano wamakhansela obusemini. Umiswa nje bese kuqalwe uphenyo olwenziwa yiMunicipal Public Account Committee (MPAC) oluqalwe ngesonto eledlule.UKhumalo utshele Isolezwe izolo ukuthi akukho okuningi azokusho ngoba usaxhumana nabameli bakhe.“Ngithole i-SMS ngo-9 ebusuku ngoMsombuluko ebingazisa ukuthi sengimisiwe emsebenzini ngakho ngizocela imibuzo uyibhekise kwimeya ngoba mina ngimatasa ngixhumana nabameli bami ngalesi simo,” kusho uKhumalo.Ngesonto eledlule Isolezwe libike ngenkombankombane yaseJozini ephakathi kwamakhansela noKhumalo ngokusebenza kwezigidi zabakhokhi bentela.Amakhansela kaKhongolose nawe-IFP abeshaya amakhala ngemali yokwakha umgwaqo waseMkhuze abasola ukuthi imali yasetshenziswa budedengu.Amakhansela abuye asole uKhumalo ngokuthi “wadla” u-R3 million wokwakha amahhovisi kamasipala.Kuthiwa wanikeza usonkontileka imali umsebenzi ungakakhangiswa.Kuthe uma umsebenzi sekufanele uqale kwavela ukuthi usonkontileka akasakwazi ukuqhubeka ngoba imali idliwe uSars.UKhumalo ngakolunye uhlangothi uyacacisa ukuthi isinqumo sokwakha umgwaqo ngo-R11 million sathathwa emhlanganweni womkhandlu owawungomhla ka-12 Meyi 2017 lapho iMeya, uDelani Mabika, yasayina ukuba kwengezwe u-R3 million ku-R8 million okwakufanele wakhe umgwaqo.UKhumalo usola ukuthi umiselwe ukulwa nenkohlakalo eJozini.FUNDA:Umsindo ngekhilomitha lomgwaqo elibize uR11 millionUveze ngesonto eledlule ukuthi wavula icala koKlebe ukuze baphenye amanye amakhansela ngokunyamalala kuka-R5 million okwakuhlelwe ukuba kwakhiwe izakhiwo ezithile zomphakathi. Le mali kuthiwa yasayinelwa njengesebenzile kodwa izakhiwo azikaze zibe khona.IMeya yaseJozini uMnuz Delani Mabika ithintwa iqale yaba namancoko yathi ivukwa wumoya ngalolu daba.“Ngicela ungithinte emuva kwemizuzwana ngoba ngibheke eHluhluwe emhlanganweni ophuthumayo. Uma ungangithintanga kuqala nami ngizobuyela kuwe,” kusho uMabika.Kuthe ngemuva kwemizuzwana abeyibekile wathintwa kodwa ucingo lwakhe belumatasa. Ngemuva kwalokho beseluvaliwe kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engatholakali.Kwenzeka lokhu nje Isolezwe lithunyelwe umyalezo okhomba ukuthi ubuvela kuKhumalo ewuthumele kubaholi abathile bezombusazwe ebalisa ngesimo abhekene naso.Umyalezo uKhumalo uyawuphika uthi akawazi futhi akekho umholi amthumelele.Kulo myalezo kubhalwe ukuthi: “Laba bantu bafuna ukungimisa emsebenzini bangesulela ngezinto engingazazi. Bagxambukela nasemsebenzini wami. Bafuna kubenabasebenzi engibaxoshayo noma ngibehlise ezikhundleni ukuze kungene abafunwa yibo.”UKhumalo uthe akawazi lo myalezo kanti uqale ukusabalala emasontweni amabili edlule.

MHLELI: Sidinga ukushayelwa ihlombe isimemezelo sikaNgqongqoshe woMnyango wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu- Natal uNkk Weziwe Thusi. Ngokombiko weSolezwe ngoOkthoba 8, 2018 ungqongqoshe ugqugquzele abantu ukuthi bahlele imindeni enkulumeni okuthiwa ayethule ngeWorld Population Day.Empeleni kufanele ngabe bonke abaholi yivangeli abalishumayela ngokukhulu ukukhuthala leli lokukhuthaza abantu ukuhlela umndeni.Ivangeli lokuhlelwa komndeni yinto esiyidinga cishe ukudlula zonke izinto esizolokhu sicefezelwa ngazo njengoba kuza imikhankaso yokhetho maduzane nje. Kuliqiniso elaziwayo ukuthi ububha okuhlasele abantu abamnyama kubuye kubangelwe nayikho ukuzalwa kwezingane kungaziwa nokuthi zizokondleka kanjani.Akusavamisile ukuzwa abantu bekhuluma inkulumo ebaluleke njengalena eyethulwe nguNkk Thusi.Eminyakeni edlule ihhovisi likaNdunankulu wesifundazwe saKwaZulu Natal lamemezela ukuthi linemali eyizigidi elizoyisebenzisa ukulwa nama-blesser. Kuyadabukisa ukusho ukuthi leyo mali kwagcina kungacacanga kahle ukuthi yabe izosetshenziswa kanjani ukuze ihlenge eyabe iphume egameni labo.Mhlawumbe bekungakuhle leyo mali uma kungukuthi isakhona iphinde isetshenziswe ukuphusha imikhankaso yokuqwashisa mayelana nokuhlela umndeni.Yize indaba yokuhlela umndeni ithinta wonke umuntu kodwa kungaba ngumqondo omuhle ukuthi imikhankaso enjalo igxiliswe kakhulu entsheni ikakhulu ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasemijondolo.Ucwaningo lwami lukhomba ukuthi abesilisa nabesifazane abasebasha bathola izingane besafunda isikole. Baqeda isikole noma bashiye phakathi bayosebenza emadolobheni amakhulu bafike bahlale ezindaweni eziyimijondolo nasemahostela baqhubeke nokuthola izingane ngaphandle kokuqondisisa kahle isimo sabo sezomnotho. Nezingane ezisuke zizalelwe ezindaweni ezingahlelekile nazo ziyakhula ziqhubeke nokuzalela khona lapho zikhulele khona.Izingane abazithola edolobheni bazihambisa emakhaya lapho bevela khona. Nakhona emakhaya kusuke kunezingane abazishiye khona abazithola besafunda isikole. Abanye bazigcina khona emadolobheni zikhulele emijondolo ngezizathu ezahlukene.Yize izingane ezizalwe zakhulela emalokishini zizalisana kodwa kuvamise ukuthi emva kokuthola ingane eyodwa zingabe zisaqhubeka nokuzala kuze kube yisikhathi esifanele. Kungalezi zizathu ngithi ukugqugquzelwa kokuhlela umndeni kufanele kuhanjiswe nakakhulu ezindaweni engizibalule ngenhla. Mhlawumbe namabandla amahlelo ahlukene kungakuhle abambisane nezinhlaka zikahulumeni ukuphusha lo mkhankaso.Ngokombiko we-United Nations eminyakeni engu 50 ezayo isibalo sabantu emhlabeni kulindeleke senyukele ku-9 billion. LISHONE elayizolo isematheni indaba yokuzibulala kwesitshudeni ebesiyisishoshovu, okusolwa ukuthi sizibulele. UKhensani Maseko (23), obeyisitshudeni emkhakheni wezomthetho eRhodes University, kusolwa ukuthi uzibulele ngoLwesihlanu emuva kokuphathwa ukhwantalala. Ngokwemiyalezo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kusolwa ukuthi uKhensani ubenokhwantalala ngenxa yokuthi wadlwengulwa yisoka lakhe elikuyona le nyuvesi. Abamaziyo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bathe bezivele zibonakala izimpawu zokuthi uzozibulala. Abaningi bakhale ngokuthi bekumele athole usizo ngoba bekukhombisa ukuthi unengcindezi. Ekhasini lakhe likaTwitter, uKhensani ubesanda kubhala ukuthi ngelinye ilanga uyokhuluma inkulumo eyonyakazisa abaningi. Ubuye wabhala ku-Instagram ukuthi "Kulungile uma kuyintando yakho." Konke lokhu kuhumushwe ngokuthi ubengekho esimeni esihle emqondweni. Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana abanye bamchaze njengesishoshovu ebesiwakhathalele amalungelo ezitshudeni futhi ehlakaniphile. Kuvele nokuthi ubengomunye wabaholi bohlaka lwezitshudeni olumele i-EFF kule nyuvesi. Kuthintwa uNksz Sixolise Gcilisha, osehhovisini lezokuxhumana kwi-EFF, uvumile ukuthi uKhensani ubephambili emzabalazweni wezitshudeni kuleli qembu. Uthe abangaphawula kahle ngaye yilabo abebesebenza naye ophikweni lwezitshudeni enyuvesi, izolo abangatholakalanga ukuphawula. UKhensani ubephinde abe nguSihlalo weRhodes Independent Electoral Board. UMsane bekumele afihlwe ngeSonto kodwa kugcine kungenzekanga abakubo sebelande isidumbu ekhweni.Omunye obekhona kwenzeka lokhu kodwa ongathandanga ukudalulwa uveze ukuthi uMsane unamakhosikazi amabili aziwa umndeni bese kuba khona noNksz Ndlovu owabhala ngasese naye umndeni ungazi.“Ubehlala ekhweni. Kuthe esegula bamphindisela emakhosikazini akhe. Bekuthi uma esesindile bamlande ngoba kudliwa imali yakhe yempesheni nekhadi lokuhola belihlala kumkhwekazi wakhe. Intombi kuyaziwa ngisho endaweni ukuthi bese ikipitile namanje ushone uMsane ingekho izwe ngoba isishayelwa ucingo,” kusho umthombo.NgoMgqibelo ebusuku ngesikhathi kunomlindelo kuthiwa umndeni kamufi awuzange ukhulume lutho ungene waqonda ebhokisini kugcwele amakholwa ecula.“Ngibone sekushaywana, abebepheka baphuma nokudla kwathelwana ngakho. Amakholwa asale ecula, bathatha ibhokisi bahamba nalo kodwa nakhona bebelandelwa amatshe ngemuva. Abanye bahambe belimele nami ngithole imihuzuko,” kusho umthombo.UNkk Ntombi Msane oyilungu lomndeni kamufi uthe baphoqwe yisimo ngoba bebebona ukuthi uMsane uzongcwatshwa ezintabeni.“Ukuba ubenomuzi besizovuma amngcwabe. Sinqaba ngoba unamakhosikazi amabili asemthethweni futhi nekhaya elikhulu likhona lapho engangcwatshwa khona. Siqale emaphoyiseni eMpophomeni, sadlulela enduneni nasekhanseleni sayobika. Silufakile enkantolo udaba sayobika naseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya kwathiwa awukho emthethweni umshado wabo kodwa kuzothatha izinyanga ezimbili ukuthi usulwe. Sibone kukude kakhulu sayolanda isidumbu yize bebesithuka besishaya,” kusho uNkk Msane.Ethintwa uNksz Ndlovu uthe uMsane wamshada engasathandani namakhosikazi akhe.“Wagula wangena esibhedlela abantu bakubo bengamsizi waze wacela ukuthi sithuthe siyohlala ekhaya alungise nempesheni. Kuyiphutha ukuthi bengikipitile, ngiyasebenza ePinetown. Sebenzela ukudicilela igama lami phansi. Kuyimanje umzimba ubuhlungu ngitubekile ngoba kwase kuliwa. Noma bengimthanda umyeni wami kodwa sesithathe isinqumo sokubayeka nesidumbu. Sengigqoke inzilo yize ngingamngcwabanga umyeni wami,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu ekhihla isililo.

USASHAQEKILE umphakathi waseNtshawini, eStanger, ngokubulawa kwabalisa ababili abaklajwe bashiswa ngamalungu omphakathi abebasola ngokuba yizigebengu ezingena emizini yabantu.Kuthiwa uMnuz Thulubheke Thokozani Mdlalose (29) noMnuz Bhekinkosi Mfundeni Msomi (35) bebephuma emsebenzini nozakwabo ababili ngoLwesithathu ebusuku ngesikhathi bevinjwa abantu abebebasola ngokuba yingxenye yezigebengu okuthiwa zihlalise abantu lubhojozi ngokubangenela ezindlini zibaphuce impahla kokunye zidlwengule nabesifazane.Laba bobabili batholakale eMelville izolo ekuseni beshisiwe. Phezu kwabo bekubekwe amathayi, utshani, amapulangwe noplastiki. Kukholakala ukuthi leli qulu libashayile labaklabha lase libahudulela epaki, iHlalanathi nokuyilapho beshiselwe khona.Ngesikhathi izintatheli zaleli phephandaba zifika epaki bekusashunqa intuthu kodwa izidumbu sezithathiwe. Uma bebuzwa abakhelene nepaki ngokwenzekile bebevele bathi abazi lutho futhi ababonanga lutho. Kuze kwaba ngabantu abebehlala esigcemeni obekuhlala kuso laba ababulewe ababhoboke ngokwenzekile.UNksz Thandazile Zulu (25) obehlala egcekeni noMdlalose okuthiwa ungowaseMlaza kodwa ubeqashe eNtshawini, uthe bangqongqozelwe abantu abasebenza naye ekuseni ngo-4 bebika ukuthi sebevinjwe umphakathi waseMelville.UNksz Zulu uthe Mdlalose noMsomi bebesebenza enkontilekeni ebifaka imithangala emgwaqweni. Uthe uzakwabo ubabikele ukuthi bebephantshelwe yisondo lemoto base behamba ngezinyawo benqamula eMelville ngesikhathi bevinjwa yiqulu labantu ebelingalawuleki.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi, uNksz Sinenhlanhla Xhakaza, lithe namanje basashaqekile ngokubulawa kwalaba njengoba libachaze njengabantu abebesebenza bengahluphi muntu. “Kubuhlungu ukubabona bebulawe ngesihluku esinje. Izandla nezinyawo zabo beziboshiwe, omunye eboshwe ngentambo, omunye ngocingo. Iminwe kaMfundeni beyiklajiwe ilenga, unyawo lukaThokozani nalo lulenga.” Uthe kuleya ndawo usukhona umkhuba wokuthi kubulawe abantu ngoba besolwa ngokwenza izenzo zobugebengu noma bengabanjwanga oqotsheni.Ikhansela lendawo uMnuz Vincent Shezi, lithe belisanda kuzwa ngalesi sigameko. Lithe umphakathi uhlushwa yizigebengu kanti sekuvamile ukuthi abantu balinyazwe, abanye babulawe ngoba besolwa ngobugebengu.“Noma sikuqonda ukuthi umphakathi uhleli lubhojozi ngenxa yobugebengu, siyakugxeka ukuthi abantu bazijezisele abantu. Ukubulawa kwabantu baze bashiswe kuwubulwane nobugebengu,” kusho uShezi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, uthe amaphoyisa aphenya amacala amabili okubulala emuva kokutholakala kwabalisa ababili bebulewe. Uthe kusolakala ukuthi laba balisa bashaywe ngamalungu omphakathi abashisa.

text: OWAYENGUNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, oyinhloko yezinhlelo zemikhankaso ye-ANC nelungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uthe uMengameli we-ANC nezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa unikwe umsebenzi wokuthi agxile ekukhuliseni umnotho wezwe ukuze kwakheke amathuba emisebenzi kukhule nezwe.UMchunu uthe lezi ngezinye zezinto okumele zilungiswe ngokushesha ezweni ukuze abantu baphume ebubheni.Ezinye zezinto athe uRamaphosa uyalelwe yinhlangano ukuthi agxile kuzona kakhulu, ukulwa nenkohlakalo, ukubhekana nendaba yobugebengu nokuqeda indlala.“Siyi-ANC sithe nazi izinto mengameli okufanele ugxile kuzona kakhulu kunakuqala, ezinye zazo zibalulekile njengemfundo nezempilo. Umnotho wethu ubungakhuli, ubukhula ngo-0 bani wamaphesenti kodwa manje sesinethemba ngoba usukhula ngo-1%. Liphezulu izinga lokungasebenzi ikakhulu entsheni, okuyinhlekelele,” kusho uMchunu.Ukusho lokhu ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku ngesikhathi kuvaleliswa obenguMengameli weNatu uMnuz Siphosethu Ngcobo obesehole le nyunyana iminyaka engu-18 eNatu Teacher Development Institute eMadadeni.Uthe isiqalile ukuthela izithelo imizamo yokulwa nenkohlakalo njengoba kukhona iKhomishini yeJaji Zondo ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana.“Abantu bayamenyezwa laphaya. Uma ubiziwe yeka ukulokhu uya emaphepheni nakwabezindaba shona khona uyophendula kuyona. Asikwazi ukukusiza kumele ugeze igama lakho kuleya nkundla,” kusho uMchunu.Uthe kumele livalwe igebe elikhona phakathi kwabahluphekayo nabacebile.UMchunu osebenze kakhulu neNatu enguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uthe le nyunyana yiyona ahlangana nayo isikhathi eside uma eqhathanisa nezinye izinyunyana.Uthe kunalabo abacabanga ukuthi othisha abanazwi ezintweni eziqhubeka ezweni wathi lokhu akulona iqiniso ngoba kumele babe nezwi.Muva nje kube nokungqubuzana kwemibono phakathi kukaMchunu nowayeyisikhulu sakwa-Eskom uMnuz Matshela Koko ngezindaba ezithinta le nkampani.UMchunu uthe kukhona abantu abasabukela phansi othisha ngokuthi bona akufanele babe nombono ngoba ngemuva kwenkulumo yakhe ekhuluma nelinye lamaphephandaba aseThohoyandou eLimpopo, waveza ukuthi kumele kugxekwe ombombayi bezimenenja ezimnyama ngezinkinga zakwa-Eskom.I-ANC yamgxeka ngalesi sitatimende kodwa yaphinde yaxolisa kuyena.“Kukhona abacabanga ukuthi othisha akumele babe nombono ngezinto ezithinta izwe. Othisha yibona bantu abakha isizwe, kumele kwesekwe yonke imizamo yokwakha leli lizwe.”UMchunu uthe ufunde lukhulu kuNgcobo nakuMengameli weNatu uMnuz Allen Thompson ngesikhathi engungqongqoshe.Unxuse uThompson ukuthi ahlale ekubantu, angazithwali njengoba esengumengameli.UThompson uthe bazoqhubeka nomkhankaso wokuqoqa lonke ulwazi lothisha bakwaGrade R ukuze bathole iziqu abanazo ukuze bakwazi ukuqashwa ngokugcwele.Uthe bazolwela nomabhalane ezikoleni ngoba ngabantu abahlale benganakwa.“Sizolwela nokuthi kuqashwe onogada, sifuna kuqiniswe ezokuphepha ezikoleni,” kusho uThompson.Lo mcimbi ubuhanjelwe yizikhulu ezehlukene okubalwa umkhandlu wothisha iSace, ezinye izinyunyana zothisha okubalwa iNaptosa, izikhulu zomnyango wezemfundo kuzwelonke nasesifundazweni.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga akakwazanga ukuphumelela ngoba bekushone umshana wakhe kodwa uthumele abalethe umyalezo wokuhalalisela uNgcobo ngokuhola inyunyana isikhathi eside.

SIGODLIWE isinqumo ecaleni ebelifakwe yiDemocratic Alliance (DA) enkantolo lokuphoqa owayenguMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma ukuba azikhokhele izindleko zamacala abhekene nawo.NgoLwesithathu u-Adv Thabani Masuku obemele uZuma utshele amajaji ukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ubengakashintshi ekutheni izindleko zecala zikhokhelwe wuhulumeni njengoba uZuma wasayina isivumelwano nalowo owayenguMengameli wezwe uMnuz Thabo Mbeki ukuthi kube wuhulumeni okhokhayo.Ihhovisi likaRamaphosa lithe uhulumeni uzoqhubeka nokukhokhela izindleko zecala likaZuma kuze kube inkantolo ithatha esinqumo esiphikisana nalokhu.IDA ne-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF) ifake icala enkantolo ngoba ifuna uZuma akhokhe uR15.3 million osusetshenzisiwe emacaleni akhe.Le mali isetshenziswe kusukela ngo-2006 ngesikhathi kushushiswa uZuma ngodaba lwama-spy tapes.UMmeli weDA u-Adv Sean Rosenberg uthe kushushiswa uZuma hhayi umbuso ngakho uhulumeni akufanele akhokhele abameli bakhe.U-Adv Thembeka Ngcukaitobi omele i-EFF uthe uZuma uphethwe ngezandla ezintofontofo ezimnika imali yombuso futhi kufanele abuyise imali esikhokhwe wuhulumeni.UMasuku usole iDA ne-EFF ngokudlala ipolitiki esho nokuthi izindleko zecala likaZuma azimbi eqolo.Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi ummeli kahulumeni eseke abantu abasebenzela uhulumeni noma ngabe babhekene namacala okudlwengula.UJaji Pieter Meyer, utshele uMasuku ukuthi uZuma waziqokela ummeli wakhe ongasebenzisani nommeli kahulumeni.UMasuku uthe akusiye yedwa uZuma okhokhelwa izindleko zecala wuhulumeni ngoba nomkhuzi wamaphoyisa ongasekho uMnuz Jackie Selebi wayexhaswe wuhulumeni.UJaji Aubrey Ledwaba uthe ukuthi kunabantu akade bethola uxhaso kuhulumeni akusho ukuthi lesi senzo silungile.UMasuku uthe lolu daba kufanele luchithwe ngoba ukuba kwalo enkantolo kubambezela ukuthethwa kwecala elibhekene noZuma kulokhu kubhekwa ukuthi wubani okufanele akhokhe.Uthe ukube iDA yayizimisele ngokuthi uhulumeni angakhokhi izindleko zecala kwakufanele ilufake enkantolo lolu daba ngo-2008.

ININGI labantu besifazane abasesigabeni sokuthola abantwana abanezinkinga zokukhulelwa, abanalo ulwazi lokuthi banenkinga.Umbhali we-website yezempilo i-healthline echaza ngezifo eziholela ekutheni kube nzima ukuthola izingane, uNkk Stephanie Watson, kule website uthe u-26% wabantu besifazane abasesigabeni sokuthola izingane, unesifo esidalwa ukungasebenzi kwama-hormone esihlasela umgudu wenzalo iPolycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS).Abesifazane abanalesi sifo uthe bajwayele ukuya ezinsukwini zabo isikhathi eside noma babe nezimpawu zokuthi bane-hormone yabesilisa eningi i-androgen.Abanalesi sifo baba nenkinga yokuba noketshezi ezikhwameni ezigcina amaqanda okuholela ekuthini ngesinye isikhathi amaqanda abo angaphumi uma sekuyisikhathi sokuthi aphume.UNkk Watson uthi akwaziwa ukuthi iPCOS idalwa yini kodwa abesifazane abanayo bajwayele ukuba nezimpawu zokopha kakhulu uma besezinsukwini zabo noma beqiwe yizinyanga bangayi esikhathini.Kwesinye isikhathi bamila uboya emzimbeni kakhulukazi emalungeni omzimba afana nasebusweni okuvamise ukuthi kube yihwanqa, intshebe, uboya obusesifubeni nakwezinye izingxenye zomzimba.UNkk Dalene Barton Schuster encwadini yakhe ekhuthaza ukuthi kusetshenziswe amakhambi emvelo uma kwelashwa lesi sifo iNatural Fertility Info uthe lesi sifo kuyenzeka sibe wufuzo uma kukhona oke waba naso emndenini.Ngokolwazi alubhale kule ncwadi uthe kuyenzeka sidalwe ukudla okungafanele, ingcindezi nokuba nokhwantalala kwesinye isikhathi ukusetshenziswa kwemithi yokulawula ama-hormones isikhathi eside.Okunye athe kuba nomthelela ekutheni abesifazane bangakhulelwa wukuvaleka kwamashubhu aziwa ngama-fellopian tubes.Izinkinga zokungabatholi abantwana uthe ziyenzeka nakwabesilisa. Kubona uthe ukuhlolwa kokuqala kuvamise ukuthi kuveze ukuthi inkinga idalwa yini kanti abesifazane kudingeka bahlolwe izikhawu eziningi ngaphambi kokuthi kutholakale ukuthi yini inkinga.

UMA uzwa ngempumelelo yesikole iZama High, yaseManzana, Osizweni, eNewcastle, ungacabanga ukuthi ngesinye salezo zikole zasemalokishini noma emadolobheni kanti ushayephansi.IZama High eqala kwaGrade 8 iye kwaGrade 12, ngesinye sezikole eziphakamisela phezulu ifulegi lezikole zasemakhaya futhi ezibhukulile zavala igebe ebelikhona phakathi kwalezi nezikole nezasemadolobheni uma kuziwa ngasohlangothini lwemiphumela.Kubhekwe lukhulu nakwimiphumela yalo nyaka ka-matric yeZama High njengoba kusukela ngo-2010, lesi sikole sihlale sithola u-100%.Kusukela ngo-2010, lesi sikole sihlale sikhiqiza iziqengqe zabafundi abamenywa nguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ngokwenza kahle kwabo uma kukhishwa imiphumela ka-matric.IZama High ibihlonishwa ngisho nawuMnuz Senzo Mchunu oke waba nguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo esifundazweni ngamagalelo ayo kwezemfundo.Lesi sikole esingaphansi kwesiFunda iMajuba siyahloniswa ezweni lonke kanti amagalelo aso aziwa ngisho nawuNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyiSisekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga.Lesi sikole ngesinye sezikole ezamenywa nguNkk Motshekga ukuba zibambe iqhaza ohlelweni lomnyango, iThe Schools That Work, oluhlose ukuzama ukuqeda inkinga yokufeyila kwabafundi ezikoleni kuzwelonke.Ngaphandle kwalokhu, lesi sikole sike sahlonishwa ngomklomelo wokulala isibili kumaNational Matric Excellence Awards.Lesi sikole sachonywa uphaphe legwalagwala inkampani i-ATKV ngokuhlale senza kahle, ukuhlomula kwaso kuholele ekutheni le nkampani igcine isisiza nezinye izikole ezingomakhelwane baso.IZama idumile futhi ngokwenza kahle emculweni njengoba iqembu lomculo lesikole eliphekwa nguthishanhloko uMnuz Oscar Kubheka lihlale lizitamuzela izindondo kusukela ngo-2010.IQEMBU lomculo lesikole iZama High, sasOsizweni eNewcastle elidume ngokwenza kahle emculweniNjalo lesi sikole sihlale simele isifundazwe kumaNational Finals of South African Schools Choral Eisteddfod manje aziwa nge-ABC Motsepe Choral Eisteddfod.Ngo-2017, lesi sikole sawina kwiminxa emine kulo mqhudelwano womculo, umlawuli weqembu lomculo yena wanqoba indondo yeNational Best Conductor. Ngo-2018 seyibe yizingqwele kwiminxa emibili, yalala isibili kweminye iminxa emibili.Lesi sikole sesiqophe amacwecwe amathathu ngosizo lukaDkt Lucky Nkosi woKhozi FM.Iqembu lomculo lalesi sikole selike lamenywa ngisho nobengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma ukuthi lizomculela kweminye yemicimbi yakhe.Engxoxweni neSolezwe, uthishanhloko uKubheka uthe impumelelo yesikole sakhe incike ekubambisaneni okuhle phakathi kwabo bengothisha nabazali.“NoNkulunkulu wangibusisa ngezingane ezifunda lapha esikoleni, ingane uma ifika ingqondo yayo ivele ishintshe izimisele njengezinye izingane,” kusho uKubheka.Uthe abazali babambe iqhaza elikhulu empumelelweni yesikole ngoba bahlale benza isiqiniseko sokuthi yonke into ihamba kahle.UKubheka uphinde wabonga nomholi wesifunda sabo uMnuz Zembethe Nkosi ohlale emgqugquzela ukuthi enze kahle.“Umhloli wethu akathi ngoba izinto zihamba kahle bese eyayekelela kodwa uyaqhubeka angiphushe lokho kusiziza kakhulu isikole,” kusho uKubheka.UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga, uthishanhloko waseZama High uMnuz Oscar Kubheka nePhini likaNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uMnuz Enver Surty bekweminye yemicimbi yokuklomelisa iZama ngokwenza kahle ku-matricUphinde wabonga nothishanhloko obekhona ngaphambi kwakhe uNkk Sbongile Mazibuko, wathi nguyena owakhe isisekelo esiqinile sesikole.USihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole uMnuz Nhlanhla Kubheka naye uhambe emazwini kathishanhloko wathi ukubambisana okwenza isikole siphumelele.“Enye into esiza isikole ukuthi siphumelele ukuziphatha nokuhlonipha imithetho yesikole,” kusho uKubheka.Uthe bahlale njalo befuna ukukhiqiza abafundi abazoba abantu abahlonishwayo emphakathini.

text: ITHOLAKALE ishonile indoda (52) yaseMbongolwane obesekuphele isonto inyamalele emuva kokuthi iphume ngesudi yesele endlini yentombi ibalekela abalisa okuthiwa babeyifuna ngezibhamu.Amaphoyisa akuqinisekisile ukuthi isidumbu sikaMnuz Kwazikwakhe Mfanothi Lushozi onyamalale ekupheleni kwenyanga edlule sitholakele sinamanxeba okungakaqinisekiswa ukuthi ngawani. IZAZI zomnotho zigqugquzela abantu ukuthi babophe izifociya futhi bamukele ukuthi intengo kaphethroli izolokhu yehla yenyuka, ngendlela okwenzeka ngayo ngoba uhulumeni akakezi namasu okwehlisa intela kaphethroli.UMnuz Doctor Sangweni oyisazi somnotho enkampanini iDolsden Oracle, uthe uphethroli othengwa kwamanye amazwe uthengwa ngentengo ebekwe ngamazwe awukhiqizayo bese uma ufika kuleli ufakwe intela ehlukene okungekaphethroli nesiza abalimele ezingozini zomgwaqo.Uthe uhulumeni nokuntenga kwerandi kwenza iNingizimu Afrika iwuthenge ngemali eningi uphethroli.“Uhulumeni nguye olawula intengo kaphethroli ngokuthi uma usufike kuleli afake intela. Mhlawumbe ukube intela iyehliswa bese amagaragi eze nentengo yawo yamalitha ngabe kunokuncintisana phakathi kwawo.Akufanele intela imbe eqolo ngoba yilokho okwenza ilitha likaphethroli limbe eqolo,” kusho uSangweni.Mayelana nodaba lokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ikhiqiza uphethroli wayo wakwaSasol, umcwaningi wezomnotho, uMnuz Sakhile Dlamini uvumile ukuthi ukhona uphethroli okhiqizwa eNingizimu Afrika osuselwa emalahleni.“Kuyimanje iSasol ihamba phambili ezinkampanini ezikhiqiza uphethroli osuselwa emalahleni emhlabeni jikelele.Lo phethroli ubizwa nge-synthetic fuel futhi kudala waqala ukwenziwa kuleli, ngesikhathi uhulumeni wobandlululo evalwa ukuthi athenge uwoyela emazweni angaphandle.Ube esesungula iSasol okuyiyona ekhiqiza iSasol fuel eminyakeni engu-63 edlule,” kusho uDlamini.Uthe lolu hlobo lukaphethroli lwaqala ukwenziwa eGermany ngabo-1920 futhi uyasetshenziswa emazweni amaningi.UDlamini ucele abantu ukuthi babophe izifociya bathenge lokho okuyizidingo ngoba azikakenziwa izinhlelo zokwehlisa intela kaphethroli eNingizimu Afrika.

text: UMENGAMELI ngokuhlonishwa we-IFP inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi uthi kuyomphatha kabi uma eze washona lungaqediwe uhlelo lokubuyisana phakathi kweNkatha ne-ANC.Ekhuluma emcimbini wokwethulwa ngokusemthethweni kwesikhwama sakhe nomngani wakhe ongusomabhizinisi ohlonishwayo, uMnuz Harry Oppenheimer esikhumulweni sezindiza esidala ngaseSiphingo izolo, uButhelezi uthe inhliziyo yakhe kayikutholi ukuphumula ngokuthi lolu hlelo kalukaqedwa.“Kuyongiphatha kabi uma ngivala amehlo ami ngishona kodwa kusenezilonda ezingakalashwa phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe uyajabula ukuthi umholi ohlonishwayo we-ANC, uMnuz Meshack Radebe ukhona emcimbini wakhe.“Kuyintokozo ukuba khona kukaRadebe lapha owaziwa kakhulu ngamagalelo akhe okudala uxolo phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC eHammarsdale ebambisene noDkt Sipho Mlaba ongasekho. Ngisho nangesikhathi uRadebe enze umcimbi wokugubha ukuhlanganisa iminyaka engu-70, wangimema kwakhe eMaqongqo ngaya ngoba ngangazi ukuthi ukungimema kwakhe kwakugqugquzelwa yintshisekelo yakhe yokubona sibuyisana,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe kade kwasa ethukwa, ebizwa ngawo wonke amagama ngabaholi be-ANC, abanye baze bambize ngomdayisi nangencelebane yabamhlophe.“Noma ngangihlaselwa ngayo yonke indlela kodwa bekungiqinisa kungenze ngime kulokhu engikholelwa kukho ngenxa yokwesekwa enganginikukwa ngumngani wami * -Oppenheimer, wangiseka futhi nangesikhathi ngithatha isinqumo sokunqaba ukuthi isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal sibe nguzimele geqe njengoba ezinye izifundazwe ezine zase zivumile,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe ngenxa yozimele geqe, abantu abamnyama babenziwa abantu bokufika ezweni labo.“Njengoba ngilapha namhlanje emcimbini wokwethulwa kwalesi sikhwama sami nomngani wami ngizizwa sengathi ngisemngcwabeni wami uqobo,” kusho uButhelezi.Isikhulumi sosuku emcimbini, uMnuz John Kane-Berman, sigeqe amagula sichaza umlando kaButhelezi namagalelo akhe emzabalazweni.“Kuyiqiniso elifihliwe ukuthi uButhelezi nguyena owayephoqa uhulumeni wobandlululo ukuthi akhulule uMengameli wokuqala wentando yeningi kuleli uDkt Nelson Mandela ejele, uButhelezi waze wasabisa ngokuthi ngeke alungenele ukhetho uma uMandela engakhululwa, kuningi akwenza ukuze abamnyama bakhululeke kodwa kufihliwe,” kushouKane-Berman.Umeluleki kaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Linda Zama, uthe umlando wakuleli kawuphelele ngaphandle kukaButhelezi no-Oppenheimer.UNksz Zama uchaze uButhelezi njengomholi osezingeni lomhlaba ngenxa yamagalelo akhe emzabalazweni“Kakusilo ihaba ukuthi sithi uMntwana waKwaPhindangene uyingqalabutho yomholi wakuleli, osebenze cishe nabo bonke abaholi abahlonishwayo nabadumile hhayi lapha eNingizimu Afrika nasezwenikazi kodwa nasemhlabeni wonke uqobo,” kusho uNksz Zama.
